chapters.title: Chapter 2680 The First Extremity Falls to Quintessence! II
paragraphs: 2680 The First Extremity Falls to Quintessence! II
Seeing the blooming Ash Tree II of Gradation and the fantastical effects it was about to give him, Noah knew his current path was the correct one.

He had created multiple avenues providing him loot as even though it was immensely hard and would become even harder for him to continue cultivating the Sporos of Extremity to maturity, he knew that it would only be an inevitability!
And all of this...was him going towards Extremity with the path that Quintessence provided.
He had other concepts that existences considered Dead Paths due to their grandness that had also reached the 17th Boundary Layer as they carried their own brilliance compared to Quintessence!
As the Ash Tree II of Gradation bloomed before him, he blinked as he pulled up the details of another path that was through nothing else other than...
Infinity.

[The Seventeenth Boundary Layer of Infinity]:: The concept of Infinity is a terrifying one to ever bring to Extremity as very few existences can withstand its meaning. Yet your existence has a part of it that already embodies a sense of Infinity as for you, the Extremity of Infinity may just be a possibility. Towards this end, Infinity leaves a path open that may just aid you in attaining Extremity- depending on how it is utilized, and it can only be utilized once in your lifetime. For an instant, you can make any Resource or Authority within your Aspects of Existence infinite...
An instant.
Not a second, microsecond, nanosecond, or any other span of time- but only a single instant.
It was an incredibly terrifying Boundary Layer that could only be utilized once.

But that once would undoubtedly produce such reality shattering effects as Noah had been having Oraculum try and find all the possible paths that this Boundary Layer could be utilized in addition to the 17th Boundary Layer of Quintessence that brought the illustrious Ash Tree II of Gradation that was blooming before him among other paths!
In the midst of his computations of possibilities...
"Hmm?"
His head rose as he gazed out.
Past the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
His will came to feel the Recorded History of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity that he had hidden his home in.
At this moment...he felt and heard...
DUM! DUM! DUM!
The sound of beating drums.
The sound of a beginning symphony.
It was a symphony of majesty as it seemed to be connected to him!
As for why it had begun...Noah's will very quickly focused on his Reified Source of Quintessence surrounded by Legions of Vacuous Malignancies behind him and Vitalis Malignancies ahead of him.
The faint sounds of beating drums had begun to echo out in this region as a drastic change occurred at this moment!

On the Hyperversal Savior's Ark Noah's Virions had incapacitated, the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity who was using waves of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority to stabilize everything suddenly had his three heads change their expressions as in front of him...
RIIP!
Space tore as a radiant Sword of Vitalis bloomed.

It pulsed with shocking power as he wasn't the only one, where if one's view encompassed all the nearby regions, they would see that a dozen massive illusory Swords of Vitalis were struck out against multiple targets as Emperor Shao continued to take center stage!
One of his sword strikes just so happened to come here.
BOOM!

The authority of the Vacuous Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity was forced to defend against this sword strike as the seas of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority supporting the 100 Extremities affected by Noah's Virions wavered, their Tier 3 and Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities still only having their expression be stern and in pain as they quickly sought to stop the spread of Noah's Blood Source across their Records, but the Vacuous Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities who were swirling with Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures...they had a much harder time.
Their Extremity Rune Scriptures could not defend them as proficiently as the Obsidian and Crimson Extremity Rune Scriptures attained by those above them.
Similar to the Avernus Extremities, once affected...Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities had to focus most if not all of their attention on stopping the spread of the Virion across their Recorded History!
It was why the Tier 1 Avernus Extremities had even fallen out of the skies of the Saurischian Archipelago.

The Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities...were having a much harder time due to the dominance of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority raging in their Aspects of Existence as while the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity who came to support them was kept busy by a Sword of Vitalis, a single Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity fell into a predicament.
DUM! DUM! DUM!
From afar, Noah felt the symphony of drums become ever louder as he wasn't the only one.
All beings in the surroundings heard it as it felt like the beating drums were ushering in something grand!
Yet Noah could feel their intensity.
He could feel their focus.
His eyes quickly moved as they came to focus on a particular Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity affected by his Virion.

He clutched his chest as his body faced multiple implosions from the storms of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, his Extremity Rune Scriptures swirling around his existence madly to isolate and take out as much Vitalis as possible!

The Scriptures read [VOID] and [DEVOURING], and only these two types of Extremity Scriptures were swirling around this existence and encasing him in a circular protective light as he had only achieved Extremity in these two concepts.
And at this moment while his Scriptures moved according to his will to isolate and remove the storms within his body, he made a mistake.
He felt the buzzing of an even purer form of Vitalis above him that the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity faced as during the impacts, tendrils of Vitalis seethed out into the surroundings.

With his fear of the Vitalis within and then feeling the tendrils of Vitalis above, a part of his Will was fearfully sent out to gaze above as he tried to move below to avoid any possible collateral attacks!
And this single choice.
This single moment of fearful decision making.
CRACK!
It caused the raging storm of Vitalis and Vacuous to locate the weakened area where he sent out a portion of his will.
An area of the circular protective light of [VOID] and [DEVOURING] Extremity Rune Scriptures suddenly had a perforation as it was no longer solid and impenetrable!

And this single perforation was akin to a chain reaction as the gaze of this being became entirely ashen a moment later, the Blood Source of the Virion in his Existence beginning to spread rapidly and gaining access deeply into his History like never before!
CRACK!
After this single perforation, another one appeared as the Extremity Rune Scriptures around this being...began to be torn and destroyed under the storm of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
Noah gazed at all this and felt a profound sensation.
The symphony in the surroundings picked up pace as authorities were riled up chaotically.
And before his eyes...
[You are scaling an unscalable wall that has only been scaled once before in all of Recorded History!]
Glorious prompts that also revealed a bit of a shocking History began to appear!

chapters.title: Chapter 2681 The First Extremity Falls to Quintessence! III
paragraphs: 2681 The First Extremity Falls to Quintessence! III
Something that had only occurred once before in Recorded History!
What a profound significance!
Who was Noah in the vastness of reality?
Who was Noah as an existence across the Records of eons past?

A young man who experienced an apocalypse and grasped onto an opportunity. He then turned this opportunity into a fate that took him on this grand path he now followed. He had now embarked on the Road of Extremity as towards existences who had taken concepts to their extremes across innumerable years...just who was he in comparison to all this?
What significance could a being like him stemming from a nondescript blue planet have in the grandeur of all this?!
His thoughts buzzed willfully as today, something significant occurred.

The scene was a heartbreaking one as after the perforation of one area, more and more perforations occurred on the protective circular protective barrier of the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity, his Hyperversal Extremity Rune Scriptures flickering and beginning to be broken down one after another as in the depths of his existence, the Hyperversal Anomalous Virion reached critical penetration into this being's records.
As if molten lava was coursing through his veins and every record of his existence, they tore apart and erased everything before they turned it to ash!
DUM! DUM!
A symphony reached a crescendo as it was akin to the melody of an archaic funeral of a soul that would forever be lost.

Noah's eyes watched the process extensively as after a certain moment, the unwillingness, disbelief, and utter horror coursing through the Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity flashed as his Extremity Rune Scriptures began to turn dim and flicker.
They lost their golden glow and immensity that showed how far this being had come!
And as they lost their glow, the profound authority of Lotra and Quintessence wrapped around the Extremity Rune Scriptures.

Without the blazing Hyperversal Extremity Authority wrapping around them gloriously, they were overtaken and devoured by Lotra and Quintessence along with the core existence of this Extremity as all of it...would be turned into Loot!
DUM!
The beat of the drum resounding out was deep and filled with importance as it echoed out across light years amidst the ongoing battles.
The Scriptures on the dying Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity turned dim and were then taken away as within moments, his figure came to a halt in the middle of nothingness.

The light of brightness within his eyes dimmed evermore as in another moment, all of his records of existence were breached by Noah's Blood Source as the storms of Vitalis and Vacuous wreaked havoc everywhere. Ultimately...
DUM!
The brightness of Extremity in this being's eyes turned entirely dim.

Noah watched the death of an Extremity through his own hands with a profound sense of calmness and wonder as at the very end, the blank gaze of this being felt like it had been shown the one responsible for everything as the dimming eyes gazed towards Noah's direction.
And he stared deeply into the eyes of his killer as all of his Hyperversal Extremity Authority faded.
DUM!
The booming drum echoed out like an alarm signaling a great end as at such a moment, an unseen Refulgence of light and majesty erupted out before the person responsible!
Not around his Reified Source of Quintessence in the midst of this battle between the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions.
But the brilliance of light unfolded around Noah's main body in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as if the Aeonic Annals of Extremity were cognizant and considerate of Noah's path.
They didn't expose his Reified Source of Quintessence with a grand show of wonder under the eyes of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Extremities as everything was occurring around his main body!
[You have scaled a wall not meant to be scaled!]
[Without taking any concept to Extremity, you are the second to erase the records and grant True Death to an existence that has achieved Extremity.]
[An Impossible Achievement!]
For an achievement that would be the second one in all of Recorded History, but what exactly would come from it?!
And who was the first existence that had managed to violate the demarcation of Extremity and actually kill such a being before they even attained Extremity?
In this moment of profound wonder and epiphany, Noah also wondered about Unrecorded Histories.

Were they simply things that had yet to happen, or could events that occurred in the past somehow be capable of being veiled under Unrecorded Histories? Were there any other feats or existences of profound quality and power across the eons who didn't have astounding achievements recorded?
And...just how extensive was the Aeonic Annals of Extremity?!
They covered all History under Extremity as the Vitalis Lifeforms utilized the Annals of Extremity, and so did Vacuous Lifeform.

But how vast was their distinction? When a Vacuous Lifeforms made an astounding feat, would the Aeonic Annals of Extremity grant them Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as a boon similar to how Noah was granted Vitalis Hyperversal Authority before? Were the Aeonic Annals of Extremity different or entirely separate depending on the Lifeform accessing them?
And when it came to Noah who benefitted from both Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities...just what would be his fate?

There were a great deal of questions with not enough information to fully answer them, but Noah was undaunted as he continued, the prompts continuing to cascade down as above him, reality splintered while something grand threatened to descend.
[You are the First in Recorded History to have erased the Records of an Extremity before you stepped on the stage of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!]
[A Quintessential Achievement!]
[The Boundary of Quintessence has taken great strides towards Extremity.]
[The title of Extremity Despoiler has been attained.]
WAA!
An adorning reality was made bare at this moment in time.
Yes, he wasn't the first to kill an Extremity before he achieved this stage himself.
But he was the first to kill an Extremity before he even became an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!
And such a feat was gloriously Quintessential.
His main body still had the magisterial Meridian Seeds that had never sprouted even now.
Even though he was close to Extremity, he still had yet to undergo his transformation as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!

chapters.title: Chapter 2682 The First Extremity Falls to Quintessence! IV
paragraphs: 2682 The First Extremity Falls to Quintessence! IV
His very existence violated all the common norms as it was due to this that he attained such a profound achievement.
And for it...
[In addition to the Vitalis Annals of Extremity, you have now gained full access to the Vacuous Annals of Extremity.]
CRACK!

The skies above Noah in this unique domain of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven he was in fully split apart as from their cracks, extremely pure waves of transparent white and deeply obsidian light cascaded down.

They twirled around the Quintessential Hyperversal Ash Tree II of Extremity that was still growing and pulsing with a profound light, some of the waves of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority being drawn into it!

As they neared in proximity, they roared out and churned with wild grandeur as they surged towards Noah's body, sinking into his Aspects of Existence as before they could cause havoc and destroy everything- two Innate Hyperversal Meridians blazed to life and greedily devoured everything coming down!
Noah turned up to gaze at the crack in space as this wasn't truly the most accurate way to describe it.
His eyes could see that this was merely a crack in this unfolding history, with the waves of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority coming from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity themselves!
The Aeonic Annals of Extremity. The Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity!
Two Sides of the same immense Records as on this day, Noah gained access to the Vacuous Annals of Extremity.
A whole set of Records he had yet to even begin exploring and learning about.
And he would no doubt have the chance to learn even more about them as many of his authorities were scaled upwards.
[Your Authority as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator has been elevated to Quintessential Inscrutable Annals Curator!]
[The Singularity Crystal of the Record of Extremity has been attained!]
[The Singularity Crystal of the True Death Record of Diospia!]

Around his main body that absorbed shockingly Pure wave soft Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, Loot began to descend as the Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures that were devoured by Lotra and Quintessence along with the entire existence of a Hyperversal Extremity were processed, elevated, and transformed into wonders.
But no wonder was as bright and filled with radiance as the one that descended next.
Radiating pure halcyon light, a piece of a scroll emanating waves of pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority manifested.
[1x Remnant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity has been attained.]
[You have obtained the first Quintessential Extremity Loot!]
A Quintessential Extremity Loot.
What else did it mean but the sheer fact that this loot...directly led to and shared an intricate connection to Extremity?

Details of this Loot and the astounding prompts before it began to emerge within Noah's mind at this moment, and at the same time...the Ash Tree II of Extremity also had its countless cerulean branches begin to flutter before they bent down towards Noah's visage.
His Origin trembled as pure Havenly Authority of Oceanus began to flow down.
His soul cheered as it began undergoing yet another round of baptism.
And his mind buzzed as glorious waves of information came.

[Extremity Despoiler]:: A distinction and title that very few beings share across Recorded History. It can be gained in very few and limited ways, and it allows those who have previously scaled an unscalable wall to be capable of traversing it at an even easier pace. With the distinction of Extremity Despoiler, one is able to condense a False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of [DESPOILER]. This False Extremity Rune Scripture requires 100,000 Units of either Vitalis or Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, along with immense reserves of resources, Soul Values, and authority to condense as any average existence standing before the cusp of Extremity would have difficulties condensing it, but as a being with the distinction and capabilities of an Extremity Despoiler, it should not be an impossibility for you. A Single False Rune Scripture of [DESPOILER] is capable of piercing a protective Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture on the body of a Hyperversal Extremity, granting you the chance to repeat what you already did before. Any subsequent achievements of scaling the Unscalable Wall of Extremity will only empower the distinction of Extremity Despoiler as its limits have yet to be breached...
The first wave of information came from the title gained by killing a Hyperversal Extremity before he had any concept taken to this level.
Extremity Despoiler!

Depending on whether one was extremely lucky with their circumstances to be capable of killing an Extremity, this distinction gave them the chance to repeat their impossible achievement by doing something as grand as allowing the erasure of a single Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture.
Of course, even a weak Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity had begun to accumulate many Extremity Rune Scriptures as their enemy just destroying one did not mean death was coming for them.
But it would allow the authority of an Extremity Despoiler to enter or pierce into an Extremity as in Noah's case...

He had been able to kill the Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity due to his means of utilizing a Virion that caused a storm of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities- and because of their momentary lapse in judgment, one of their Rune Scriptures was perforated by an erupting storm as this was akin to the tipping of the dominoes that gave way to much greater damage being dealt to this being's records!
More and more of their Extremity Rune Scriptures were then perforated and destroyed by Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities until ultimately...
True Death came for them.
Now, Noah didn't have to hope for a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity to have a lapse in judgment or make a poor decision.

So long as he condensed a False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture, he could destroy a single Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture on their bodies as he could kick start their path towards True Death...and make his astounding achievement be more than a one hit wonder!

sentences.text: 2682 The First Extremity Falls to Quintessence!
IV
His very existence violated all the common norms as it was due to this that he attained such a profound achievement.
And for it...
[In addition to the Vitalis Annals of Extremity, you have now gained full access to the Vacuous Annals of Extremity.]
CRACK!

The skies above Noah in this unique domain of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven he was in fully split apart as from their cracks, extremely pure waves of transparent white and deeply obsidian light cascaded down.

They twirled around the Quintessential Hyperversal Ash Tree II of Extremity that was still growing and pulsing with a profound light, some of the waves of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority being drawn into it!

As they neared in proximity, they roared out and churned with wild grandeur as they surged towards Noah's body, sinking into his Aspects of Existence as before they could cause havoc and destroy everything- two Innate Hyperversal Meridians blazed to life and greedily devoured everything coming down!
Noah turned up to gaze at the crack in space as this wasn't truly the most accurate way to describe it.
His eyes could see that this was merely a crack in this unfolding history, with the waves of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority coming from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity themselves!
The Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
The Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity!
Two Sides of the same immense Records as on this day, Noah gained access to the Vacuous Annals of Extremity.
A whole set of Records he had yet to even begin exploring and learning about.
And he would no doubt have the chance to learn even more about them as many of his authorities were scaled upwards.
[Your Authority as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator has been elevated to Quintessential Inscrutable Annals Curator!]
[The Singularity Crystal of the Record of Extremity has been attained!]
[The Singularity Crystal of the True Death Record of Diospia!]

Around his main body that absorbed shockingly Pure wave soft Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, Loot began to descend as the Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures that were devoured by Lotra and Quintessence along with the entire existence of a Hyperversal Extremity were processed, elevated, and transformed into wonders.
But no wonder was as bright and filled with radiance as the one that descended next.
Radiating pure halcyon light, a piece of a scroll emanating waves of pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority manifested.
[1x Remnant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity has been attained.]
[You have obtained the first Quintessential Extremity Loot!]
A Quintessential Extremity Loot.
What else did it mean but the sheer fact that this loot...directly led to and shared an intricate connection to Extremity?

Details of this Loot and the astounding prompts before it began to emerge within Noah's mind at this moment, and at the same time...the Ash Tree II of Extremity also had its countless cerulean branches begin to flutter before they bent down towards Noah's visage.
His Origin trembled as pure Havenly Authority of Oceanus began to flow down.
His soul cheered as it began undergoing yet another round of baptism.
And his mind buzzed as glorious waves of information came.
[Extremity Despoiler]:: A distinction and title that very few beings share across Recorded History.
It can be gained in very few and limited ways, and it allows those who have previously scaled an unscalable wall to be capable of traversing it at an even easier pace.
With the distinction of Extremity Despoiler, one is able to condense a False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of [DESPOILER].

This False Extremity Rune Scripture requires 100,000 Units of either Vitalis or Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, along with immense reserves of resources, Soul Values, and authority to condense as any average existence standing before the cusp of Extremity would have difficulties condensing it, but as a being with the distinction and capabilities of an Extremity Despoiler, it should not be an impossibility for you.

A Single False Rune Scripture of [DESPOILER] is capable of piercing a protective Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture on the body of a Hyperversal Extremity, granting you the chance to repeat what you already did before.
Any subsequent achievements of scaling the Unscalable Wall of Extremity will only empower the distinction of Extremity Despoiler as its limits have yet to be breached...
The first wave of information came from the title gained by killing a Hyperversal Extremity before he had any concept taken to this level.
Extremity Despoiler!

Depending on whether one was extremely lucky with their circumstances to be capable of killing an Extremity, this distinction gave them the chance to repeat their impossible achievement by doing something as grand as allowing the erasure of a single Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture.
Of course, even a weak Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity had begun to accumulate many Extremity Rune Scriptures as their enemy just destroying one did not mean death was coming for them.
But it would allow the authority of an Extremity Despoiler to enter or pierce into an Extremity as in Noah's case...

He had been able to kill the Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity due to his means of utilizing a Virion that caused a storm of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities- and because of their momentary lapse in judgment, one of their Rune Scriptures was perforated by an erupting storm as this was akin to the tipping of the dominoes that gave way to much greater damage being dealt to this being's records!
More and more of their Extremity Rune Scriptures were then perforated and destroyed by Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities until ultimately...
True Death came for them.
Now, Noah didn't have to hope for a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity to have a lapse in judgment or make a poor decision.

So long as he condensed a False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture, he could destroy a single Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture on their bodies as he could kick start their path towards True Death...and make his astounding achievement be more than a one hit wonder!

chapters.title: Chapter 2683 The First is Always the Hardest! I
paragraphs: 2683 The First is Always the Hardest! I
The first was always the most special, yes, but it was also the hardest!
Getting there was always the trickiest part as after one arrived at a certain benchmark, staying on it or forging further ahead was always easier the next time around.

For any existence, erasing the Records of an Extremity were an impossibility unless they gained such a power themselves to be capable of affecting the Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures that protected the very Aspects of Existence and Records of such a being!
What Noah had done was bypass gaining any similar authority himself as he...
got himself access to authorities that even some Extremities cannot control or grasp.
Vitalis.
Vacuous.
He used these two authorities paired with his very own Blood Sourceto achieve the stellar feat that at this moment granted him...the key to making it possible again!
[Extremity Despoiler].
It provided a quantity of Units in terms of Vitalis or Vacuous Hyperversal Authority that were required along with immense resources and soul values that were not quantified on top of this.
Noah would have to find out for himself as this distinction and the capabilities it granted...was his key to butchering Extremities in the time to come!
"Extremity Despoiler."

So while an Ash Tree II of Gradation was pouring its refulgent authority into his Origin and Soul, while seas of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities cascaded from the cracks of records above...he called out lightly.
BZZT!
And the reality in front of him fluctuated as a singularity bloomed, the nearby reality being pulled into it as it gradually formed into a stroke that represented [D]!
Noah's soul then buzzed as under his command, streams of pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority began flowing into this beginning of a False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture.
He was quickly able to grasp what the streams of Vitalis flowing into him were in terms of Units as they flowed into the forming Rune Scripture ahead of him.

At the same time, the input of Soul Values was immense as within moments, Noah had the Reified Wealdian Source of Vitalistic and Lotra appear beside him, waves of Soul Values in the hundreds of thousands releasing from them steadily!

As for Mana? This didn't even need to be mentioned as seas of this gorgeous blue authority flowed endlessly into the False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture to make up for any and all authorities.

Droves of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowed in as when the halfway mark of the requirement was met at 50,000 Units of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, Noah found the total reserves of this authority in his Meridians to have depleted by 25%!
It meant he currently had an approximate range of 200,000 Units of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority to play with, and a similar number of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
The only downside was that the regeneration of these two authorities was currently abysmal to Noah!
These were his thoughts, but if others who had undergone Awakening heard them, they might deviate from their circulation of authority in anger at his perspective.
He had a steady stream of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority from those joining his Lineage as it was absorbed and refined into his body in addition to replenishing the reserves he had.
He now also had pure streams of it gushing from the rupture of records above along with Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
His current regeneration of these two authorities through such unique means was far faster than even an existence who had undergone their Third Awakening.

Waves of Authorities surged from his body and his Reified Clones as ever so slowly, more and more characters appeared in the blooming singularity above them that now radiated intense might while being at [DESP].
While this process continues, the details of the other boons to come from Noah's shocking actions unfolded.

[The Singularity Crystal of the Record of Extremity]:: Very rarely are there worthy records to view and ponder on, but the record of an established path to Extremity along with the process of advancement from the 17th Boundary Layer and into the Extremity Layer is indispensable of a record. This Singularity Crystal holds within it the Records of Extremity of [VOID] and [DEVOURING] up to the First Gradation of Extremity. The gains made from viewing and learning from such a record can be insignificant or quintessentially insightful. The Record can be viewed a total of 100 times before it is used up and collapsed into itself. Upon sending a trace of your soul to view this record, you will experience it to the extent as if you were the existence traversing from the 1st Layer to the Extremity Layer of the [VOID] and [DEVOURING]...

[The Singularity Crystal of the True Death Record of Diospia]:: The breakdown of Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures and True Death of an existence that has begun to walk the Gradations of Extremity. In death, there can be new life. In viewing the True Death Record of the one known as Diospia, it may be possible to draw inferences on the formation and breakdown of Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures. The Record can be viewed a total of 100 times before it is used up and collapsed into itself...

The first two descriptions were astonishing Records of Extremity that didn't just allow one to simply learn about the records of an existence achieving extremity and then even dying, it made it so that the one experiencing it all was actually the viewer!

It would allow one to actually feel the shocking alteration of life from an Apex Aeonic Lifeform and towards Extremity as such a tool...may just make it possible for some unique beings that needed one last nudge to reach the last Extremity Layer.

Noah's soul didn't feel any sense of grandness when gazing at the Singularity Crystals as he knew they wouldn't be able to do much for him apart from increasing his understanding of the Extremity Rune Scriptures that he could already see with his Eyes of Extremity!
But...if an existence whose very foundation and makeup was conducive towards achieving Extremity at the shortest possible time...
HUUM!
The surrounding reality released hums of grandiosity as Noah's gaze turned towards the Apollyon Aletheian Haven.
Towards the center of dense Sources of Chaos where a gorgeous young woman shimmering with quasars stood!

chapters.title: Chapter 2684 The First is Always the Hardest! II
paragraphs: 2684 The First is Always the Hardest! II
Xiaomi.
The existence with the Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos!
Noah had already seen and stated that she would be the first existence to gain the authority of a Hyperversal Extremity in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
This assertion had not proved wrong just yet as after his eyes were illuminated with the light of Oraculum, he clenched his fist as space distorted and twisted.
And within an instant, the visage of a graceful young woman appeared as her body crackled with tendrils of Ruin and other Sources of Chaos.

The moment she arrived, her soul trembled as her eyes fluttered open, feeling the shocking authorities of Vitalis and Vacuous above her, as well as the glistening illusory Ash Tree II of Gradation that had its branches sinking into Noah and giving off immeasurable waves of authority!
She was baffled at such a confluence of authority and majesty that she felt extremely small in the midst of all this.
But the being at the center of it all beckoned towards her as her body moved before her soul even commanded it.

She felt the sheer pressure and majesty of this being before her released as currently, a multicolored Emperor's Robe pulsing with authority draped over him, his dark hair sparkling more than her own that was filled with quasars as his eyes...their Nine Pupils caused the surrounding space to tremble as within them, Xiaomi could swear she was seeing a stroke of runic lights that seemed to say Extremity!

She almost felt as if she was standing in front of a genuine Extremity as she continued to marvel at this being who seemed much grander than his past self- and this was compared to his past self of just hours or a day ago, not even weeks, months, or years!
"Xiaomi."

He called out her name as she instantly came out of her fantasies and focused, nodding with utmost respect and reverence as she saw his devilish smile that caused her heart to beat like a drum, his hands carrying the weight of entire Aletheian Havens moving as he pointed towards one of the many dazzling things around him.
"Send your will into this Record and let us see how much closer it gets you to Extremity."
His words were filled with majesty as always as Xiaomi nodded once more, her will focusing on one of the dazzling Singularities in this region as a part of her soul sank into it!
Noah watched this scene calmly as on the description of the Singularity Crystal of the Record of Extremity, the usage went down from 100 to 99.

Around him, typhoons of authority continued to spin as the massive Ash Tree II of Extremity had already spent 50% of its authority, its massive stature beginning to reduce as in his Origin, the Sixth Aletheian Haven that was composed almost entirely of Oceanus and a sliver of Helios was more than 70% completed!
Of course, in addition to all this, there was the Havenly Boundary Layer of Oceanus that came with it- the prompts of this stupendous authority simply passing over Noah's eyes.
[The 15th Havenly Boundary Layer of Oceanus has been attained!]
[The 16th Havenly Boundary Layer of Oceanus has been attained!]
Oceanus.

This was yet another Havenly Boundary Layer added after Dissolution, Helios, and Genesis. Four out of the Seven Havenly Authorities of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains were now obtained by Noah as he aimed to have all of them under his banner.
All of them.

Not just the Seven Havenly Authorities that made the Seven Vitalis Haven. As Noah had butchered 100 Million Vacuous Apex Lifeforms and a single Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity, he had also been sifting through an uncountable number of memories from all of these beings!
Memories of the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.

Memories of moments of nothingness stretched out across even grander expanses of the absence of time and reality itself. Within these memories, he received more than a glimpse of fantastical lands built atop the grandeur of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, as well as Havenly Authorities that made up their lands.
But they didn't refer to them as Havenly Authorities. They were referred to as Infernal Authorities that made up their Infernal Havens of Extremity!
Such things were also within Noah's sight as he felt like he would be more complete if he could attain Infernal Authorities as well as Havenly Authorities.

And... it seemed like he would get the chance to gaze at one of such Infernal Authorities in action as while a part of his will probed the last Loot he gained from killing a Hyperversal Extremity, the [Remnant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity], a stupendous change occurred within the gaze of the Reified Source of Quintessence that was responsible for killing the Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity!
Within the gray region of Vitalis and Vacuous Authorities where two forces had begun to clash.

The death of a single Vacuous Extremity was insignificant in the larger picture, but there were still 99 others from the Ark Noah had affected who were still fighting the storms within their bodies. There were the constant attacks from a terrifying Vitalis Extremity who filled the battlefield with sword lights.
By all accounts, since the battle had begun- the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions had been pushed back as Vitalis had shone with brilliance.
The forces behind the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions seemed to have had enough of this.

Because at this moment in time, a booming sound rang out across the gray region as in a shocking turn of events, an entity filled with extremely pure Vacuous Hyperversal Authority appeared above a Bastion of Vitalis!
They had crossed vast light years of space and somehow cut across the lines of defenses, their stature massive in size as their form was utterly massive!
Four pairs of wings made of aurora of Vacuous lights expanded behind it as any trace of transparent white Vitalis was actually burned in this Entity's presence.

The pressure he gave off was immense as this Entity...was one who had undergone the Third Vacuous Awakening at the very least- attaining a shocking form of power and might that they sought to display at this moment by targeting an entire Bastion of Vitalis!

chapters.title: Chapter 2685 Infernal Brilliance! I
paragraphs: 2685 Infernal Brilliance! I
Mighty, and immeasurably fast.

The entire body of this being seemed to be made up of extremely pure Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as along with the aurora of four pairs of obsidian wings behind his back, their whole makeup seemed to be pure Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as their humanoid visage had a single head that only had spinning crimson Singularities for eyes.
The eyes burned with callousness and terror as with great speed, this being thrust his hand out towards the massive and light years spanning Bastion of Vitalis that was akin to a Minor Haven!

From the Bastion, a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity felt their scalp tingle as a woman adorned in a flaming blue Armament of Extremity radiating the grandeur of Oceanus rose up with a bellow- Vitalis Hyperversal Authority beginning to coagulate around her.
And yet comparatively, the existence made up of extremely pure Vacuous Hyperversal Authority that had appeared was much, much too fast.

The moment their hand thrust out, the surrounding space dimmed as an instant later, a gloriously shining illusory construct that looked like an Extremity Rune Scripture covered by a crimson glow manifested.
Its size alone was ridiculous as it covered and pressed towards the Bastion of Vitalis while covering all of its surface area!
As if a massive hand was pressing down from immeasurably high skies!
And for those who managed to catch a brief glance at this massive Extremity Rune Scripture...their minds would tremble while reading a stroke of characters representing a single word
[ACHERON]!
One of the Infernal Havens of Extremity stretched out across the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains!

The massive Extremity Rune Scripture had an overall glow of crimson, but it deeply shone with a topaz glow of majesty that was wrapped in the obsidian grandeur of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as while the Tier 4 Vitalis Hyperversal Extremity was just gathering the radiant glow of Vitalis around her to react...
BOOOM...CRACK!
The illusory Extremity Rune Scripture of [ACHERON] thundered down with mad fervor.

All traces of Vitalis underneath were shredded and burned away as the Extremity Rune Scripture seemed to express how mighty it was as a concept, topaz colored flames blaring in all directions as the horrific scene of the massive Bastion of Vitalis the size of a Minor Haven fracturing could be seen next!

In the center of it all, the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity in charge of this Bastion roared out with all her might as around her body, dense Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures began to circulate.
Yet each one seemed to be getting ground down by the massive Scripture of ACHERON that continued to descend!

She seemed to be in an utterly precarious situation as her yells became ever radiant, her skin beginning to peel and turn into pure transparent white as before she could entirely carry out an extremely painful transformation on her end...
SHIING!
The sound of dense sword lights echoed out like trillions of birds as from all directions, tens of massive Swords of Vitalis struck down.

The last and mightiest sword came from below the shattered Bastion of Vitalis as inside of it, the figure of none other than Emperor Shao blazed with brilliance as he came from below, his hands wrapping protectively around the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity while his sword swung up- buzzing and causing waves of ruptured to spread as the Extremity Rune Scripture of ACHERON was finally pushed back, its illusory glow slowly fading and disappearing!
The scene was an ecstatic one as the wills watching were breathless.

Like a glorious emperor bathed in Vitalis, Emperor Shao supported the female Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity who had her will gaze around her in rage, seeing that on this Bastion of Vitalis, the scorched records of Hundreds of Extremities was the only thing that could be seen as the vast majority had died, only a dozen or so Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities still supporting themselves as half of their bodies were scorched and nearly burnt away!
As for Apex Aeonic Lifeforms? What remained of them wasn't even enough to make up dust.

The female Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity stemming from the Sima Clan breathed out with maddened wrath, gazing at the Vacuous Entity made of pure Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as she roared out while surging towards him, Emperor Shao shaking his head with a light sigh as his sword swung above to support!
This...was only a single scene out of this devastating war.

A scene that Noah took in and continued to gain knowledge of the power and expertise of Hyperversal Extremities- and truly powerful ones at that as even these beings that had come out...they weren't the major players!
Both sides seemed to be probing each other with devastating attacks every now and then.
The number of lives that would be lost was bound to be innumerable.
They would only add to those who had been ground down to nothingness under the eons of Extremity!
Hatred would breed hatred, and the war between Vitalis and Vacuous would rage on!
On such a battlefield, Noah's will took everything occurring as he marveled at the Infernal Boundary Layer displayed by a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.
Acheron.
This and more were waiting for him to grasp in this ongoing war that was bound to last a long time before it saw any victor.
As a participant, he would play this war to the utmost and use it to rise to a level of glory that could dominate this whole battlefield!
But for now, he had to move covertly.
And...he also had many parts of him that were moving.
His Reified Source of Quintessence was in the form of a Vacuous Apex Lifeform as he followed an Ark towards Legions of Vitalis Apex Lifeforms in front of a Bastion of Vitalis.
Uniquely, near this Bastion...a dense cluster of figures adorned in gold white masks could be seen, with even more arriving in large numbers!
In their lead, a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity could be seen as he had a white horn rising above his head.
Behind them, the above average auras of Tier 3, 2, and Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities blazed as even further behind them, exceptional Vitalis Apex Lifeforms could be seen.
It was a Legion of the Curagulus of Extremity that had appeared in this region, other Legions of this deep and hidden organization stretched out across other Bastions of Vitalis to provide support!

chapters.title: Chapter 2686 Infernal Brilliance! II
paragraphs: 2686 Infernal Brilliance! II
The forces of the Curagulus of Extremity!

In his identity as a Vacuous Apex Lifeform, Noah gazed towards them with great malice along with all the other Vacuous Apex Lifeforms, his eyes especially coming to lock onto a figure revealing a devilish aura while adorned in a light blue robe and the same white gold mask as all the others.

This being was surrounded not by other members of the Curagulus of Extremity, but a terrifying Haven Lich who pulsed with the aura of both life and death, and behind this Lich...there were seven titanic Champions of Thanatos that were modified from the Chthonian abominations!
The Haven Lich cackled gleefully at the aura of death in the surroundings as he turned towards the direction of the Ark where Noah's body was hidden as a Vacuous Apex Lifeforms.

The Haven Lich then bowed towards this direction as the Vacuous Apex Lifeforms in the Hyperversal Savior's Ark growled, taking such a motion as ridicule from this being and not knowing the Lich Ra'Zan was merely paying respects to his Master who was hidden among them!
[OOOH!]
The Vacuous Apex Lifeforms roared out as the domain released by the Ark extended far and wide, coming to cover even their enemies as they surged out.
Noah's wills released a great deal of power as from the forces of the Curagulus of Extremity, Alexander stared forth with a devilish smile and battle intent.

From the field of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, Aleksandr stared forth with a hellishly dazzling smile and a bellow, his First Vacuous Awakening pulsing in the surroundings as nearby Vacuous Apex Lifeforms followed his cry as they were heeding his command- the hierarchy of these Existences being that of following the strong as they would follow Aleksandr!
And so like a grand commander, Aleksandr pointed towards the forces of the Curagulus of Extremity as he sent Vacuous Apex Lifeforms towards Alexander.
They thought they were going to a great war...but it was just Noah sending them to the butcher- who just so turned out to be another part of him!
Noah nodded with a playful smile as another method to obtain loot was established, the Haven Lich roaring out and commanding the Champions of Thanatos as waves of obsidian green flames exploded out!

His tasks in this war were many, but each one was getting completed smoothly thus far as for now, he waited for the False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of DESPOILER to be completed as he would then fully begin hunting Hyperversal Extremities.

This process was arduous as he couldn't make many of them currently with his reserves of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, but he should only be able to increase his speed and output after all the boons of the Ash Tree II of Gradation finished and it reverted into a Sporos III of Extremity that he could then excessively pump all the new Loot into!
Step by step, Extremity came ever closer within his grasp.

And with a chilling light, his Reified Source of Quintessence turned away from the area ahead of him that had the Legion from the Curagulus of Extremity and gazed upon a Bastion of Vitalis shimmering with a purple light.
Here, a dense cluster of Avernus Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were clustered.
While gazing at them, Noah couldn't help but radiate genuine intent to kill as his War with the Avernus Clan was still far from over!
In the Nether Haven of Genesis.
Within the depths of the domains of the Sima Clan, at the peak of a milky white mountain floating alone above multiple Planes of Existence that pulsed with the Havenly Authority of Genesis.

On the peak of this Mountain that was known as the Seer's Abode, an old woman could be seen walking amidst a serene meadow that was filled with pure streams of Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Genesis.

Around her aged body, a sense of beauty and grace still remained as there were dense Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of GENESIS swirling with gratitude fervor among multiple other Crimson Rune Scriptures!
At this moment, this old woman was walking while playing with a crimson gold Singularity in her hand that held no other identity but a Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Source!
Behind this woman, the Extremity of Foundation walked a step behind with a somber expression as the Identity of this being was very important.
The Seer of Sima!
To be granted the distinction of being the Seer of an entire Clan, this was something that only a being with true power could afford!
And at this moment, the Seer of Sima spoke with a smile.

[It is an astonishing treasure that doesn't hold anything negative other than the fact your current Lineage will be overwritten and a new record will come into place. It is something that allows you to attain a Lineage similar to the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages of the Supernal Havens of Extremity, but this Blood Source...the purity you will gain is something that will be hard for others to attain in the Supernal Havens unless they pay a great deal. As for its boons...even this old lady is interested in them. At its current level, even I can benefit from it. You got this from...Noah Osmont, was it?]
Her aged figure turned towards Extremity of Foundation who replied succinctly.
[They're apparently being circulated by a force known as the Infernal Havenly Commerce for a set but manageable price in the Supernal Haven of Dissolution...]
[Oh?] The brows of the Seer of Sima rose as she nodded with a smile.

Then, she threw the Blood Source in her hand up and down while she walked, and on the third time she threw it up in the air, she didn't catch it with her hand as the Extremity of Foundation watched with astonishment the reality of the falling Blood Source fall into the mouth of the Seer of Sima!
[Mmm...sugary.]
Her nonchalant comments were even more astonishing as who was this being?
This was one of the few Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities of the Sima Clan, an existence of immense age and power!
She...had overwritten her bloodline just like this by swallowing the Blood Source?
BZZT!

A surge of profundity exploded from her as even in her laid back demeanor, she still showed surprise as a burst of information exploded in her mind along with the records of her Lineage being rewritten.
Feeling the trace amounts of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within this Lineage, the Seer of Sima gave a nod as her aura became even more profound!

[Definitely worth it for you and all the other kids. Procure as many as you can for the Sima Clan, with this and other tools, maybe at least half of the Sima Clan will survive the tumultuous times to come.]
Shocking words left her mouth as the Extremity of Foundation had his expression become extremely grim!
At least half of the Sima Clan would survive after utilizing this tool and many others? Just...what could be coming to cause something like this?!

While this question remained unanswered, the very real reality of the first Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity joining the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage played out as just what effect would it have on its Progenitor?

chapters.title: Chapter 2687 Second Awakening! I
paragraphs: 2687 Second Awakening! I
Like the Hyperversal Anomalous Virions he was using, Noah's will and lineage spread rampantly and with wild abandon.
What he was giving out was akin to the most pristine Havenly Blood Source Seas as the Lineage granted allowed one to seamlessly get ever closer to Extremity!

At the time that a fantastically powerful Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity decided to swallow one of his Blood Sources and take hold of his lineage, Noah was watching the effects of the Ash Tree II of Gradation finish as many astounding prompts already presented themselves before him.
[The 17th Havenly Boundary Layer of Oceanus has been attained!]
[The Sixth Aletheian Haven of Extremity has been completed!]
[The Seventh Aletheian Haven of Extremity has begun to be forged!]
His Origin now held layers of Seven Havens that looked like massive rings of an ever expanding tower of quintessence.

In addition to a sliver of Helios, his Sixth Aletheian Haven was mostly composed of Oceanus as his Seventh Aletheian Haven that just started out has this same cerulean Havenly Authority in its starting stages!
"Seven Aletheian Havens..."
His voice was deep as he spoke while gazing at the figure of Xiaomi who was still engrossed in the Records of Extremity of the Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity Noah had killed.
He then gazed at the Quintessential Extremity Loot in his hands as seas of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority continued to descend from above.
He was gazing at the Remnant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity!

[Remnant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity]: A Writ of Extremity is an undeniable authority. Through the Records of the True Death of a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity, their accomplishments and history were culminated into a type of treasure that actually stands opposite to the true meaning and pursuit of Extremity. Extremity is meant to be sought and achieved by one's very own existence, but this Loot is one of the 10 pieces required to forge a Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity that allows an existence- regardless of whether they truly stand and define the concept, to attain Extremity in it. A Golden Writ is only applicable for the lowest dredges of concepts to achieve Extremity- Planar Boundaries. Its Authority isn't able to elevate Innate or Consummate Boundaries to Extremity, much less the concepts held by the True Emperor of Quintessence. Its usage by you even with the collection of all Remnants would not be sufficient to take any of your prime concepts towards Extremity, even if you haphazardly manifest a Planar Boundaries. If you personally seek to achieve Extremity in this path, the only quintessential route is to attain 10 Remnant Crimson Absolute Hyperversal Writs of Extremity by decimating the records of 10 Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities. The decimation of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity and the procurement of their records would theoretically grant a Quintessential Zenith Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity, but...let's remain realistic here.
The description of the Remnant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity was an astonishing one as truly, it was a loot that granted Extremity!

So long as 10 Remnants were collected, a Planar Boundaries could be taken from the 17th Boundary Layer and elevated to Extremity! And yet, Noah was barred from it as collecting 10 Remnant Golden or even Obsidian Absolute Hyperversal Writs of Extremity by killing Tier 1 or Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities wouldn't do much for him!
His qualifications would only be met if he decimated the Records of a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.

And the details of this Loot towards the end caused his brows to rise as when it came to the quantification and display of data in the form of prompts and details of Loot or abilities, it was in part done by Noah's Infinite System and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as they collected and gained more information on the perceived reality- on Recorded History and Unrecorded History.

Noah's own abilities, the unique authority of his Eyes, his increased authority in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, and other factors contributed to just how much details he could pull from his surrounding reality- to the extent that the names, identities, and Stat Panels of weaker beings could be seen by his eyes!

With the advent of his Eyes of Extremity, he could even begin to see more details of a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity just by gazing at them as him being capable of seeing their Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures quantified for him what concepts they had, and which ones had achieved Extremity.

For progressively powerful beings, he could only see names of- being like this including Emperor Shao as when he reached a high enough level, Noah couldn't even discern his Extremity Rune Scriptures anymore.

So the details of the Writ of Extremity he held caused him to smack his lips by reminding him that decimating a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity was not at all something realistic, even with Noah's habit of breaking down walls of impossibilities!
But when he looked at all the information he knew about them and the terrifying level of power they held...he shook his head.
Before Extremity, such a thing was too much to even call a dream.
He had multiple possibilities to now look at as he took a moment to see which path lay with the most opportunity.

With the completed Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity, he could have someone among his Vassals attain Extremity- so long as he focused on directing a portion of the Aeonic Treasures of Extremity he was receiving through his Infernal Havenly Commerce to elevate their chosen Planar Boundaries to the 17th Layer.
This was a possible path.

He didn't need to waste the Writ on someone like Xiaomi as her Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos took care of her path to Extremity along with the tools Noah granted her- with her experiencing the ascension of a Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity at this very moment as they forged their first Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture!

And the details of this Loot towards the end caused his brows to rise as when it came to the quantification and display of data in the form of prompts and details of Loot or abilities, it was in part done by Noah's Infinite System and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as they collected and gained more information on the perceived reality- on Recorded History and Unrecorded History.

Noah's own abilities, the unique authority of his Eyes, his increased authority in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, and other factors contributed to just how much details he could pull from his surrounding reality- to the extent that the names, identities, and Stat Panels of weaker beings could be seen by his eyes!

With the advent of his Eyes of Extremity, he could even begin to see more details of a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity just by gazing at them as him being capable of seeing their Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures quantified for him what concepts they had, and which ones had achieved Extremity.

For progressively powerful beings, he could only see names of- being like this including Emperor Shao as when he reached a high enough level, Noah couldn't even discern his Extremity Rune Scriptures anymore.

So the details of the Writ of Extremity he held caused him to smack his lips by reminding him that decimating a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity was not at all something realistic, even with Noah's habit of breaking down walls of impossibilities!
But when he looked at all the information he knew about them and the terrifying level of power they held...he shook his head.
Before Extremity, such a thing was too much to even call a dream.
He had multiple possibilities to now look at as he took a moment to see which path lay with the most opportunity.

With the completed Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity, he could have someone among his Vassals attain Extremity- so long as he focused on directing a portion of the Aeonic Treasures of Extremity he was receiving through his Infernal Havenly Commerce to elevate their chosen Planar Boundaries to the 17th Layer.
This was a possible path.

He didn't need to waste the Writ on someone like Xiaomi as her Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos took care of her path to Extremity along with the tools Noah granted her- with her experiencing the ascension of a Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity at this very moment as they forged their first Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture!

chapters.title: Chapter 2688 Second Awakening! II
paragraphs: 2688 Second Awakening! II
Noah's eyes shone with utmost brightness as with a pondering gaze of the myriad paths to take, his will then turned inwards as he looked at his Innate Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians.
They pulsed and brimmed with roaring streams of these two authorities as they seemed ready to take the last step.

The feat of killing a Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity was stupendous enough to allow him to near the cusp of the Second Vitalis and Vacuous Awakening in addition to all the minute streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority he received from those joining his Lineage, but it still wasn't enough.
What he needed was something that could pierce a wall and take the last ste-
BOOOM!
His thoughts came to a halt.

Above him, a refulgence of glorious light exploded as his mind buzzed soon after, his very own Blood sending him information as at this moment, he realized that a terrifying existence had actually become part of his Lineage!
As the Progenitor, he had many tools to utilize under his belt- and gaining the basic information of those becoming part of his Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage was one of them.
And his eyes radiated magisterial splendor as the information of an existence with a unique distinction appeared in his mind!
The Seer of Sima!
An aged woman who had seen eons and lived an uncountable number of years, traversing across the Vitalis Annals of Extremity freely!
A Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.

As soon as such a being became a part of his lineage, extremely pure streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority broke from above like a dam and surged into him, his Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians vibrating and being forced to expand as this surge of authority acted like a needle that pierced a heavy wall!
BOOM!
Along with it...
[Your Aspects of Existence has reached a critical threshold of purity of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.]
[Your Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians have reached a sufficient level of size and magnitude.]
[Your Second Vitalis Awakening is beginning!]
The Second Vitalis Awakening!

The inclusion of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity into his Lineage was the last step it took to make it happen as the influx of pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority seethed and caused his body to brim with brilliance.

At the same time as this began, the potent Vacuous Hyperversal Authority within his existence also seethed as of sensing an imbalance, the calm flow of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority still steaming down from the ruptured records above due to Noah's achievement pulsing and releasing a tidal wave of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority unto him.
[Your Aspects of Existence has reached a critical threshold of purity of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.]
[Your Innate Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians have reached a sufficient level of size and magnitude.]
[Your Second Vacuous Awakening is beginning!]
Like dominoes falling.
After one came the other!
His body pulsed with utmost glory as in the surroundings, drums of Quintessential victory that had died down somewhat began to buzz again.
DUM! DUM! DUM!
From the skies, the rupture of records became even larger astendrils of pure Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority roared out like serpentine rivers that snaked their way into his body.
Before, he had seen snaking streams of Vitalis wrap around Emperor Shao as he breezed into his Second Vitalis Awakening.

Now, he had both Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority snaking towards him in vibrant tendrils of light as he seemed like a grandiose entity being forged by the flames of these ever clashing authorities existing for an untold period of time!
The transformation was bound to be a glorious one as-
HUUM!
Oraculum blared with golden grandeur.
And an instant later...
[Hello?]
A sonorous voice buzzed.
A voice that wasn't his or anyone he had come in contact with as he quickly ascertained this voice came...from his very Lineage!
The voice was feminine in nature and yet filled with age, and it seemed questioning as it didn't really know who it was talking to.
But Noah very quickly knew as shockingly, this voice stemmed from the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity that had just joined his Lineage- the Seer of Sima!
[Hello? Is anything cognizant behind this? Can you hear me? Which Primogenitor is in charge of this Lineage?]
Her voice echoed out again.

Her capabilities were so frightening as she was able to somehow send a message through the Lineage she had attained...towards its very top as she was probing the identity of the existence or construct at the very peak of this Lineage!
Yet Noah remained calm as he didn't follow the connection of his lineage to say anything back.

The safeguards he had placed with Oraculum in addition to his status as an Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable Existence and his masking capabilities with Obfuscation still allowed him to retain an impenetrable veil as this being could only even send messages towards the one standing at the very peak of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage due to her shocking power!
This was also his authority as a Progenitor of this Lineage!
She didn't know who was behind it, but she was capable enough to probe.
[Primogenitor Steel, is it you? Have you branched off to another path after Artificer to do this?]

Her voice continued to probe. It showed how Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities truly shouldn't be underestimated, and it also a testament to the power and authority of Noah's Lineage, its standing, and what his status as an Inscrutable Existence granted him.
This was something he theorized may be possible if sufficiently powerful Existences obtained his lineage, and the reality of it happening now and seeing its result left Noah satisfied!
Even Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities connected to him through his Lineage could not obtain information or see through him.
Even a terrifying Seer was only able to do what the Seer of Sima was doing now, which was already out of the realm of impossibility.
[Primogenitor Acacius, is it actually you? I've read the records that you were always interested in all things relating to Bloodlines...]
[Or is this just some blank will that can't even answer back?]
[Vitalis...is this another one of your doings? Do you actually have a will? Or are you the same cruel and non-caring construct I know of?]
The only issue was that her voice continued to come incessantly.
[Mmm...who could this be?]
As her voice continued to ring out, Noah shook his head and was returning to focus on his Awakenings when...
[Noah Osmont?]
BOOM!
Her voice was thundering as Noah's eyes squinted powerfully.
He remained unaffected as...
[Ara Ara, that can't be it. Primogenitor Cleisthenes, is it you?]
A guess.
She had uttered Noah's name as a guess, but it showed her terrifying intuition as Noah's sharp eyes called the Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum here!
Even if just out of an overabundance of caution, his veil has to be made ever thicker.
And this...was something that his Awakenings may even help with as they proceeded!

chapters.title: Chapter 2689 Second Awakening! III
paragraphs: 2689 Second Awakening! III
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, raging rivers of pure Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities roared down with fervor onto a single being.
His Innate Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians were being expanded and enlarged. The concentration of these two authorities inside of his body was also being increased!
Along with this, previous Authorities were elevated as new ones were granted!
All the while this was occurring...
[The False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of DESPOILER has been completed!]
A dazzling singularity with sublime strokes reading [DESPOILER] floated before Noah's figure surrounded by waves of authorities.
His first False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture was completed!
[An achievement worthy of being heralded across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!]
[Without attaining Extremity, you have forged a type of Extremity Rune Scripture, even if it is a false one.]
Yet another profound achievement was added to his roster as who could forge an Extremity Rune Scripture before they attained Extremity?
Around him, the rivers of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities turned even wilder as the ongoing Awakenings seemed that much more glorious and filled with ever-increasing radiance.
And at the same time, the tool that had given him access to a rapid progression of his Origin and Soul had transformed back into a seed that floated before him.
[The Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos III of Extremity has manifested and is ready to be cultivated to maturity.]
A seed that would take an even more obscene amount of Loot to cultivate to maturity appeared as Noah gazed at both it and the False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of DESPOILER.
Both were tools he planned to use heavily in the days to come as they would eventually bring him to Extremity!

As for the False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of DESPOILER, he planned to construct as many as he could in the next day before he unleashed them on multiple Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities affected by his Hyperversal Anomalous Virions.

Killing a single Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity was a grand achievement. Killing multiple of them at once...was even grander. And it prevented any possible countermeasures from being taken against Noah as the truly powerful Entities on the battlefield observe one Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity falling after another under the same circumstances.
His glorious path slowly had its steps laid out as his very existence continued its baptism of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities!
The only thing that interrupted this was a voice that continued to ring out across the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage that only he could hear.

[Whichever Primogenitor this is, I'll continue sending these communications until I receive a reply. I'll either anger you until I get to know who is behind all this, or you aren't even cognizant and may just be a blank construct. Either way, I have endless words and stories I can bombard you with...]
The voice of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity that was the Seer of Sima was relentless!

[All I've gazed upon are Records, so I can talk endlessly. Did you know of the Record of the Extremity of Reincarnation? That guy kept on killing himself in Unrecorded Histories thinking they were the currently playing out reality, thinking he gained an edge over all others with his information. Alas, Unrecorded Histories don't always play out as intended, and this guy died before achieving Tier 4. His path was a unique one though. Oh, and talking about paths, have you tried traversing any of the Dead Paths? Sure, we consider them dead ends, but can you imagine taking one to Extremity? Well...]

Her voice continued to resound without any apparent end as Noah had to turn her down to a small glimmer of a whisper, a majority of his will focusing on the changes in his Aspects of Existence and just where he would be after this point.

The Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum was floating opposite to Noah with its eyes closed as it perused the Aeonic Annals of Extremity- also preparing to begin exploring the Vacuous Annals of Extremity.

And besides Noah's figure, the clear eyes of Xiaomi opened at this time as a terrifying trace of epiphany blazed, her eyes moving from the Record of Extremity and towards the True Death Record of Diospia!
She had seen the record of this being forming his Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures.
She had seen him transform his soul and other aspects of Existence to a glorious height with these Scriptures!
Now...she wanted to see the end of these Scriptures.
To her, the end was much more profound than the beginning. She felt an inkling that after observing how this being died, she could coalesce everything and be able to have a clear path for Ruin!
Just....
BZZT!

She had to be capable of navigating the shocking amount of rivers of obsidian and transparent white lights that were dancing around Noah, where even being near him gave off an astounding sense of oppression as in the surroundings, a symphony carried by ancient rhythmic drums continued- as of it were welcoming the arrival of a grand existence!
[No luck?]
The Extremity of Foundation asked carefully as the Seer of Sima shook her head with a profound light.
Her aged figure pulsed with ingenuity as she spoke out commandingly.
[It's okay if we don't know who is ultimately behind it. Go to this Infernal Havenly Commerce and obtain as many as possible, other Clans and Inheritances are likely already on the move as well.]
The Sima Clan moved as it wasn't the only one.
Word of the Infernal Havenly Commerce spread. Word of the Blood Sources capable of re-writing one's lineage and granting stupendous boosts towards and past Extremity spread!

In the Nether Haven of Helios, the figure of Ayame stood before her grandfather as he pinched and played with one of the Blood Sources she had gotten from Noah, his visage surrounded by molten waves of heat and grandeur as this Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity swallowed the Blood Source soon after.
In the Nether Haven of Andromeda.

A purple Aurora of stellar light stretched out endlessly as millions of floating moons could be seen stretched out in a serene region covered by layers of Hyperversal Extremity Formations and Defensive Barriers.
This...was one of the core areas of the Havenly Moon Clan- one of the Seven Clans of the Nether Havens of Extremity!
