chapters.title: Chapter 2690 Second Awakening! IV
paragraphs: 2690 Second Awakening! IV
Many beings had begun to move to obtain what were known as Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Blood Sources, but none had moved to obtain as many as the Havenly Moon Clan!
The first set of beings to come across the Infernal Havenly Commerce were from this group.
And after their Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities saw the grandiose boons, they sent word to their entire Clan as Havenly Moon Vaults began to be emptied just to obtain these Blood Sources!

At this point in time, they had already obtained a million Blood Sources as this number would only increase, with the Seers of the Havenly Moon counting to analyze the Blood Sources before they were sent to their Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities.
And soon after...the Avernus Clan began to pick up on the appearance and gradual proliferation of the Blood Sources.
It wasn't yet known that this Clan was at odds with the Progenitor of the spreading lineage.
So when they got their hands on the Blood Sources...just what would this result in?
Only time would tell as in the Vitalis Havens of Extremity, reality continued to unfold.

More and more forces entered the Supernal Havens of Extremity as the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification was fully underway, those who were capable of gaining entry and beginning to accumulate Units of Havenly Aurora
Outside of these Havens, a blazing war had fully begun and picked up pace between Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Entities.
Many beings rose and fell, with others only beginning to enact their grand history!
And like so...the minutes turned into hours.
And the hours churned on as a day passed.
In the Nether Haven of Oceanus.

Out of all the Seven Havens, Oceanus was undoubtedly one filled with the most beauty and wonder as the cerulean glow of the endless and ever- pervasive bodies of water alone could astonish one for years.
It also contained the largest variations of races and existences as the Inheritances in this Haven were many!
Of course, the bases of the Seven Clans were also found across this Haven.
At this moment, towards the center of the Nether Haven of Oceanus.
In the Independent Oceanus Marketplace where a dense number of Inheritances and even the Seven Clans came to barter and trade.
High-rise underwater buildings rose in all directions as rainbow-colored ocean beasts swam freely, with a white blue skyscraper at the very center having the most activity.
At this moment, in front of the doors of this skyscraper that was known as the Oceanus Iridescent Auction House, there were multiple stalls set up for beings to buy and trade their wares.

One stall in particular though, had a flurry of activity and beings surging around it constantly as a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity adorned in a golden blue robe that had a crimson flaming infinity symbol in front of the chest had his head raised high while holding a Blood Source within his hands.

This was an employee of the Infernal Havenly Commerce who knew where to find the most customers, leaving the Nether Haven of Dissolution where a lot of the Extremities from his Extremity Cicada Inheritance had already set up shop in front of the Vein Rifts!
He came to Oceanus as here, he had already made thousands of trades as his commission would be high!
[Make way.]

At this moment, an authoritative voice echoed out as a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity Authority descended, the groups around the Employee of the Infernal Havenly Commerce showing displeased faces as they parted ways.

They were here to obtain the much acclaimed and needed Blood Sources that could change the fate, talent, and potential of an existence. In times of war, this was much needed! Yet this authoritative voice thundered out at this moment.

From behind, the figures of multiple Hyperversal Extremities from the Avernus Clan adorned in purple robes appeared, the one at the forefront waving his hands to cause dense clusters of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity to appear!
They had already collected information on the Blood Sources being sold here as the Tier 3 Avernus Extremity at the forefront spoke.
[As many Blood Sources as this can pay for.]
His words were short and to the point as the Employee of the Infernal Havenly Commerce smiled.

He sent his will to the stream of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority inside of him and communicated with it, a light of glorious Quintessence flashing as the clusters of treasures disappeared, and a crimson gold flash of light from the stream of Vitalis inside this being ejected out 100 radiant Blood Sources!
The eyes of the Avernus Extremities lit up, the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms behind them even more so as they had collected too much information about these Blood Sources!
All clans so far had gotten their hands on them as their effects were shocking.
They couldn't be left behind as these 100 were just a trial run, their storage relics still filled with many Treasures to exchange with.

The leading Avernus Extremity waved his hands to collect the 100 Blood Sources as without delay, he took one to swallow right away- garnering envious gazes from the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in the surroundings who couldn't even afford a single Blood Source!
Some Extremities from other Clans and Inheritances also looked on with shining eyes as they had seen this scene multiple times on the last day.

Some Extremities would radiate a shocking level of power after swallowing the Blood Sources, with there being a case where an Apex Aeonic Lifeform who had been stuck at the 17th Boundary Layer for the past hundreds of years actually making a breakthrough to attain Extremity on the spot!
What effect would the Blood Source have on a terrifying Tier 3 Avernus Extremity?

They watched as uniquely, the glaring crimson gold light of glory didn't shine from this Extremity, his gaze changing as in front of the eyes of all beings here, the Blood Source this Avernus Extremity just swallowed flashed out of his body as crimson gold illusory words flashed above it for all to see!

[For any Avernus Clan Members seeking the boons of the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Blood Source, an Oath of Extremity of them cutting off all ties to the Avernus Clan and barring their involvement in any of their Clan matters is required.]
A shocking message rose as all eyes in the surroundings gazed in astonishment!
At the same time, the faces of the Avernus Extremities turned extremely sour and ashen!
What the hell was this?
How had the Avernus Clan offended the terrifying power behind these Blood Sources for something as shocking as this to actually occur?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2691 Second Awakening! V
paragraphs: 2691 Second Awakening! V
A stunning revelation of reality!

The Avernus Clan members seemed to have a shocking history and an unfathomable enemy as when a Tier 3 Avernus Extremity tried to swallow a Blood Source, a terrifying message appeared before everyone's gaze.
His expression was bold as he bellowed out.
[Daring!]
WAA!
He took the Blood Source again as he flicked it towards a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity behind him, this being gazing at the source with a somber expression before he also swallowed it.
And a moment after...his expression became exceedingly sour as the Blood Source appeared outside of his body, flashing a similar message soon after!

[For any Avernus Clan Members seeking the boons of the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Blood Source, an Oath of Extremity of them cutting off all ties to the Avernus Clan and barring their involvement in any of their Clan matters is required.]

Immense silence descended in the surroundings as the forces of other Clans and Inheritances here looked on with astonished gazes, instantly beginning to transmit scenes of what was happening to their forces as this was the first time they came across this!
As far as they knew, nobody else from any inheritance or Clan had ever received such a treatment in front of the Blood Sources.
Now, the biggest question was...why was the Avernus Clan different? Just who did they offend to have the current reality playing out?!
[What is this? How come it is like this?]
The Tier 3 Avernus Extremity was enraged as he turned his might and pressure onto the Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity of the Extremity Cicada Inheritance.
The Employee of the Infernal Havenly Commerce who had sold him the Blood Sources!

Facing the pressure of an existence that had condensed Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures, the soul of this Infernal Havenly Employee couldn't help but tremble as he spoke while gritting his teeth.
[I am merely an Employee conducting business, I know not of any other matters!]
His eyes shone with unwillingness as he noted in his heart that Avernus Clan members would never again be his customers!

And yet the enraged figure of the Tier 3 Avernus Extremity still remained. But apart from releasing his terrifying pressure, no other action could be made in this Independent Oceanus Marketplace, much less before the steps of the Oceanus Iridescent Auction House.
The wills of multiple Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities had already begun to rouse because of this commotion!
Feeling despondent and stifled from the gazes of others, the Tier 3 Avernus Extremity waved his hands angrily as he and his group began to retreat.
And soon after, the surroundings buzzed as information rapidly began to circulate!
It of course circulated even faster with the force directly involved, all of that had occurred being sent to the higher echelons of the Avernus Clan as everything became known within seconds.
In the Nether Haven of Dissolution.

In a spatial pocket carved out by a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity, the astonishing scene of dozens of Extremities in seated positions with their faces constantly twisting in pain could be seen, with only a few having blank expressions filled with bloody murder!
Such Extremities included Ariana, Gayacus, and Extremity Blue.
Above these Extremities, a group of a few others floated behind a wondrous Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.
The Seer Amestris!
Beside her, an illusory mirror showed the grandiose and majestic visage of the Avernus Extremity Overlord who was gazing at the scene ahead with utmost calm.
[Someone is trying to destabilize our Avernus Clan from within. Have you come up with some possibilities?]
They received the news of the message of the Blood Sources all others were assimilating and receiving shocking boons, and yet this wasn't the case for the Avernus Clan members!
Naturally, this had to be by the hands of someone.
An enemy!
The Avernus Clan had made many enemies over the years.
They were at odds with the Reality Plucking Pavilion Inheritance, the Havenly Moon Clan, and other individual Extremities that they had conflicts with in the past.
More recently, they just added the Cult of Endless Shadows as another enemy!

The Seer Amestris was silent for the following seconds before she carefully opened her mouth, pure Authority continuing to leak from her and flow into the bodies of the Avernus Extremities fighting against an infection of their Existence.

[Four possibilities come to mind, but I've eliminated two of them due to the timing. If I add origination as well...then the possibility of the one who played a hand in this may be the same one that did this to a portion of your forces.]
WAA!
She pointed towards Extremity Blue and the others as the gaze of the Avernus Extremity Overlord flickered on the illusory screen while he spoke out questioningly!
[Noah Osmont?]
A daring possibility.
And yet Seer Amestris nodded while replying.

[I'm not entirely confident in this theory, but the Blood Sources that have been spreading recently are originating from the Supernal Havens of Extremity. They are a form of the Havenly Lineages similar to the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages. The last time I left Osmont, he had the backing of a Tier 4 Saurischian Titanosaurus as he revealed his Vitalis Awakening. He may have played a hand in influencing whatever force is producing these Blood Sources to blacklist the Avernus Clan.]
He may have utilized his influence to ask for the powerful force to do something like this!
Uniquely, the possibility that it was all him didn't cross their minds as such a thing was far too ridiculous and didn't have a whole lot of supporting facts.
Even their current theory was a speculation!
The Avernus Extremity Overlord simmered in authority and power as he listened, gazing at the states of his forces as his authoritative voice rang out.

[Verify this as soon as you can, pay a visit to this Infernal Havenly Commerce if you have to. As for this Osmont...to do this to Hyperversal Extremities, it is all the more reason for us to quickly erase this feud before it continues any further. But if he has joined the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage and is afforded their protection that scales up to Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities...
how should he be handled?]
A slippery enemy they hadn't been able to put down!
With the tight protection of their Lineages they had come to understand on the last day, killing him would be nearly an impossibility as they had to think of something else.

[A group of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities or a single Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity ignoring his supposed support from the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage should do it. But they will then be hunted down soon after in these Supernal Havens of Extremity...]
The authoritative voice of the Avernus Extremity Overlord continued to ring it as Seer Amestris squinted her eyes dangerously at this point.
A light of ingenuity burned in her eyes.
[I may have a more permanent solution for this. Someone who could disregard his layers of protection and still come out unscathed after killing him..]
Words with a level of certainty rose from her as even the Overlord's will beside her rose in a questioning tone!
Seer Amestris then spoke daringly as a cruel and fantastical light flashed across her eyes.
[He just recently advanced to become a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity who shows a tremendous level of power in the Bastions of Vitalis...and he still owes us a favor.]
BOOM

chapters.title: Chapter 2692 Second Awakening! VI
paragraphs: 2692 Second Awakening! VI
A shocking proposed path!
Utilizing a favor owed from a being when he used to be Tier 3, and now they had achieved a shocking level of power.
Seer Amestris had a profound look as she continued.

[Emperor Shao. We can use the last favor with him to ensure the complete eradication of the records of Noah Osmont while not earning the ire of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage ourselves. Even now, most forces haven't truly been able to quantify his power, but in the past day, he has held off five Tier 4 Vacuous Extremities by himself. Sufficient to say...a single anomaly that has yet to achieve Extremity, even one as abstruse as Osmont, should not be able to stand up to his might.]
The Avernus Extremity Overlord was quiet after this as he seemed to be contemplating.
The favor of a powerful Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity!

Should such a thing truly be used to completely wipe off the threat of a being that before they had even achieved Extremity, they held tools that could incapacitate Tiers 1 to 3 Hyperversal Extremities?
Silence continued to permeate.
The decision that would be made here was bound to be a critical one!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

The Havens being built and remodeled within this treasured land continued to increase as a shocking amount of authority was held by the Infinite Hyperversal Haven with the Natural Laws and Dectra reaching the 17th Boundary Layer.

The Natural Laws were more so inclined to be similar to Dead Paths than the Decreta that were a level below, but Noah had elevated all of them to such a high peak as a single jump into Extremity in one meant Extremity in all of them!
And now, there were even the Havenly Boundaries added into the mix.
At this moment, Noah's figure was standing at the edge of an expanding Aletheian Haven of Oceanus, with its borders connecting with Genesis and Helios so far as Dissolution was further from it.

The glow of a stellar cerulean grandeur could be felt all around Noah as at the very edge of this Haven, his feet dangled down as a shimmering cerulean waterfall of Oceanus cascaded down with serenity.
Yet around him, rivers of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities swam freely as every now and then, they would flash and buzz before they were separated by Noah's will!

Along with the rivers of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities, one could also see 210 dazzling False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER, half being made of Vitalis and half being born of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
All of these were accumulated over the last day as Noah was ready to make a grand move in the chaotic battlefield between Vacuous and Vitalis Domains!

Apart from this, a dazzling Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos III of Extremity floated while radiating multicolored brilliance, having been fed endless reserves of Loot that were multiplied by RUINATION over the last day.
Even though raising it was more arduous than the previous seeds, it was getting the inflow of 90% of the Loot from Noah's Infernal Havenly Commerce!
This...was loot gathered from many Inheritances and the Seven Clans, the number being utterly astounding, and even more so once it was multiplied by RUINATION.
Currently, its progression was an astonishing one after a day.
[Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos III of Extremity]... 53% Maturity...
Halfway there!
It was a pace other beings could only despair at as at this moment, Noah thought of the waves of information he had received based on the safeguards he had placed on the Blood Sources.
The scene that occurred in the Nether Haven of Oceanus that showed the rejection that the Avernus Extremities had received had played out as grandly as he expected!
His targets for the Blood Sources were all of the Seven Havens and the existences within it, and excluding Avernus Clan Members would not hurt him.
At the same time, he would achieve his purpose for this great enemy.
The first one was isolation.
Apart from all others, only the Avernus Clan would not be able to obtain a terrific tool that increased one's rate of progression towards and past Extremity!
While other Clans and Inheritances around them obtained the Blood Sources and became increasingly powerful, their forces would grow weaker.
The effect of this isolation and ostracization would only increase as more and more Blood Sources spread!
Gradually from this isolation...sources of chaos would continue to increase as Noah wouldn't have to do anything.

The members of the Avernus Clan would slowly renounce and cut off ties with it in order to be capable of accepting the Blood Sources, with Noah expecting Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to be the first as soon after...Avernus Extremities would follow as more stories and information spread about how much more powerful other Extremities were getting!
Then taking this action would then make them traitors as to propagate further chaos...the deserting Avernus Extremities would be hunted.
Conflict would continue to grow thereafter as Noah even planned to offer Blood Sources for free to Avernus Clan members in a day or two!
On the path of Extremity, everyone was out for themselves.

More and more of their Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and Extremities would be attracted to this irresistible allure as with this simple plan...Noah was going to fracture the massive and indomitable clan into pieces!
And he had gotten even more confident of this after the changes brought forth by the Second Vitalis and Vacuous Awakenings.
Inside of him, his Innate Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians were greatly expanded, their intricate systems now coursing with both authorities as if they were sharing rivers.
They cycled across Noah's existence as with each cycle, he felt himself brimming with ever more power as if his very existence was refined and baptized to become stronger each time!
The prompts of these Awakenings were stunning ones as even now, Noah could see them shimmering with brilliance in his logs.
[You have completed your Second Vitalis Awakening!]
[You have completed your Second Vacuous Awakening!]
[Your distinction as an Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable Existence has been elevated to Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable II Existence.]
[The discernment of your History, Realm, Authorities, Dynamis, or anything else about you is now veiled and masked even against Zenith Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities!]
[After obtaining more information, the Transformation into Vacuous Havenly I Entity has been renamed and elevated into Vacuous Infernal II Entity.]
[Transformation into the Vitalis Havenly I Entity is now possible!]

An array of prompts had come as amidst all of the critical and astounding ones, the ever constant surge and baptism of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities while paired up with the boons of the Ash Tree II of Gradation that had just finished a day ago made way to...
[Your soul has reached the Unscalable Wall of Extremity!]
A Quintessential reality!

The glow of a stellar cerulean grandeur could be felt all around Noah as at the very edge of this Haven, his feet dangled down as a shimmering cerulean waterfall of Oceanus cascaded down with serenity.
Yet around him, rivers of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities swam freely as every now and then, they would flash and buzz before they were separated by Noah's will!

Along with the rivers of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities, one could also see 210 dazzling False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER, half being made of Vitalis and half being born of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
All of these were accumulated over the last day as Noah was ready to make a grand move in the chaotic battlefield between Vacuous and Vitalis Domains!

Apart from this, a dazzling Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos III of Extremity floated while radiating multicolored brilliance, having been fed endless reserves of Loot that were multiplied by RUINATION over the last day.
Even though raising it was more arduous than the previous seeds, it was getting the inflow of 90% of the Loot from Noah's Infernal Havenly Commerce!
This...was loot gathered from many Inheritances and the Seven Clans, the number being utterly astounding, and even more so once it was multiplied by RUINATION.
Currently, its progression was an astonishing one after a day.
[Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos III of Extremity]...
53% Maturity...
Halfway there!
It was a pace other beings could only despair at as at this moment, Noah thought of the waves of information he had received based on the safeguards he had placed on the Blood Sources.
The scene that occurred in the Nether Haven of Oceanus that showed the rejection that the Avernus Extremities had received had played out as grandly as he expected!
His targets for the Blood Sources were all of the Seven Havens and the existences within it, and excluding Avernus Clan Members would not hurt him.
At the same time, he would achieve his purpose for this great enemy.
The first one was isolation.
Apart from all others, only the Avernus Clan would not be able to obtain a terrific tool that increased one's rate of progression towards and past Extremity!
While other Clans and Inheritances around them obtained the Blood Sources and became increasingly powerful, their forces would grow weaker.
The effect of this isolation and ostracization would only increase as more and more Blood Sources spread!
Gradually from this isolation...sources of chaos would continue to increase as Noah wouldn't have to do anything.

The members of the Avernus Clan would slowly renounce and cut off ties with it in order to be capable of accepting the Blood Sources, with Noah expecting Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to be the first as soon after...Avernus Extremities would follow as more stories and information spread about how much more powerful other Extremities were getting!
Then taking this action would then make them traitors as to propagate further chaos...the deserting Avernus Extremities would be hunted.
Conflict would continue to grow thereafter as Noah even planned to offer Blood Sources for free to Avernus Clan members in a day or two!
On the path of Extremity, everyone was out for themselves.

More and more of their Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and Extremities would be attracted to this irresistible allure as with this simple plan...Noah was going to fracture the massive and indomitable clan into pieces!
And he had gotten even more confident of this after the changes brought forth by the Second Vitalis and Vacuous Awakenings.
Inside of him, his Innate Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians were greatly expanded, their intricate systems now coursing with both authorities as if they were sharing rivers.
They cycled across Noah's existence as with each cycle, he felt himself brimming with ever more power as if his very existence was refined and baptized to become stronger each time!
The prompts of these Awakenings were stunning ones as even now, Noah could see them shimmering with brilliance in his logs.
[You have completed your Second Vitalis Awakening!]
[You have completed your Second Vacuous Awakening!]
[Your distinction as an Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable Existence has been elevated to Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable II Existence.]
[The discernment of your History, Realm, Authorities, Dynamis, or anything else about you is now veiled and masked even against Zenith Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities!]
[After obtaining more information, the Transformation into Vacuous Havenly I Entity has been renamed and elevated into Vacuous Infernal II Entity.]
[Transformation into the Vitalis Havenly I Entity is now possible!]

An array of prompts had come as amidst all of the critical and astounding ones, the ever constant surge and baptism of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities while paired up with the boons of the Ash Tree II of Gradation that had just finished a day ago made way to...
[Your soul has reached the Unscalable Wall of Extremity!]
A Quintessential reality!

chapters.title: Chapter 2693 The Way to Scale the Unscalable! I
paragraphs: 2693 The Way to Scale the Unscalable! I
The Unscalable Wall of Extremity.
He was approaching this terrifying wall before!
After the Ash Tree II of Gradation and his Second Vitalis and Vacuous Awakenings, he was now at the wall.
Breaking it meant gaining a type of Extremity Soul even before he achieved Extremity!
It was a monumental achievement, but as for whether one could achieve it...
the wording was in the name!
Unscalable.
One had to gain Extremity to achieve an Extremity Soul! Otherwise, it would only be a pipe dream for them.
[An Unstoppable Force is required to break through such a wall, where even the direct strengthening and baptism of your soul may not be enough.]
It was unknown whether the Ash Tree II of Extremity would be enough to break through this wall when a prompt like this came.
It was unknown whether another baptism of Vitalis and Vacuous would do the trick!
Noah had to do something explosive to break such a wall.
And when it came to what this could be...he smiled while gazing towards the far away figure of Xiaomi who was lost in cycles of epiphanies- intent on finding a path towards Extremity.
Noah gazed at her as for his answer on how to break the Unscalable Wall of Extremity...
"Is it finally time to undergo Apexification?"
Apexification!
A process his main body had never gone through as he still held Quintessential Hyperversal Meridian Seeds!

Yet his very existence was already touching upon multiple aspects of Extremity as he even wanted to use the force of Apexification to undergo a thorough transformation of his existence that would scale the Unscalable Wall of Extremity.
He knew that he had to prepare for it.
It couldn't be the process of Apexification alone as he had to pair it with one or two more unstoppable forces. And he already knew where to start!
As he thought of his current power that he held before even undergoing Apexification, he paused the perusing of the prompts that showed the boons of the Awakenings to view his stat panel.
[Name]:: Noah Osmont
[Realm]:: Seventh Aletheian Haven of Extremity(23% completed]
[Lineage]:: Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor

[Titles]:: True Emperor of Quintessence, Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor, One Who Gazes Upon Hyperversal Authority, Aletheian, Indefatigable, Tyrannical Emperor, The Tainted, Anomaly, Home of the Weald, Awakener, Inscrutable, Hyperversal Anomaly, 9th Infernal Lord, Havenly Progenitor, Extremity Despoiler, Gazer of the Unscalable Wall
[Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Value]:: Infinite
[Quintessential Hyperversal Vitality Value]:: 6,999,999
[Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Value]:: 9,999,999
[Quintessential Hyperversal Defense Value]:: 6,999,999
[Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Value]:: 9,999,999
[Hyperversal Dignity]:: 59
[Hyperversal Mastery]:: 59
[Absolute Hyperversal Authority Resistance]:: 51%
[Absolute Hyperversal Authority Penetration]:: 51%

[Dynamis of Extremity]:: Indefatigable(Quintessential Absolute II), Aletheian(Quintessential Absolute II), Vitalistic(Quintessential Absolute II), Oraculum(Quintessential Absolute II), Thanatos(Quintessential Absolute II), Lotra(Quintessential Absolute II)

[Boundaries of Extremity]:: Quintessence, Infinity, Dissolution, Helios, Genesis, Oceanus, Foundation, Blood, Manadynamics, Loot, Reality, Dimensions, Anima, Body, Origin, Soul, Genesis, Apocalypse, Prana, Dreams, Avalon...
A lot had changed in an extremely short period of time!

His Dynamis of Extremity now held an excess of 32 Boundaries in each of them as their authorities were greatly elevated, with grandiose changes taking place where in Dynamis like Aletheian, the Natural laws, Dectra, and the newly obtained Havenly Boundaries of Dissolution, Helios, Genesis, and Oceanus began to be incorporated into it.
The level of authority this Dynamis now bolstered was immense as it was his Aletheian Havens in his Origin that obtained the greatest boost.

Oraculum was another one of Noah's Dynamis that also now held the Havenly Boundaries of Dissolution, Helios, Genesis, and Oceanus into it- with the traversal of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity being all that easier when the Havenly Authorities that made up the very Havens that history was being Recorded on into the Dynamis!
When Noah looked at his status panel now and compared it to just days ago, the difference was so drastic that he seemed like a different being entirely!
What was an existence like Ahpuch who had 20,000 Values compared to his Soul Values which neared 10 Million?
What were other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms compared to him?!
They were mere ants who could now crumble from his gaze alone!
And yet...
'Be humble...be humble...' Noah smiled as he didn't let these inflated values get to his head.
His foundation below Extremity was unrivaled.
He could not truly be classified in any criterion as he exceeded some or was deficient in others!
He stood on his own stage and path as he would only forge forward without looking back.
And the tools he had on him would make all of this possible.
His eyes flashed as he returned to the logs of prompts that showed his continued growth after his Second Awakenings.
[Primitive Vitalis Manipulation has been elevated to Proficient Vitalis Manipulation.]

[The day you achieve Quintessential Vitalis Manipulation, your enemies will be forced to question their very own existence. It is unknown how many Awakenings or unique conditions have to be met in order to attain Quintessential Vitalis Manipulation.]
[Hyperversal I Assimilation has been elevated to Hyperversal II Assimilation.]
It was a collection of fantastical streams of information.
He was taken from Primitive to Proficient Vitalis Manipulation as a drop of knowledge told him that far down the line, he could even attain Quintessential Vitalis Manipulation!
And such a thing would be enough to just make his enemies give up.
Proficient Vitalis Manipulation. New Vitalis and Vacuous Entity Forms to adorn, and then the elevation of Inscrutable!
With the Inscrutable II Existence distinction, Noah was confident to do many things he knew he couldn't do before!

Before he called out the False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER for a hunt of Extremities that would grant him enough Loot to mature the current Sporos III of Extremity, he wanted to affirm the terror of his distinction as an Inscrutable II Existence.
He wanted to affirm the deadly things he could do with it!

chapters.title: Chapter 2694 The Way to Scale the Unscalable! II
paragraphs: 2694 The Way to Scale the Unscalable! II
The Hyperversal Anomalous Virion!

It was entirely made up of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that were separated by a myriad of Noah's authorities, with their core having an altered Blood Source born from Noah's very own Blood.
The storm of authorities occurring within Extremity Blue and the other Avernus Extremities...it was his altered Blood Source that attacked their records even now seeking to destroy them.
His Blood Source.
It carried his will as he could open his awareness to view things even from his enemies affected by his Hyperversal Anomalous Virions!
Before, he didn't even try as in front of the Seer of Avernus, many things could go wrong.

But now, he had attained the distinction of an Inscrutable II Existence. Even Zenith Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities could not glean anything about him as he could make his authorities seem like anything he wished!
So at this moment, he closed his eyes. He focused on the Hyperversal Anomalous Virions he had spread out.
There were millions of inactive ones in the gray region where Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities clashed. There were 99 active ones still raging within Vacuous Extremities!
Then, there were a few dozen active Virions in the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
His Authority focused on these as with a flash of light, the trace of his will within them woke up!
A reality soon painted itself before him.

From the body of Extremity Blue who floated in a seated position with a deadly expression, his will gazed around as he located all the other affected Avernus Extremities also in a seated position fighting with the storms in their bodies, with a pristine authority of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity washing down over their figures!
Yet this authority....didn't notice that the gaze of another being had woken up here!

Noah's will expanded its breadth as he followed the heavy authority upwards, and he wondrously saw the figure of Seer Amestris who floated with a sharp gaze of contemplation, with an illusory screen of light beside her showing the image of none other than the imposing Avernus Extremity Overlord.
Noah's will was gazing at all of them...and they didn't know!
Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable II Existence!
This was its sheer grandness as the amount of things Noah could do with it were limitless.
The authorities of two terrifying Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities were right before him along with dozens of other Extremities, and they had no idea!
And at this time, Noah's will perked up as he heard the calculative voice of Seer Amestris ring out.
[There are a few pathways we can utilize, but the one of Emperor Shao is the highest cost...but also the one with the most guaranteed rewards. I say use the favor for it.]
Emperor Shao? Favor?
With a gaze of interest, Noah's will came right in front of Seer Amestris and the illusory screen of the Avernus Extremity Overlord.

She wasn't currently veiled as her beauty could topple main realities and parallel realities, grace and majesty overflowing from her as she shone with a blinding light of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures.
After a few seconds, her words received a reply from the Avernus Extremity Overlord that caused Noah's will to turn utterly cold.
[Very well. Inform Emperor Shao of the last usage of the favors he owes us...
shall be the complete eradication of Noah Osmont.]
WAA!
Deadly words echoed out under Noah's watch as his gaze turned increasingly cold!

He saw the visage of Seer Amestris flicker as an Extremity Clone was soon formed, this clone disappearing soon after as the gaze of her main body then turned its entire attention towards the Avernus Extremities below them in this isolated domain who continued to battle the effects of the Virion.

[As for them, there are three methods I want to try to separate the Extremity Pathogen in them. All will require the brief separation of their souls from their Aspects of Existence as they may even enter a state of pseudo True Death. But if nothing is done, the souls of the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities will be worn down within a few days. After that...all of their Records will be affected and destroyed.]
She determined Noah's fate by directing a terrifying enemy towards him, and then she moved on like nothing to gaze at the Avernus Extremities below!
Noah's will become exceedingly cold.
Many thoughts and possibilities crossed his mind as he sought to create new paths with the new information he had obtained.
Currently, his most pressing goal was to scale the Unscalable Wall of Extremity as with Oraculum, he had theorized that his Apexification may be a strong enough trigger.

In addition to this, he wanted the baptism and transformation brought by the full maturity of the Sporos III of Extremity to occur at the same time, and he planned to make it so by utilizing the False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER and gaining Loot from Extremities in addition to the millions of Apex Vacuous Lifeforms he had spread it to with Hyperversal Savior's Arks!
Thereafter, he would feel ready.
And even though the information he had just obtained in front of the discussion of Seer Amestris and the Avernus Extremity Overlord was deadly, he wasn't scared of the one known as Emperor Shao!
He was a terrifying entity who stood above others, yes.
But...could he even find Noah?
So now...
'How about getting started with Avernus Extremities?'
His will radiated coldness.
He counted 34 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities among the Avernus Extremities affected by his Hyperversal Anomalous Virions.
He saw the Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures swirling around them as their gazes constantly changed from the explosion of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities within them!
Far, far from here- across Unrecorded and Recorded Histories, Noah's main will in his Main Body was roused as he floated up from the dazzling edge of Oceanus.
He saw the 210 False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER that floated in front of him as with a gaze of tyranny and power, he waved his hands to cause 34 of them to disappear!
"The first Extremity has fallen under my arms...let the rest of them begin to follow."
DUM!
A symphony of battle and majesty began.
Quintessence was roused as the Tyrannical Emperor made a move amidst schemes and power plays from many sides, his voice being one dripping with battle!

He made an attack from his base in a distant Recorded History within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, this attack occurring right under the nose of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity as this was what glorious a stage Noah had now reached!

chapters.title: Chapter 2695 The Way to Scale the Unscalable! III
paragraphs: 2695 The Way to Scale the Unscalable! III
With a resolute will that didn't even fear the eyes of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity, Noah made a move to decimate the Aspects of Existence of Avernus Extremities!
This was after a day of preparations, with the changes occurring on this day being too significant.
Some significant changes were even occurring at this very moment!
Within the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
Near the Golden Havenly Smilodon Archipelago.

A shimmering golden floating landmass that was now widely known as the Infernal Havenly Commerce Archipelago blazed with brilliance amidst the streams of Dissolution, the authority of dreams pulsing in its sandy structure as halcyon waterfalls of essence beautifully dripped all around it.

It was filled with bustling activities at this moment, as in its peripheries, groups of Hyperversal Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from different Inheritances and Clans could be seen, many of them marveling as they forged Absolute Dynamis of Extremity with a little effort and showed off the grand things they could do after they attained the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage!

Other beings were clustered and going into the center of the island where the Esteemed Entity trading everyone the Blood Sources could be found, a steady stream of beings from Inheritances and Clans seeking these shocking crimson gold singularities only increasing over the last day as the Tyrannical effects of the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage became more and more known.

Outside of this island, in the space that was halfway towards the Golden Havenly Smilodon Archipelago, the aura of a few Tier 3 and Tier 2 Smilodons, Titanoboas, and Dragonflies could be seen as they gazed at the far away golden island with scrutiny!
[Did you all find anything?]

A Havenly Smilodon Extremity spoke out calmly as they had gathered a lot of information about the Infernal Havenly Commerce over the past day, and they had even obtained a few hundred Blood Sources themselves to study.

[No. We've sent word to the nearby Obsidian Havenly Saurischian Archipelago, but these Blood Sources...the purity of a Bloodline they grant and the effects it has...they may meet or exceed what one gains when they've undergone a Crimson Bloodline Ablation...]
BOOM!
A Titanoboa pulsing with black tendrils of light spoke as his words caused an immense silence to descend!
None of them here had undergone a Crimson Bloodline Ablation.
Very few had even gained enough Units of Havenly Aurora to purchase the Obsidian Bloodline Ablation!
These Blood Sources...were even appetizing for them who held the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage!

[It is a type of a Havenly Lineage...just not one of the Four prominent ones. I'm not entirely sure how the higher ups will react to its spread- and it is spreading fast as some Apex Havenly Beasts have already fallen to the temptation and used the Blood Sources. Of course, their effects and true and tempt even someone like me.]
A serene Dragonfly spoke as an immense silence descended thereafter.
In the Supernal Havens of Extremity that was dominated by the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages, what effects and reactions would propagate from here on out?
It was a question that had to be asked as the more time that passed, the more that beings were convinced of the shocking majesty of this Lineage as even more forces rushed to obtain it!

Within the Supernal Havens of Extremity, the Infernal Havenly Commerce was gradually being considered one of the most renowned and easily accessible tools of this Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification due to how affordable its treasures were and what effects they brought.

And at this moment in time, something occurred that showed just how significant the spread of the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage was about to be as the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities of Clans and Inheritances passed their judgment and made commands to attain as many Blood Sources as possible.
And of course, the first ones to take a big step forward were none other than the Clan that had been the first to attain the Blood Sources.
Towards the depths of the Infernal Havenly Commerce Archipelago, a procession of powerful auras of Extremities adorned in silver blue robes etched with the ecriture of a crescent moon could be seen.

They were led by a terrifying Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity whose figure was veiled with cerulean cloth, her curves dangerous for others to even gaze at as nobody spared her any inappropriate glances with the shocking power she let off!
Behind her, Tier 3, 2, and 1 Hyperversal Extremities followed along with a hundred thousand Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
All of them emanated waves of power as among them, others emanated even grander waves of authority as they already held the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage!
The appearance of these beings caused the waves of people to scatter like sand as in a short moment, the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity of the Havenly Moon Clan appeared before Noah's figure.

This clone of his was draped in a golden emperor's robe as he seemed like an old man without a single strand of an aura, the gaze of the Tier 4 Extremity before him sharp as she only waved her hands to reveal the treasure she came to trade with.
And it was a maddening one as instantly, an aura of Pure Hyperversal Extremity spread out.
Extremely Pure!
And such purity could only come from...
[How many Blood Sources for this? It is a Half-Forged Armament of Extremity with the name of Andromeda Cleaver.]
WAA!
An Armament of Extremity!

A half-forged one, but it was an Armament of Extremity nonetheless as were it not contained in a glass circular casing filled with a silent aura of Extremity, its authority would have spread out to crush all beings who hadn't achieved Extremity here!
Silent alarms and shock spread out all around as Noah's eyes remained placid even though his mind was booming.
His Eyes of Extremity gazed ahead as he saw the glass circular casing pulsing with 9 Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures all around it that read [DIVIDER].
And contained in this glass casing, a purple scimitar with a carved and sharp end could be seen as it stopped halfway- its handle not yet being formed.
A Half-Forged Armament of Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2696 The Way to Scale the Unscalable! IV
paragraphs: 2696 The Way to Scale the Unscalable! IV
It was only a Half-Forged Armament of Extremity, but the aura it let off was palpating as for Noah, it meant many things.
But the major one...was that would he even be able to obtain it?!
As an existence who hadn't achieved Extremity, he could not directly grasp Extremity.
His job was made half easy since the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity was encased in a tool that contained its grandeur.
But even holding this tool required Hyperversal Extremity Authority!
His eyes turned sharp as many thoughts bloomed, and countless possibilities flashed before his eyes!
Without a delay, he waved his hand to cause a shockingly dense proliferation of tens of millions of Blood Source to bloom.
It was a scene that caused the breaths of many to be held still as their eyes flashed crimson gold with greed.
[50 Million Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Sources are sufficient to exchange for this little thing.]
WAA!
His words were astonishing to many as the sight of 50 Million Blood Sources caused many beings to feel their hearts racing.
This..wasn't this enough to take the whole Havenly Moon Clan, its Extremities, and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to attain this shocking lineage?
They could even begin to spread it to those who had yet to become Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, with their elevated lineage allowing them to very quickly ascend towards becoming Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
Undoubtedly, this would take the strength of the Havenly Moon Clan to a whole other level.

As for Noah casually releasing 50 Million Blood Sources...it was only a show of his preparation coming to fruition as over the past day, he had been rapidly producing more and more Blood Sources as the number he had in his reserves...was in the Billions.
After a momentary lapse of shock and wonder, Noah waved his hands forward as the millions of Blood Sources went towards the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.
And this being waves her fair hands as the encased Half-Forged Armament of Extremity floated towards Noah!
Her eyes were luminous as her actions today could also be a form of a test.

Many beings wanted to know more about this mysterious old man and many others like him from the Infernal Havenly Commerce as with the appearance of an Armament of Extremity, he would at least have to reveal some of his Extremity Authority!
So...what exactly would it be?
Noah's eyes were serene at the sight of a floating Half-Forged Armament of Extremity coming towards him.
Something that was so far out of his grasp just a day ago as he was dragged into the Vaults of a Clan and an Inheritance just to view and be near one.
And now, he was about to gain ownership of such a treasure as it also tested him!
And his will seething with Quintessence and tyranny did not delay as he moved.
So what if it was an Armament of Extremity?
So what if he couldn't touch it?!
BOOM!
His body exploded with glory as thick streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority surged from him, this scene causing the hearts of all Extremities to flutter in shock!
[Second Vitalis Awakening...Second Vitalis Awakening!]
A Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity couldn't help but shout out as they saw the pristine control of snakes of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that surged towards the cased Armament of Extremity.

And for those with more perceptive eyes, they saw that mixed within these streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, a dense number of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures swirled with glory.
Crimson Extremity Rune Scriptures!
The Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity of the Havenly Moon Clan breathed out a bated breath as she confirmed her test.
The Infernal Havenly Commerce was not to be underestimated!

Her eyes were fooled as she came to a shocking conclusion, but what she didn't know was that the dense Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures she could see the light of...were all False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER.
What she saw was merely what Noah wanted her to see!
What was the description of the distinction of the Inscrutable Existence?

It stated that [...No existences will be able to discern your Realm, Concepts, Layers, Dynamis, or anything else about you as even when you express a form of authority, you can choose how others perceive it, or you can express it as a formless authority that isn't visible to the naked eye...]
This was its description.

After gaining the False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER, Noah was capable of easily altering this type of Extremity Authority to be seen as Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures- even to the eyes of a Zenith Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity, much less this Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity before him!
Thereafter, his gaze focused on the Armament of Extremity before him.
His task was even easier as he didn't have to handle it personally, but just the Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of [DIVIDER] that surrounded the circular casing.
HUUM!

The glow of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority mixed with Noah's False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER wrapped around the glass casing as gloriously...he was able to move it towards him.
He wasn't coming in contact or moving the Armament of Extremity himself, but he simply moved two different authorities filled with his Will to carry the circular casing forward!
And since the authorities were filled with his Will, his eyes flashed with brilliance as a moment after...
WAP!
A glimmer of light flashed as the rivers of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority disappeared.

A monumental trade took place as on the other side, the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity attained 50 Million Blood Sources, her gaze filled with an unknown light as she gave a nod of respect towards Noah's figure, her hands fluttering commandingly as she and her forces instantly began to make their exit!
As for the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity that disappeared in the eyes of others? It would never be seen again!
Across the folds of space and time.

Layers of reality and dimensions pulsing like strings overlapped with each other as a circular casing carrying a Half-Forged Armament of Extremity was moved, layers of Oraculum wrapping around it as its destination was the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
Around it, Noah's will was utterly cold as he had gained a lot of understanding of Extremity already.
One crucial one was that Extremity Rune Scriptures could carry the will of the existence that forged them!

And so on the period of time as the circular cased Armament of Extremity fluttered across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, 9 of the False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER flashed as they targeted the 9 Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DIVIDER.
BOOM...CRACK!
And thundering explosive waves of authority echoed out as the first usage of Noah's DESPOILER Scriptures were actually not on any being.

And the instant the Rune Scriptures protecting the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity from leaking disappeared, a storm of this authority seethed and threatened to spill out as other False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER wrapped with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority still kept it somewhat contained.
It traversed across the Records of history until it arrived in the Record containing Noah's Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
A crack tore open in space above the Aletheian Havens being born of Dissolution, Helios, Genesis, And Oceanus.

There, a roaring boom echoed out as a purple scimitar appeared, Vitalis Hyperversal Authority scattering along with False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER as this Half-Forged Armament of Extremity exploded out with a storm of purple authority that emanated glorious waves of Pure Hyperversal Extremity!
Pure. Hyperversal. Extremity!
It was an opportunity Noah had only theorized that some Clans may give when he forged the Infernal Havenly Commerce.
He didn't know it would occur so soon. He didn't see it in the Unrecorded Histories he was perusing!
And yet here it was.
Another method for him to Scale the Unscalable Wall.
An opportunity for RUINATION.
An opportunity for his Vassals!
It was Noah and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven gaining their first Armament of Extremity...even though it wasn't fully forged!

chapters.title: Chapter 2697 The Way to Scale the Unscalable! V
paragraphs: 2697 The Way to Scale the Unscalable! V
A brilliant half-formed scimitar.

It radiated glorious purple waves of Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of ANDROMEDA as similar to the Hyperversal Bow of Helios, it was an Armament of Extremity that was being formed with a Havenly Authority at its basis!

It now sat atop the Aletheian Havens of other Havenly Authorities as the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority blared out like an unfolding sea, covering the nearby 1,000 light years in diameter before the surging tendrils of ANDROMEDA pulsed and maintained this stellar domain.
This was the Andromeda Cleaver!
And by obtaining it, Noah could possibly do a great deal of things as first and foremost...
[My people...]
HUM!
His voice roared out with majesty and grandeur as his main body appeared in the periphery of the Armament of Extremity.
His voice echoed out to all Apex Aeonic Lifeforms under his banner as through the purity of his Lineage, Henry was the first to arrive as he was soon followed up by Aurelia and Orion!
Barbatos, Guinevere, Kazuhiko, the Sword Emperor, and many others appeared soon after that as their numbers only kept increasing.

All of their main bodies were in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as only their Vitalistic Clones ventured into the Supernal Havens of Extremity, and they were currently stretched out across multiple Havenly Archipelagos as they lived and breathed in Challenger Arenas and collected Units of Havenly Aurora!

As soon as they neared the 10,000 threshold or exceeded it to the extent that even Extremities could begin paying attention, they transferred all the Units to Noah for safekeeping as he was acting like one of the Vaults of Extremity that the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages established.

These Units would then be utilized by them whenever they wished to purchase Havenly Treasures that met their needs, with his strongest Vassals being reborn through the baptism of battles and loot as they actually put their concepts of Extremity as their own!
And now, he called them here to grant them access to something he fought hard to get multiple times.

[A Half-Forged Armament of Extremity lies before you. The Andromeda Cleaver...if you can bear and absorb the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority it radiates, you will obtain the Havenly Boundary of Andromeda. If you are inches from it, you will achieve the 17th Layer. If you are able to wield it...
Extremity is yours...]
His voice was filled with Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as he spoke, his words causing clamor and shock to spread among his people- even those who thought they knew Noah better by now!
If one had to be an Extremity to wield it...then how did it get into their Infinite Hyperversal Haven?
Was Noah already....
Many gazed at his figure with astonished and questioning looks as in a corner, even the figure of the demoness Lilith could be seen observing with a difficult expression!
She seemed to bury many things in her heart at this moment as she was among the first to ask no questions.
She only walked forward.

Henry and the others were also at the forefront as with their Boundary Layers barely reaching the 13th or 14th as their highest, they came in contact with and tried to overcome the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of a Half-
Forged Armament of Extremity!
At the same as Noah released this opportunity to his Vassals, the area surrounding him flickered as the crimson gold humanoid figure of RUINATION appeared from the depths of his soul.
Her gaze was fixated on the Andromeda Cleaver as Noah's voice rang out lightly.
"Can you deconstruct it and at the very least duplicate it? Or can you only devour it to gain its status?"
His voice calmed and wasn't burning with authority as even after he asked...
Ruination remained quiet.
For the first time in many weeks and months, RUINATION didn't reply to Noah right away on whether she could do something or not!
She took her time as her eyes seemed to flash with glory and uncertainty at the very same time.
And soon after...
[I need to be close to be sure.]
Her words were resolute as he also began to walk into the 1,000 Light Year Domain!
At this moment, an Armament of Extremity was about to be put to full use by the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven- the one to make this happen being the Infernal Havenly Commerce.
Its source...one of the Seven Clans.
The Havenly Moon Clan had traded a Half-Forged Armament of Extremity for millions of Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Sources.

Such a reality and knowledge was spreading far and wide as it was easy to speculate...just what effect it would have on the current state of affairs of the Seven Clans? And what of the Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity?!
In the Nether Haven of Genesis.

The Seer of Sima was looking at a man shrouded in a billowing storm of golden white brilliance, his aura sharp and oppressive to all others as around him, tendrils of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority swan freely!
He was filled with power, and yet the Seer of Sima treated him normally as she spoke at this time.

[The Havenly Moon Clan has just used an Armament of Extremity to buy all of their most important forces the keys to unlock the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage. I've told you that if the Sima Clan is to survive with a decent number of us keeping our lives, something like this will be critical. I know you've had everyone collecting and filling up the Vaults of Sima all these years...it is time to empty them. If not an Armament of Extremity, then other oddities and rarities you haven't let go all these years..]
Her words were resolute.
The man billowing with white gold storms of brilliance was quiet before he gave a light nod a moment later!
This...was just the Sima Clan.

The other members of the Seven Clans reacted in varying manners after learning of the actions of the Havenly Moon Clan, but there were others with an even stronger reaction who held just as much power as the Seven Clans!
The most powerful Inheritance of Extremity!

A brilliant half-formed scimitar.

It radiated glorious purple waves of Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of ANDROMEDA as similar to the Hyperversal Bow of Helios, it was an Armament of Extremity that was being formed with a Havenly Authority at its basis!

It now sat atop the Aletheian Havens of other Havenly Authorities as the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority blared out like an unfolding sea, covering the nearby 1,000 light years in diameter before the surging tendrils of ANDROMEDA pulsed and maintained this stellar domain.
This was the Andromeda Cleaver!
And by obtaining it, Noah could possibly do a great deal of things as first and foremost...
[My people...]
HUM!

His voice echoed out to all Apex Aeonic Lifeforms under his banner as through the purity of his Lineage, Henry was the first to arrive as he was soon followed up by Aurelia and Orion!
Barbatos, Guinevere, Kazuhiko, the Sword Emperor, and many others appeared soon after that as their numbers only kept increasing.

All of their main bodies were in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as only their Vitalistic Clones ventured into the Supernal Havens of Extremity, and they were currently stretched out across multiple Havenly Archipelagos as they lived and breathed in Challenger Arenas and collected Units of Havenly Aurora!

As soon as they neared the 10,000 threshold or exceeded it to the extent that even Extremities could begin paying attention, they transferred all the Units to Noah for safekeeping as he was acting like one of the Vaults of Extremity that the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages established.

These Units would then be utilized by them whenever they wished to purchase Havenly Treasures that met their needs, with his strongest Vassals being reborn through the baptism of battles and loot as they actually put their concepts of Extremity as their own!
And now, he called them here to grant them access to something he fought hard to get multiple times.
[A Half-Forged Armament of Extremity lies before you.
The Andromeda Cleaver...if you can bear and absorb the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority it radiates, you will obtain the Havenly Boundary of Andromeda.
If you are inches from it, you will achieve the 17th Layer.
If you are able to wield it...
Extremity is yours...]
His voice was filled with Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as he spoke, his words causing clamor and shock to spread among his people- even those who thought they knew Noah better by now!

Was Noah already....
Many gazed at his figure with astonished and questioning looks as in a corner, even the figure of the demoness Lilith could be seen observing with a difficult expression!

Forged Armament of Extremity!
At the same as Noah released this opportunity to his Vassals, the area surrounding him flickered as the crimson gold humanoid figure of RUINATION appeared from the depths of his soul.
Her gaze was fixated on the Andromeda Cleaver as Noah's voice rang out lightly.
"Can you deconstruct it and at the very least duplicate it?
Or can you only devour it to gain its status?"
His voice calmed and wasn't burning with authority as even after he asked...
Ruination remained quiet.
For the first time in many weeks and months, RUINATION didn't reply to Noah right away on whether she could do something or not!
She took her time as her eyes seemed to flash with glory and uncertainty at the very same time.
And soon after...
[I need to be close to be sure.]
Her words were resolute as he also began to walk into the 1,000 Light Year Domain!
At this moment, an Armament of Extremity was about to be put to full use by the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven- the one to make this happen being the Infernal Havenly Commerce.

chapters.title: Chapter 2698 The Way to Scale the Unscalable! VI
paragraphs: 2698 The Way to Scale the Unscalable! VI
Around the same moment in time, within the Nether Haven of Helios.
In a plane of existence located amidst trillions of burning suns, within a domain termed the Royal Infinite Scorching Chambers.
The visage of Ayame floated in a unique domain with her eyes closed, multiple Hyperversal Extremity Authorities washing over her body on all sides as they seemed to be analyzing everything about her.
A crimson gold Aurora of lights covered this whole region as behind her floating figure, her grandfather could be seen.
And far ahead of them, 9 crimson gold flaming thrones radiating intense might and grander floated as they were the ones analyzing everything about Ayame after she had taken a Blood Source!
Thereafter, one of the 9 voices thundered out.
[This Havenly Lineage is one of the most conducive things to seek an Aspect of Infinity that I've ever come across. Hidden within it...I can even sense a thread of Infinity!]
WAA!
A thread of Infinity!
The voice that thundered out caused Ayame's grandfather to squint his eyes in shock as he asked in a low voice.
[This thread of Infinity...was successfully taken to Extremity? The one to enact this Lineage has actually made Infinity no longer be a Dead Path?!]
If an existence ever took a concept that was considered a Dead Path and elevated it to Extremity, its Hyperversal Extremity Authority would be born.

Thereafter, it was akin to a forefather taking the steps forward and giving a chance for those behind him to follow, with the chances of others opening up this dead path also increasing if they were given access to the pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of the Dead Path!
Infinity...was something that nobody in the Inheritance of the Infinite Extremity had achieved.
They only sought Aspects of Infinity in other concepts as a vast majority focused on Heat. Others called it Incandescence, or Calefaction. Others focused on entirely opposing concepts of Coldness!
But at the end of the day, they sought Infinity.

[No, it shouldn't have been taken to Extremity just yet. Otherwise, this Lineage would be something that may change the fate of our Nether Havens. But...we do need to obtain more of these Blood Sources, as well as any connections they hold. You said Ayame obtained these from a...Noah Osmont?]
Another authoritative voice thundered out as it clasped a Blood Source within their hands.
Ayame's grandfather nodded as a moment later, another voice echoed out from a far left throne.
[Invite this Noah Osmont over. In the meantime, the completed Hyperversal Bow of Helios does not yet have an owner...are any of you opposed to using this to obtain everything our Inheritance needs?]
Shocking words emanated out as from the surroundings...
[Nay.]
No opposition!
When asked if there was anyone opposed to utilizing the recently completed Hyperversal Bow of Helios, nobody denied such a thought as the motion was quickly passed!
[Very well, make the trade with the Infernal Havenly Commerce. Let us see if this is the key that shall finally let us grasp the ever distant Infinity...]

A breath of billowing heat from the speaking Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity boomed out as Ayame was finally awoken from her slumber, her will gazing around and not knowing just what monumental choices were made!
In the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
Towards the depths where one would find Supernal Vein Rifts leading to the other Supernal Havens of Extremity, within one of the largest Crimson Havenly Archipelagos.

Across its vastness and quintillions of Lifeforms moving about, towards the very center of this Archipelago- there was a Restricted Domain that only some of those with the purest Celestia Extremity Lineage could enter!

In one such restrictive domain, streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowed serenely as crystal white trees rose majestically, glistening white grass sewing in the wind as it surrounded a lake of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.

At the center of this lake, the figure of Emperor Shao's main body could be seen seated in a meditative position as in his hands...he grasped the tool that made it possible for him to attain his First and Second Vitalis Awakening successively.

His tan gold skin reflected its crystalline white luster as it was a smooth round crystalloid object the size of his fist, and yet its weight alone was hard for the past him who was at the Tier 3 Gradation of Extremity to even hold onto!

It was something that could only be forged by Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities with a strong inclination to Vitalis Hyperversal Authority- and those who also had a Billion Units of Havenly Aurora to buy a Modus Operandi that allowed one to refine Vitalis Hyperversal Authority and forge such a treasure!
It was known simply as...a Vitalis Planalith Krystallos.

A Havenly Extremity Treasure that contained within it the densest and most concentrated forms of pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority as even though it was the size of his fist, it contained inside of it enough Pure and dense Vitalis Hyperversal Authority to fill an entire plane of Existence!
Vitalis Planalith Krystallos!
A single one was equivalent to the baptisms of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority he had received for his grand achievements.
And he...had already devoured 10 Vitalis Planalith Krystallos that were refined by the very same being who threw him out of these lands long, long ago.

They were part of his inheritance that cost Billions of Units of Havenly Aurora as even among the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages, getting one's hands on any Vitalis Planalith Krystallos was nearly an impossibility.

Shao breathed out serenely as tendrils of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority burst around his body, continuing to slowly take in the essence of the Vitalis Planalith Krystallos in his hands when his gaze changed.
He waved his hands to pull out a communication medallion that showed the illusory visage of Seer Amestris rising up before him, her figure unveiled before his eyes as she even smiled!
[Emperor Shao, we are ready to redeem the last favor.]
WAA!
His dark hair shone with a glorious luster. His now golden-colored skin pulsed with incandescence as he spoke with sharp eyes.
[You know my methods. Send over all the information.]
All of the information.
The background, who it involved, their Recorded Histories, affiliations, recent events and conflicts- everything!
He always wanted a clear picture before he ever made a move as information was critical.
The medallion he held wavered and flashed with light as soon after, multiple Singularities containing information floated out as Shao's will permeated into them.
And soon after, his eyes flickered as his gaze changed.
The Singularities of information he had received all had a single being contained within them!
[Noah Osmont again?]
His voice was light as he turned to stare directly at the illusory figure of Seer Amestris.

The Seer didn't hide anything and let him know that by completing this favor, he would very likely be hunted by the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages- at the very least the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage!

[You realize that by forcing me to complete this favor, it will also make me your enemy? You are making me do something that a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity like yourself doesn't have the will to do, to make enemies of the forces of the Supernal Havens of Extremity.]
[I know.] Seer Amestris replied with a light nod as her smile faded ever so slowly.
[I know...and yet, it is better to earn your ire than keep this threat of Noah Osmont active. I hope you understand our position.]
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2699 {WEAK}! I
paragraphs: 2699 [WEAK]! I
It was better to earn the ire of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity than to keep alive the threat that was Noah Osmont!
Such a statement was a shocking testament to the might and mystery that Noah Osmont represented!
Emperor Shao's eyes shone with utmost sharpness as he gazed at the visage of Seer Amestris calmly.

He owed the Avernus Clan favors as he had received their help in gathering the rest of the materials to forge his Armament of Extremity that his Extremity Clone carried a version of while protecting the Bastions of Vitalis, among other rare treasures over the years.
After he gained a sufficient foothold, he stopped handing out favors as he knew one day, the cost of one may be exceedingly high!
And now, such a time had come.
With utmost serenity and power, he replied to the illusory figure before him.
[Then I will work to the best of my abilities to complete this favor. Since it is someone who stumped even you and your Overlord, I cannot provide any guarantees.]
Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities talked amongst each other as shockingly, they couldn't say with confidence that they would be able to kill a single being who had yet to even achieve Extremity!
Seer Amestris nodded after hearing this as her figure began to flicker.
[Then I wish you a good hunt.]
WAP!
Thereafter, the illusion entirely flickered and disappeared.
All that was left behind was Emperor Shao as his gaze remained one of placidity and grandeur, his voice echoing out to himself as he perused the many Records he just received.
"Noah Osmont...just what are you to warrant such an unfolding reality?"
An existence that hadn't even achieved Extremity, and yet his hidden attacks had incapacitated even up to Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities.

While viewing the records of this being in the Obsidian Havenly Saurischian Archipelago, and how he had remained utterly still while his capabilities affected Tier 3 to Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities, as well as the eruption of storms of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority in their bodies...
[Hmm?] Shao blinked a few times as he viewed this scene again.
The erupting storms of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
Didn't he see something similar to this early in the unfolding War occurring between Vitalis and Vacuous Legions right now?
His thought process quickly moved as he brought up the reality he viewed in the periphery of his will a day ago.
And there...he saw it once more.

He saw a whole Hyperversal Savior's Ark incapacitated as when he made his moves, one of the affected Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities had even perished under a storm of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities!
[He...is already active in this large-scale war? Fighting for Vitalis?]
Shao's eyes were deep as he affirmed his thoughts!
He also confirmed that this being- before he even became an Extremity, he had already grown capable of decimating those at this stage!
Shao knew his own history as he was never capable of killing a Hyperversal Extremity when he was an Apex Aeonic Lifeform.
Now, an entity who could do this and more had risen as...his path and destiny in all this was to do his best to destroy this being?
A being that had the potential to grow and be even more exceptional than him?
An existence who may have undergone their Second Vitalis Awakening. Their Second! This was what remained most unbelievable, because Shao knew the difficulty of achieving the Second Awakening.
Even though he had achieved it successively after the first Awakening, he relied on things all others didn't even know existed- the Vitalis Planalith Krystallos!
The Records Seer Amestris had given indicated for Shao to go to the Saurischian Archipelago to locate one of Noah's bodies and then use his means to scorch everything about him from existence.
But now that Shao affirmed this being was active in the war between Vitalis and Vacuous Legions, he could observe him and just what this being stood for on this battlefield!
[Noah Osmont...] Shao uttered out this name again as he wondered.
What was this being doing right now, and how should Shao exactly react to this favor?
Waves of silent tyranny simmered.

In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, there was now a domain of 1,000 Light Years of Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of ANDROMEDA, with many beings currently seeking to advance towards the tool radiating all this grandiose light!
After Noah's closest Vassals, hundreds of Enders of Extremity could be seen making their way into this domain as in the lead was none other than Hyperion!
His elephantine trunk blared out maddeningly while swallowing up the purple tendrils of Authority while he advanced forward slowly.

Among those who had made the greatest headway towards the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity, Henry was actually in the lead as an Entity next in line with the highest level of purity of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage.
After him, through sheer pride and glory...it was actually the Emperor Penguin!

Orion, Aurelia, Ophelia, and uniquely Lilith were somehow on the same page- the last mentioned being having come to a shocking resolution to change herself as she did not like sitting on the sidelines.
She was the Daughter of Hatred.
The Dimensional Deceiver!
Her loss had been mind-numbing and mind-shattering as she had lost her way briefly, but the actions of the being who came to dominate her showed her a path forward.
He didn't care about her.
After defeating her and dominating her, she felt fairly discarded!
It wasn't that he was just apathetic- but he simply surrounded himself with those who were useful. After her loss, had she been useful?

She knew this answer herself as since the Master of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven didn't care about old enemies like her joining his folds, she could still seek what her heart desired so long as it aligned with his goals.
And so...she took another step forward.
HUUM!
Bells resonated around her as she saw a prompt telling her she had attained the 9th Boundary Layer of Andromeda.
Her steps were light and firm.
She was the Defiler of Souls.
Her strongest point was her soul as her machinations had spread across Dimensions!
At this moment, her soul cried out and flourished as her obsession to reclaim her grand status but under the banner of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor was grander than anyone else!
