But now that Shao affirmed this being was active in the war between Vitalis and Vacuous Legions, he could observe him and just what this being stood for on this battlefield!
[Noah Osmont...] Shao uttered out this name again as he wondered.
What was this being doing right now, and how should Shao exactly react to this favor?
Waves of silent tyranny simmered.

In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, there was now a domain of 1,000 Light Years of Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of ANDROMEDA, with many beings currently seeking to advance towards the tool radiating all this grandiose light!
After Noah's closest Vassals, hundreds of Enders of Extremity could be seen making their way into this domain as in the lead was none other than Hyperion!
His elephantine trunk blared out maddeningly while swallowing up the purple tendrils of Authority while he advanced forward slowly.

Among those who had made the greatest headway towards the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity, Henry was actually in the lead as an Entity next in line with the highest level of purity of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage.
After him, through sheer pride and glory...it was actually the Emperor Penguin!

Orion, Aurelia, Ophelia, and uniquely Lilith were somehow on the same page- the last mentioned being having come to a shocking resolution to change herself as she did not like sitting on the sidelines.
She was the Daughter of Hatred.
The Dimensional Deceiver!
Her loss had been mind-numbing and mind-shattering as she had lost her way briefly, but the actions of the being who came to dominate her showed her a path forward.
He didn't care about her.
After defeating her and dominating her, she felt fairly discarded!
It wasn't that he was just apathetic- but he simply surrounded himself with those who were useful.
After her loss, had she been useful?

She knew this answer herself as since the Master of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven didn't care about old enemies like her joining his folds, she could still seek what her heart desired so long as it aligned with his goals.
And so...she took another step forward.
HUUM!
Bells resonated around her as she saw a prompt telling her she had attained the 9th Boundary Layer of Andromeda.
Her steps were light and firm.
She was the Defiler of Souls.
Her strongest point was her soul as her machinations had spread across Dimensions!
At this moment, her soul cried out and flourished as her obsession to reclaim her grand status but under the banner of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor was grander than anyone else!

chapters.title: Chapter 2700 {WEAK}! II
paragraphs: 2700 [WEAK]! II
The potential of all beings under the light-years long domain of Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority was unleashed.
Geniuses and those with unique Mutated Souls unveiled themselves- especially those who had their Aspects of Existence and Realms altered under Noah's hands!
Noah's main body viewed all of this calmly as even though beings like Henry and Lilith caught his eyes with their vibrantly shining wills, Noah's figure was already beside the Andromeda Cleaver.
[The 17th Havenly Boundary Layer of Andromeda has been attained!]
He was right in front of the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity as he couldn't grasp it with his hands.
So long as one didn't attain Extremity, they couldn't equip an Armament of Extremity!
'That is also a reality I want to shatter...'
His thoughts were wild and filled with tyranny as when he looked at the Andromeda Cleaver, his gaze towards it was a special one!
When he looked at this pristine treasure, his thought was a very simple one.
He was wrong.
He had underestimated the effects of his Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage by a small margin, even though he analyzed and theorized how stupendous the extent of its effects would be.
But he was still in his mindset where the boons of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage were things he could already do effortlessly!
He still held a semblance of bias.
He knew his lineage would be transformative for others, but he had underestimated just how much.

He now knew this because after the actions of the Havenly Moon Clan trading a Half-Forged Armament of Extremity for Blood Sources, the Unrecorded Histories that Oraculum was viewing were currently buzzing with craziness as from them, Noah saw possibilities of another Armament of Extremity...maybe even two!
This...was not something Noah would have expected just hours ago.
And yet so many things had changed now as he was more confident than ever in breaking the Unscalable Wall of Extremity!
Once he did this, he would possess Eyes of Extremity and a Soul of Extremity.
Would he still not be capable of even grasping an Armament of Extremity then?
Noah didn't know for sure as it seemed the utilization of Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures was absolute, but regardless- the possible unfolding reality was a grand one.
He had a lot of ideas and things he had done over the last months.
But the Blood Source and the Infernal Havenly Commerce? They were undoubtedly one of his most Quintessential ones as they were about to usher in shocking changes.
But like all changes that had occurred before, none of them would have come to fruition had it not been for himself...and for the choices he made.

At this moment, he proceeded with his preparations to scale an unscalable wall as the first step was something he had sent out some time ago- 34 False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER to be exact!
34 Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER for 34 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities.

They crossed space and time through his will and blood as at this moment, he initiated their advancement and eruption in the hidden spatial domain that contained the main body of Seer Amestris and the affected Avernus Extremities!

[With this, we've lost the support and gained the ire of a potentially Zenith Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity in exchange for the eradication of a unique threat. He won't do anything against us, but this whole ordeal has been a great blow to the Avernus Clan. And the effects are still in their infancy as we have yet to handle the issue of the Blood Sources that all clans and Inheritances are doing everything to obtain.]
The voice of Seer Amestris was calm as her eyes were glazed with a golden purple light- as if she were piercing into the very veil of the Vitalis Annals of Extremity!
She could see a great deal of chaos still on the way as-
BZZT!
Her gaze instantly changed as she looked below.
DUM!
A heavy and foreboding sound of drums calling for destruction and death could be heard echoing out.

She felt an eruption of a disturbance on the bodies of all Tier 1 Avernus Extremities below as their deep healing state of recovery was disturbed, with Seer Amestris seeing everything that occurred in slow motion as her authority surged towards those closest to her!

She saw the somewhat stable Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures on the bodies of these Extremities flicker, and then opportunistically- the Rune Scripture that was protecting an area of a churning storm of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities...it buzzed before it was his by something and shattered!
The moment this occurred, it was as if a balloon had been popped.
A sorrowing cry could be heard.

The storm of Vacuous and Vitalis exploded out at this gap along with the Records of the Avernus Extremity, a heavy and irreversible sense of instability caused as in other directions, the stable state of protection and homeostasis they had built was utterly destroyed as in succession, more of their Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures began to break down one after another, the deadly will Pathogenicity climbing across their Records gaining deeper and unchanging access!
This didn't occur with a single Tier 1 Avernus Extremity- but all 34 of them.
[HO!]
[NO!]
Seer Amestris' eyes flickered.

Booming shouts of shock and unwillingness exploded out as in rapid succession, all 34 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities were faced with perforations across their Aspects of Existence as their deepest Records were breached!
Deep within the Virion that affected them, the light of Quintessence and Lotra shone as their existence began to be broken down and turned into something else entirely.

Even when the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity Authority from Seer Amestris reached the Extremities closest to her...she could only wrap her Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures around them protectively as by this point...
BOOM!
It was too late.
Their records were heavily breached.
Their Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures lost their golden glow as Lotra rapidly wrapped around them.

When their very identity as an Extremity was breached and their Hyperversal Extremity Authority was broken down, they lost their sense of sense as everything around them was sucked into the core of their eroded records before it exploded out into a shower of stellar dust!
DUM!
A drum wrang out as if it foretold and ascertained the death of the first Tier I Avernus Extremity.
And in succession...
DUM! DUM! DUM!

Booming drums of valor and victory were disseminated one after another as the very Hyperversal Extremity Authority of 34 existences was broken down and devoured, with their bodies exploding into stellar dust right after.
It was a maddening scene that caused Seer Amestris' eyes to radiate a profound killing light!
It was a scene that caused the bodies of the Tier 2 and Tier 3 Avernus Extremities who were nearby to begin trembling!
Because the stellar dust of 34 Tier 1 Avernus Extremities moved as if it had a will- forming into shocking runic strokes that read out a single word.
The word caused booming anger to rise in the eyes of Seer Amestris while the figures of the remaining affected Avernus Extremities began to shake.
The stellar dust of the decimated Tier 1 Avernus Extremities read...
[WEAK]!

chapters.title: Chapter 2701 Unprecedented! A Tier 2 Falls! I
paragraphs: 2701 Unprecedented! A Tier 2 Falls! I
Weak!
This was what the remnants of stupendously powerful Hyperversal Extremities made up as their bodies were utterly eviscerated!
As the one behind it let them know in a taunting and shocking fashion with a single word.
The Seer of Avernus had gazed at this unfolding reality as her eyes burned with great anger.
While the remaining Tier 3 and Tier 2 Avernus Extremities had entirely different reactions.

When they saw their compatriots die to the storms of Vitalis and Vacuous Authorities, the same storms inside of them now felt all that much more menacing as at this moment, from the depths of their hearts..they began to feel an unfamiliar and extremely rare emotion.
They were Hyperversal Extremities.
They had taken concepts to their utmost extremes and because of this, they were awarded a stupendous form of power.
Due to such a power for a great deal of years, this emotion was not one that they were familiar with!
This emotion was something they rarely felt since they attained such a high level of authority...but on this day- they felt fear!

Because of their level of authority, they were able to deduce many, many things. They looked at how all of them were affected by the pathogenic authority over a day ago, and they looked at how now, all of the Tier 1 Avernus Extremities had simultaneously perished due to it.
It was instant and organized, with the will of their enemy acting at once.
Many of them theorized that their enemy had not been able to do exactly what he had just done now when he first affected them.
They theorized he could not kill the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities a day ago, and yet now, he had taken all of them out in an instant!
What if hours from now or days from now, he also did to the Tier 2 and Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities what he just did to their lower level compatriots?
Such a thought filled them with immense fear.
It was to the extent that a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity rose up with a face of desperation and floated below the feet of Seer Amestris, his voice coming out in a ragged tone
[Please, get it out. Whatever means you have to use...whatever dangers there are, please just get it out!]
He was a Hyperversal Extremity. And yet at this moment, none of that grandeur could be seen on his face.
He was the first one to show such desperation, but most of the other affected Avernus Extremities were feeling the same thing!

The Seer of Avernus watched the stellar remnant dust of their forces fade away along with the single word of [WEAK], and her eyes became decisive as her hand flashed out to grasp the head of the Tier 2 Extremity in front of her.
BOOM!
Her authority seethed out and barreled into the very existence of the being before her as she tested the methodology that she only theorized on this Extremity.

The problem they were affected with was one that allowed a Pathogenic Authority to enter their existence and permeate across their records. Every time they tried to purge it out, it spread elsewhere as they could only try their best to stop its spread while dealing with the storms of authorities inside of them.

So, all of those affected were put in a constant state of fighting off damaging storms and the action of stopping the spread of the Pathogenic Authority was barely achieved with the remaining Will that they had.
What Seer Amestris sought to do was actually very simplistic.
She's simply had to purge every part that was affected by this pathogenic will, including any records it may have already spread to!
Records...that may include the person's identity, their concepts, or even their very core!
It was basically what one would do if they were seeking to kill an Extremity. The process would literally be her killing a large part of this being in order to save him!
As for what effect it would have on the existence thereafter?
This was the part that they would have to see.
HUM!

Her authority surged like a tide as it instantly enveloped and blanketed every single record of the Extremity that had the Pathogenic Authority attaching to, and at the same time, she isolated the various parts of his existence that already had storms of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities.
Her power wrapped around everything in an intricate manner as with the low shout...
A glorious purple light flashed.

The fantastical power of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity showed itself as in an instant, 60% of the body of the Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity before her was sectioned off into multiple pieces and thrown off meters away!
The sectioned-off parts exploded in a storm of Vacuous and Vitalis Authorities as soon after, an immense silence descended.

The Seer of Avernus looked at what remained of the Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity, her authority filling the carved out and sectioned parts of this being as she sought to heal his soul and stabilize his nearly erased records.
In exchange for entirely removing the pathogenic will that had spread into this being, she had to erase over 60 percent of the Extremity Rune Scriptures that made him!
Over half of his Boundaries and Dynamis of Extremity.
Over millions of years worth of memories, and even portions of his identity!
After it was done and her Authority stabilized his soul, her voice rang out with caution.
[Andros.]
She called out the name of the Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity, and this being...
did not even raise their head.
They stared forward blankly as their eyes were blinking constantly, almost as if they were questioning and wondering who he was and what they were doing!
[Andros!]
The Seer of Avernus called out again as this being finally turned to gaze at her with her outburst of authority, but his eyes were blank and without much luminescence.
At this moment, everyone in the surroundings could feel the authority of this being regress from Tier 2 and head to Tier 1!

chapters.title: Chapter 2702 Unprecedented! A Tier 2 Falls! II
paragraphs: 2702 Unprecedented! A Tier 2 Falls! II
A regression from Tier 2 and into a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity!

At this moment in time whether it was because he had lost so much of himself, or whether the process was just that excruciating- this formally powerful Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity actually remained mute and only stared forward as if he were maimed.
And he may forever remain this way.
The scene was a dreadful one to see as it made the Tier 3 and the Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities affected by the pathogenic will howl out in indignation and unwillingness!
Extremity Ariana bellowed out with utmost rage while on the side, the figure of Extremity Blue actually held the most calm out of all affected Extremities here.
She floated with majesty and contained anger as she gazed at the actions of the Seer of Avernus, as well as what the results were.
Her eyes burned with such measured calm and wrath that one would almost think she wasn't among those affected. As if she didn't have a raging storm inside of her right now!
But at this moment, her eyes shone with a radiant glow of blue.
It was the cerulean light of Lunacy.
When a lot of beings faced unprecedented peril, they likely fell under the pressure with their mind and defenses, breaking down until ultimately- whatever they faced devoured them to oblivion.

But there were a select few beings who refused to be ground down by a danger that would have been granted to them True Death, their wills denying such a reality as if strong enough, they could bring about an unexpected result!
At this moment, after watching the actions of Seer Amestris, Extremity Blue came to a shocking decision.
Her soul and will turned inwards as she gazed at all the parts of her that the pathogenic authority had spread into as an instant later...
BZZT!
The remnant parts of her unaffected authority moved with shocking brilliance.
In her body, there were a few Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures that were radiating the blue light of Lunacy!
At this moment, they all moved under her command as they began cleaving over 50 percent of her very Recorded Existence!
Over 50% of her concepts, of her boundaries, of her Dynamis!
She cleaved out everything affected with decisiveness and fervor as she let it all go.

She carved out multiple Obsidian Extremity Rune Scriptures that made up more than 9 concepts she had taken to Extremity and 11 Golden Extremity Rune Scriptures that represented even more concepts that she brought to extremity. All of their records were tainted by the pathogenic authority as she cleaved it all out and spat it on the space before her.
Her mind and soul buzzed at such an action as at this moment, she felt incomplete.
The concepts of extremity in her body that were sectioned into multiple pieces seemed ready to break down and destroy her completely!
And at such a juncture, the Crimson Extremity Rune Scriptures of Lunacy moved as they intentionally destroyed what remained of every single other concept in her body!

Every other concept that she brought to extremity and whatever remained of it as the light of Lunacy didn't just destroy...but it devoured over 20 concepts, or what remained of them, that Extremity Blue had brought to Extremity!
She devoured the Dynamis she had forged, her foundation, Meridians...even memories of her past self.
She truly and completely let Lunacy run rampant and devour every other part of her that was fractured and threatening to break down.
It was such a shocking action that the Seer of Avernus gazed in her direction in a stupor.
Because as the light of Lunacy devoured and devoured, the power of Extremity Blue actually began to grow.
The action she took to solve the unprecedented peril she was in supremely agreed with the concept of Lunacy as a shocking effect was brought to fruition.
The few Crimson Extremity Rune Scriptures of Lunacy that she had pulsed while radiating a powerful light- rapidly beginning to proliferate and increase in number!
And a blinding crimson radiance that only a few existences could see erupted around her as the pristine light of Lunacy was being elevated!
KA!
KA!

Howling cries of madness could be heard resounding in the surroundings as even the Aeonic Annals of Extremity reacted in a shocking turn of events, dozens of Crimson Extremity Rune Scriptures blooming around Extremity Blue's destroyed body.

It blazed like an ever-incandescent blue sun as it sought to grasp a realm above it, and it almost seemed to have taken all the steps there as it was on the precipice of Tier 4!
On the Precipice!
But even with this grand change, it only blazed brightly and stopped there as it couldn't fully step into this glorious stage.
It was only half a step into the Fourth Gradation of Extremity.
[OOOH!]
But even this was enough as Extremity Blue bellowed out her anger and desperation, the bid she had taken working in the end as at this moment, her figure could be seen.

A blue dress of pure Lunacy formed around her as her snow-white hair carried tendrils of blue. A deep and exotic sense of wildness emanated from her deeply blue eyes that radiated utmost contained rage, these eyes visibly burning with flames as her figure began to move while she cried out with valor!
[Noah! Fucking! Osmont!]
BOOM!

With a blinding flash of light, she broke the barrier of the isolated domain Seer Amestris had enacted, her figure moving like a shooting star as she weaved across space in the Supernal Haven of Dissolution- her destination set as she fearlessly surged towards the Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago.

BOOM!

Inside the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, near the Andromeda Cleaver.

chapters.title: Chapter 2703 Unprecedented! A Tier 2 Falls! III
paragraphs: 2703 Unprecedented! A Tier 2 Falls! III
The Records of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity split open!
Such an action was a rarity as even the opening of the Records was astonishing in itself- and it was mainly to show the grandeur of unprecedented records!
It was as if recording down a new history was enriching and worthy of recognition for the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.

Depending on the feat, any myriad of unknown honorariums could come out as when it came to this subject, very few beings could say they were knowledgeable on all the things that astonishing existences were granted over the eons.

A strengthening and elevation of a concept, soul, body, or origin, or the granting of a certain authority, or a baptism of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority were some ofthe most commonly known honorariums among those in the Vitalis Havens of Extremity.

Now, there was another type of honorarium that could be added to the list as above the purple domain of the Havenly Authority of Andromeda, a rift of records bloomed as from it...descended a dim white gold scroll!
Noah blinked while gazing at this with doubt as if it wasn't Vitalis or Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities...it should be something much grander, right?
So what exactly was this?
HUUM!
at its appearance though, the surrounding realities instantly calmed and became docile- including the Havenly Authority of Andromeda in the surroundings!
The wild tendrils of Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Andromeda actually became exceedingly still as if they held a sense of reverence or fear towards this Scroll.
Accompanying its eerie descent, its prompts exploded with fanfare.
[A Quintessential Achievement!]
[You are the first in Recorded History to decimate the Records of a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity and grant them True Death before attaining Extremity!]
[An Unprecedented Feat!]
[You are the First in the Recorded History of the Vitalis Annals of Extremity to grant True Death to a large number of Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities before attaining Extremity!]
[You are the Second in the Recorded History of the Vacuous Annals of Extremity to grant True Death to a large number of Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities before attaining Extremity!]
[The Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art has been attained!]
The achievements were grand.

Noah gazed at them with shining eyes as he was the first in Recorded History to kill a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity, but what was more shocking was that when it came to killing over 34 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities...he wasn't the first one to do so in the Vacuous Annals of Extremity!
The records he had access to had been greatly expanded as with this, the number of information and existences Noah could be compared to had grown.

It seemed there was a terrifying existence in the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains as the feats of killing an Extremity before they became one themselves...they repeated it a large number of times with great success!
But...just how many did they kill, and what number would Noah have to reach to attain an unblemished record in this honorarium as well?
It was a question he didn't have the answer to, but his eyes kept on being locked to the white gold scroll of magisterial light that caused all authorities to be reined in and turned docile.
It descended until it was inches before Noah's eyes, and with it being so close- even his main body buzzed as the authorities within him reacted in a unique manner!
His hand reached out towards this dazzling scroll as it radiated a light that branded itself into him, waves of information exploding into his mind!

[[The Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art]:: A Modus Operandi meant for existences that have attained Hyperversal Extremity Authority of the Middle Grade Gradation of Extremity at the very least, with versions and variations of it found in the Havenly Archipelagos of the Supernal Havens of Extremity for those capable of obtaining them. This particular Modus Operandi has been modified to fit the needs and means of the existence worthy of a Quintessential Honorarium. Its purpose is to process, refine, and purify all forms of authority by compressing them into a Planalith Krystallos- a type of singularity that is outwardly as small as 5 inches, but inwardly as vast as billions of Light Years. The pure authorities found in nature are raw, unrefined, and not nearly as compatible for the absorption and assimilation into existences. The Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos makes it capable of refining any authority into a singular refined core that will express the most profound effect upon consumption. Normally, Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures are required for the art of refining any Authority into a Planalith Krystallos as it is a field where Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities are able to navigate in, with the Planalith Krystallos mainly being refined authorities at the realm of Hyperversal Extremities...]

[...For the True Emperor of Quintessence, this Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art allows you to utilize Units of Vitalis or Vacuous Hyperversal Authority to a limited extent in the refinement of other authorities. The uses of refined authorities packed into Planalith Krystallos can go as far as aiding one to traverse the Awakenings of Hyperversal Existential Authorities, the traversal of the Gradations of Extremity, or even the endless search of what may lie beyond Extremity. With this Golden Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities cannot yet be refined by you unless you attain Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures. The cost of utilizing this Modus Operandi is high as it is questionable whether you can even successfully complete a single refinement of an authority...
A shocking piece of work that Noah had to read multiple times over to make sure he didn't miss anything...and that he gauged this Art before him accurately with just what it could do!

The biggest clue to its majesty was the fact that existences at Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity were the ones who could even begin to utilize this fantastical Modus Operandi, with versions of it even being accessible in the Supernal Havens of Extremity.

Since Noah had not seen anything like this in the Saurischian Archipelago he was currently moving in while talking to the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity that reigned his authority over this Archipelago, he could only assume that it was something to be found in the Crimson Havenly Archipelagos towards the depths of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution!

chapters.title: Chapter 2704 Unprecedented! A Tier 2 Falls! IV
paragraphs: 2704 Unprecedented! A Tier 2 Falls! IV
What was most astonishing about the Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art was just what their products could do.
Traverse the Gradations of Extremity...and even through the Awakenings!
Because how frequently could an existence perform one astonishing feat after another to gain baptisms of Vitalis or Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities?

For the masses, they had to rely on other things as if there were truly powerful Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities in the Seven Aeonic Havens...then they were likely utilizing some form of a Modus Operandi like this to refine Vitalis Planalith Krystallos and utilize them to go through Awakenings.
Of course, this was something that even Noah couldn't do right now.
He couldn't refine Vitalis or Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities as he could only use them to refine other authorities currently.
But since the purpose of the refined products of this Modus Operandi were to aid existences that had already achieved Extremity...what results would Noah gain when he refined other authorities?
What if he refined Quintessence? Or Manadynamics? Or Loot? Or the Havenly Boundaries?
Could he even refine the authorities of Dynamis of Extremity? And what would they even grant?
The questions and possibilities buzzing in his mind were many as he paid attention to the last sentence of the description of the Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art.
The cost of such an art was so high that his reserves of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities may not even be able to bear it.
For this, it only caused Noah's competitive and tyrannical will to rouse as his body began to buzz.
So what if it was a Modus Operandi that Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities may have the power to utilize?
What if it was something for those already on the Gradations of Extremity?!
Since he had obtained it, he would make it work for him as it was only a matter of time before he figured out its intricacies...and just what shocking effects they would bring.
In his blazing thoughts of majesty, other prompts began to descend as Lotra and Quintessence hauled in bountiful loot from the Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities and 34 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity
[1x Remnant Obsidian Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity has been attained.]
[1x Tier 2 Singularity Crystal of the Record of Extremity has been attained!]
[1x Tier 2 Singularity Crystal of the True Death Record of Radon has been attained.]
[34x Singularity Crystal of the Records of Extremity have been attained!]
[The Singularity Crystal of the True Death Record of Babit has been attained.]
[The Singularity Crystal of the True Death Record of Kyle has been attained.]
[The Singularity Crystal of the True Death Record of Emily has been....]
[34x Remnant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writs of Extremity have been attained.]

An unprecedented influx of loot came as the death of a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity granted many things, but the sheer numerical advantage of killing 34 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities granted even more!

It was so much so that out of the descending Remnant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writs of Extremity, three pairs of sets of 10 began to blaze with golden radiance as they were pulled towards each other.
[The Remnant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writs of Extremity are merging to form a single full Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity.]
Noah's eyes were bright as he looked at 10 pages of dazzling light coming together to form a single glorious Writ of Extremity!
A Writ that could be granted to an existence to bring a Planar Boundary to Extremity.
He was about to gain three of them as he already had Oraculum illuminate the path forward on how he could best use these!

The single attack against the Avernus Extremities had brought in so many things that Noah had to digest, with him moving his time table on Apexification forward even more as with the Loot he just gained, he would be able to feed the Sporos III of Extremity with abundance and bring forward the next Ash Tree of Gradation.
When this and other factors were met, Apexification would proceed as he would break down an Unscalable Wall of Extremity!
But between this...the effects of his actions with the Avernus Extremities continued to propagate.

This was because at the same time that Noah came across his ecstatic loot and recognition, another being who had also caused the Aeonic Annals of Extremity to ring out praise had arrived light years near the grand image of the Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago!
It was none other than Extremity Blue as the actions she had taken had granted her a terrifying opportunity, and at the same time, a sense of danger.
This was because she literally devoured and assimilated everything into Lunacy.
Before, she had other concepts tying her down as they kept her grounded and somewhat stable.
But she took them all away as what was left behind...was only Lunacy!
And she truly followed this concept to the Extreme as no sane being would choose to do what she was doing right now.
Yet in a state of magisterial Lunacy, none of this nattered.
The only thing in her eyes...
[Noah! Fucking! Osmont!]
It remained Noah.
His actions blinded her as rage spilled out along with Hyperversal Extremity Authority that was right on the precipice of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.

She scanned the whole Archipelago light years away of all of its beings in a matter of seconds, she located Noah's figure that was walking with the only Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity on this Obsidian Havenly Saurischian Archipelago.

Her eyes burned with a fierce light of Blue as even though she saw such a being beside him...even though her might as an Extremity should have been able to tell her many things...she gritted her teeth as the light of Lunacy flashed.

In her very being, Lunacy took the lead as Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of LUNACY churned and cycled across her existence, her hand striking out as above the Obsidian Havenly Saurischian Archipelago, a massive glow of blue flourished as a light years long Extremity Rune Scripture that read [LUNACY] bloomed and descended!
Rationality would not win over Lunacy.
She followed what comprised most of her Existence currently as she attacked her obsession freely, not caring about any consequences that would come after that!

[The Remnant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writs of Extremity are merging to form a single full Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity.]
Noah's eyes were bright as he looked at 10 pages of dazzling light coming together to form a single glorious Writ of Extremity!
A Writ that could be granted to an existence to bring a Planar Boundary to Extremity.
He was about to gain three of them as he already had Oraculum illuminate the path forward on how he could best use these!

The single attack against the Avernus Extremities had brought in so many things that Noah had to digest, with him moving his time table on Apexification forward even more as with the Loot he just gained, he would be able to feed the Sporos III of Extremity with abundance and bring forward the next Ash Tree of Gradation.
When this and other factors were met, Apexification would proceed as he would break down an Unscalable Wall of Extremity!
But between this...the effects of his actions with the Avernus Extremities continued to propagate.

This was because at the same time that Noah came across his ecstatic loot and recognition, another being who had also caused the Aeonic Annals of Extremity to ring out praise had arrived light years near the grand image of the Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago!
It was none other than Extremity Blue as the actions she had taken had granted her a terrifying opportunity, and at the same time, a sense of danger.
This was because she literally devoured and assimilated everything into Lunacy.
Before, she had other concepts tying her down as they kept her grounded and somewhat stable.
But she took them all away as what was left behind...was only Lunacy!
And she truly followed this concept to the Extreme as no sane being would choose to do what she was doing right now.
Yet in a state of magisterial Lunacy, none of this nattered.
The only thing in her eyes...
[Noah!
Fucking!
Osmont!]
It remained Noah.
His actions blinded her as rage spilled out along with Hyperversal Extremity Authority that was right on the precipice of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.

She scanned the whole Archipelago light years away of all of its beings in a matter of seconds, she located Noah's figure that was walking with the only Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity on this Obsidian Havenly Saurischian Archipelago.

Her eyes burned with a fierce light of Blue as even though she saw such a being beside him...even though her might as an Extremity should have been able to tell her many things...she gritted her teeth as the light of Lunacy flashed.

In her very being, Lunacy took the lead as Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of LUNACY churned and cycled across her existence, her hand striking out as above the Obsidian Havenly Saurischian Archipelago, a massive glow of blue flourished as a light years long Extremity Rune Scripture that read [LUNACY] bloomed and descended!
Rationality would not win over Lunacy.
She followed what comprised most of her Existence currently as she attacked her obsession freely, not caring about any consequences that would come after that!

chapters.title: Chapter 2705 Deterioration! Refinement! I
paragraphs: 2705 Deterioration! Refinement! I

It had been over a day since Noah's initial display of power, with his control over Vitalis Hyperversal Authority being shown as at that time- it was enough to make people think he had undergone his Second Vitalis Awakening.
Though at that time, he only had Primitive Vitalis Manipulation and was of the First Vitalis Awakening!
But it was still enough for the Havenly Master of the Obsidian Havenly Saurischian Archipelago to pay attention to him.

He was officially stripped of his identity as an Underdweller as he emanated the glow of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage, and any existences in the Supernal Havens of Extremity who had undergone Vitalis Awakening were a precious resource!

This was even more so for those who had undergone their Second Vitalis Awakening as they were commonly genius Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities, or those at the stage of Tier 3 or 4 Hyperversal Extremity.
An Apex Aeonic Lifeform being in this state though? It was unheard of!

[You've had some time to think it over...what will your choice be? Even the forces of the Supernal Havens of Extremity will soon set off and be embroiled in the ensuing chaos. I can write a Recommendation for you to enter the Havenly Hyperversal Gauntlet of Gradation in the Supernal Haven of Helios. It is a treasured domain born under the warping of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority and the nearby spacetime continuum. It allows Entities and Treasures from Recorded History to appear within as it is also filled with great peril and unknown dangers, but the Genius Extremities of our Supernal Havens are sent there when they seek to traverse the Gradations of Extremity at a faster pace. It is truly meant to cut down on hundreds or thousands of years of hard work...so long as you can survive the Gauntlet of Gradation. Spots are limited in order to keep the shocking concentration of authority and treasures within, but you will be able to take a slot so long as you prove yourself.]
The Havenly Hyperversal Gauntlet of Gradation!
It was a place that eliminated the factor of time- reducing it by a great deal and allowing genius Existences to more smoothly traverse the Gradations of Extremity.
These were the words that the Havenly Master of this Archipelago was telling Noah before a moment later...
They both turned their heads up towards a certain direction. And soon after...
BOOM!
The space above the gorgeous obsidian island with its flowing waterfalls of Dissolution split as a massive spinning Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of LUNACY appeared.

It held a crimson halo around it, and yet the scripture itself was filled with a majestic blue glow as even though it threatened to cover the whole Archipelago, its authority was focused like a needle towards a single being!
The Havenly Master of the Archipelago saw this as his eyes opened with brilliant anger, a harrumph coming from him as he pressed his index finger up.
A single finger.

And yet in the next moment, a crimson light of Extremity flashed as from a swirling Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture, an illusory finger of Titanic stature and size bloomed as it pressed on the descending Scripture of Lunacy!
The single illusory finger was endlessly light years wide as it instantly shattered the blinding glow of Lunacy, continuing to go further up as the expression of Extremity Blue changed rapidly.
[Ya!]

She bellowed out with fervor as shockingly, the massive illusory finger continued to barrel towards her and arrived on moments- with her body erupting and releasing an endless sea of blue that the massive finger sank into.
BOOM!

The endlessly blue sea of Lunacy churned as it was split apart and destroyed into streams of innumerable rivers, the figure of Extremity Blue manifesting far off on the side from one cerulean stream as crimson gold blood flowed freely from her eyes.
She looked to be in a terrible state after facing the counterattack of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity of the Obsidian Havenly Saurischian Archipelago as his voice boomed out at this moment!
[You dare? A measly Clan from the Nether Havens of Extremity dares to be so bold as to attack with the intent to decimate a whole Archipelago?!]
His voice boomed out like a thunderclap as in the region above, Extremity Blue's bleeding eyes still burned with utmost hatred as she didn't falter.

The light of Lunacy bloomed again as this time, her whole body radiated the spinning of a myriad of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures as a moment later, she exploded into billions of strands of water droplets that spread out to cover the whole Archipelago, this water drops coming down like an endless rain as even though there were billions of water drops...Extremity Blue's soul and existence was only hidden in a single one!
And the billions of other drops of water all carried the terrifying corrosive power of a being on the precipice of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.
To try and pick her out amidst all of these water drops...should be impossible as it should give Blue some time to get closer to the one she wanted to kill.
[OSMONT!]
The billions of water droplets all bellowed out as they thundered down with utter disregard for the Havenly Master.
And this being turned exceedingly cold as his body glowed with authority, his two palms rising in front of his chest as he brought them together.

In the space above where innumerable water drops were raining down, two massive illusory palms formed as they pressed from left and right, squeezing together and evaporating all the water drops they came in contact with in a shocking show of power as they crashed towards each other speedily, eradicating every single drop of water until...
BZZT!
A single drop of water remained as it came to struggle between the incoming pressure of two palms!
[Ya!]
Extremity Blue's raging bellow came out as she transformed from the water drop, her eyes unwilling as she was outclassed by this Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity on all sides!
And now, his massive illusory hands threatened to crush her between them as she burned every ounce of authority she had to stop them from clamping her out of existence.
This gave birth to a figure of a dazzling gorgeous crazy woman stuck between two illusory palms, her hands stretched left and right as her bountiful chest trembled from the shocking pressure!
And the Havenly Master didn't relent as he brought his palms ever closer, intending to squash this being and decimate their records!
[Sigh.]
At such a time, the reality playing out and being recorded fluctuated.
The gaze of the Havenly Master became stern as at this moment, the blaring aura of another Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity appeared!

chapters.title: Chapter 2706 Deterioration! Refinement! II
paragraphs: 2706 Deterioration! Refinement! II

The blazing aura to appear was from none other than Seer Amestris, with her power being so unique that even though her figure couldn't be seen anywhere, her authority had already permeated in the surroundings.

It weaved through the massive illusory hand in the skies and around Extremity Blue's rageful figure that was holding the palms at bay- the very Record being etched down in this region somehow being altered as a crimson light wrapped around Extremity Blue...and whisked her away!
The scene was an ecstatic one as it finished just as quickly as it began.
BOOM!

The two illusory palms clasped onto each other while smashing into nothingness as Extremity Blue was forcefully taken away- this being now showing a great level of strength as she was able to withstand the attacks of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity!
An Extremity that after repelling her effortlessly, his resonant voice filled with majesty boomed out.

[You think you can come, attack, and go as please?! Your so-called Avernus Clan will not have a good time in these Supernal Havens of Extremity! Anyone of you even daring to enter any Archipelagos of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage will be killed on sight!]
His voice spread out to all like a declaration!
The forces of some Inheritances and four of the Seven Clans that already had their people arrive on the Obsidian Havenly Saurischian Archipelago all heard it!
They gazed at each other in shock as they quickly began to spread this information to their forces.

Just what was the Avernus Clan doing? They first offended whoever was behind the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Sources, and now they blatantly offended the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage by attacking an Archipelago? And behind it all, their target was Noah Osmont?
"Is this the same Noah Osmont who declared a War of Annihilation with them and the Singularity Overseers?"
An Extremity from the Havenly Moon Clan discussed with another as when they looked at it, it seemed that the Avernus Clan was too active!
After their conflict with Osmont, even the Singularity Overseers had been lying low as no major moves were made from them.
But the Avernus Clan...many major things were centered around them as they currently took the limelight with conflicts and what seemed like really bad decisions!
The words of the Havenly Master that thundered out made it known.
The Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineages on this floating landmass heard these words.
And Noah himself...heard the words that barred the Avernus Clan from certain Archipelagos and welcomed them with utmost profundity!
The first phase of his machination against the Avernus Clan was Isolation.
Isolate them from the support and strength of other forces, and now...they were even becoming isolated from the opportunities of the Supernal Havens of Extremity!
Noah didn't predict the actions that Extremity Blue would take, nor that she could have survived his Hyperversal Anomalous Virion the way that she did and have it grant her an elevation of power.
But what he was looking forward to was how other beings would combat his Virion as when he looked at the methods they used against it...he could then improve his Virion even more!

Currently, he had seen Seer Amestris cleave out the affected parts of an existence- any records that may have been affected as thereafter, their fate had half a chance on remaining who they were before the cleaving.
To improve it...he would now make it so that his Virions strictly target the Records of the Concepts of Extremity that an existence had!
If the concepts that gave them power had to be cleaved out...nothing would remain to protect them as their deaths would be guaranteed.
So from every angle, he looked at what occurred as opportunities and boons for him!
With a smile, he turned towards the enraged figure of the Havenly Master as he spoke out calmly- as if what had just occurred wasn't even involving him.
"I'll take you up on the Recommendation of the Havenly Hyperversal Gauntlet of Gradation in the Supernal Haven of Helios."
An opportunity that was meant for beings to quickly traverse through the Gradations of Extremity!
Of course, he who hadn't even attained Extremity would seek it.

Since he had many different parts of his soul stretched out across the Nether and Supernal Havens, they would all be put to work as the few days deadline to grasp Extremity...would surely be cut short as he didn't even expect to need a full 7 days!

At this very moment as he agreed to prove himself to enter something known as the Havenly Hyperversal Gauntlet of Gradation, his Main Body deployed the remaining False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER as their destination was in the booming battle between Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions.
He had reaped the lives of 34 Tier 1 Extremities and even one at a Tier 2, and it was now time to collect on the Virions he had cultivated in the Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities!
With their Loot and the Loot he had gained so far...the Sporos III of Extremity was bound to be taken to maturity as at that point, the grandeur of a Quintessential Apexification would bloom.

Then, there were his other bodies stretched out with the identities of the 9th Infernal Lord of the Infernal Havenly Commerce as at this moment, some of them welcomed personages of the Seven Clans who came to trade with abundance- with Oraculum buzzing in his mind as he could sense a possibility of trades involving something even grander than the Andromeda Cleaver!
And then...there was the wonder that was Xiaomi.

In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, his main body was flipping through the records of the Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement while watching over her figure that he had now given the Tier 2 Singularity Crystal of the Record of Extremity and Tier 2Singularity Crystal of the True Death Record of the Tier 2 Extremity he had inadvertently killed.

These records were useful even to him, with Xiaomi being allowed to see them first as her Foundation that was conducive to elevating Ruin and other concepts of Chaos to Extremity...it began to tremble at this moment after she experienced the formation and death of Extremity for both Tier 1 and Tier 2 existences!
She saw the beginnings, and then the ends of these powerful existences.
Noah didn't even have to give her the Records of the other 34 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities.
At this moment, her existence began to tremble as she felt like she had arrived at the precipice of a grand achievement!

chapters.title: Chapter 2707 Deterioration! Refinement! III
paragraphs: 2707 Deterioration! Refinement! III
The Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos!

It was initially a foundation only meant to elevate RUIN to Extremity at the fastest possible time, but after Noah and Quintessence became involved, this Foundation became something even grander as it included other Sources of Chaos as well.
The holder of this foundation had absorbed the Records of birth and death of Extremity of two beings.
One at Tier 1, and another at Tier 2. She saw how they formed their first Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures, and how their very existence was altered because of it.
She also saw how they lost all of their Rune Scriptures before they died.
This cycle of beginnings and endings of Extremity had pushed her ever closer towards the 18th Boundary Layer of RUIN as in front of her- ever glorious prompts rose!
[You are nearing the extreme of RUIN!]

Her body was floating not too far from the light years domain of the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Andromeda being given off by the Andromeda Cleaver, and profoundly crimson tendrils of Ruin were swirling around her in an ecstatic and erratic manner.

[An Astonishing Feat in the works! If you are capable of scaling the wall of Extremity, you will be one of the few in Recorded History to have achieved Extremity of a concept in a short period of time!]
The prompts that appeared before her were ones that Noah also saw through his connection and system, and he could see any of the prompts of his Vassals with ease if he wished.

But Xiaomi's prompts...they showed the terrifying grandeur of the Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos as since she began on the path of Extremity, Xiaomi would enter the ranks of beings who took a truly short period of time to achieve Extremity!
Noah didn't doubt that in Recorded History, beings who held different variations of Innate Pellucid Foundations were among the many who achieved Extremity in a short period of time.
But even when it came to such a feat...Noah was bound to break it as the time that has passed from when he first expanded his concepts towards Extremity...it had only been a matter of weeks!
Since he stepped into the Abecedarian Sacrarium of the Learnean Lineage, it had only been a matter of weeks as not even a full month had passed.
Who in Recorded History had achieved Extremity in less than a month since the time they first expanded their concept?
A light of tyranny flashed over Noah's eyes while thinking of this, with his thoughts of brilliance focusing on the next set of prompts that flashed by Xiaomi.
[An infinitesimally small distance is left between the 17th Boundary Layer of Ruin and the Extremity Layer of Ruin!]
[The infinitesimally small distance is one that others may never cross throughout their lives. Your soul and understanding of Ruin is critical in crossing this distance and attaining Extremity.]
WAA!
An infinitesimally small distance.
It demarcated those with power and those with not!
It showed those who had grasped Extremity and those who would forever be far from it.
As for Xiaomi...Noah knew she would likely cross this gulf within the day or two!
But even this seemed too long.
Noah looked at the figure of Xiaomi which had a determined expression with its own exotic charm as he pondered.
Oraculum burned brightly in his mind as after many computations, his will turned towards the Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art.
Oraculum told him that if he wanted to nudge her to achieve Extremity even faster, he could experiment with this method!
And so, Noah breathed in while taking a seated position in space.
His mind was buzzing with authorities as he called out lightly.
[Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art]
HUUM!
He felt his Innate Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians vibrate as the authorities within were roused!
And in front of his eyes...
A blue illusory square panel appeared as towards its center, there was a golden bordered illusory triangle that had on each side runic etchings!
They read [Planalith Krystallos Refinement].
As Noah looked at the simple display before him, a prompt rose that him which authority he would like to refine.
And when such a prompt came, he spoke simply.
"Ruin."

The golden box pulsed as a single crimson point of light bloomed, with the borders of the illusory display then beginning to disappear until before Noah's eyes, there was only this single Singularity of crimson light!
The beginnings of a Planalith Krystallos!
[The Ruin Planalith Krystallos has begun to be forged.]
[The Process of refining the concept of Ruin would lead to a product normally capable of aiding an existence across the Gradations of Extremity!]

[Since no Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures are available to carry out the refinement, Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities may be utilized in a limited extent to continue the processing, refining, and purifying of the Ruin Planalith Krystallos.]

His Innate Meridians that were pulsing this whole time began to churn as their strong streams burned, the crimson point of Planalith Krystallos beginning to spit rapidly as from all around, Ruin was called forth!
In all forms, potency, and concentration, all of Ruin surged into this single point of Singularity as they underwent a heavy baptism- a process of refinement!
After Noah's reserves of Vitalis and Vacuous began to burn, the singularity of Ruin before Noah spun ever faster as a wondrous process began.
It wasn't something that he could finish so quickly at this stage as when he saw the process of the spinning Ruin Planalith Krystallos, he knew that it would take some time- even by his standards!
An hour passed after the Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art was activated for the first time.
At this point, the Singularity before Noah had condensed into a terrifyingly powerful crystalline circular stone that caused the surrounding authorities to stall and falter!
It was the treasure that was as small as mere inches outside, but spanned billions of light years within.
It was something that normally, only Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities could forge.
Now, what product would Noah have when he was doing all this before he even achieved Extremity?!

If you are capable of scaling the wall of Extremity, you will be one of the few in Recorded History to have achieved Extremity of a concept in a short period of time!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2708 Deterioration! Refinement! IV
paragraphs: 2708 Deterioration! Refinement! IV

The refinement of Noah's first Planalith Krystallos was proceeding smoothly, the major thing he was watching being the expenditure of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities and how much he was recovering as it continued to burn up every second.

Although he couldn't say with absolute confidence, he could see that it would likely drain all of his reserves of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities just to complete this single Ruin Planalith Krystallos- and this was with him regenerating these authorities as it meant his current reserves weren't enough!
This was how ridiculous utilizing the Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art as even a being of the Second Awakenings like him had trouble with it.
But he proceeded steadily as at the end of the road...there was going to be nothing else other than Extremity.
Instead, he places his focus elsewhere as this process continued, a part of his will turning towards his ongoing war with the Avernus Clan!
His machinations were deep as after a day, he had already made multiple moves against the Avernus Clan.
In the Nether Haven of Oceanus.
Within a cluster of Minor Havens surrounded by dazzling purple swirling formations that would protect and alert the Avernus Clan of any intruders.
In a Minor Haven known as the Brightlac Haven, a group of Tier 3 and Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities sat in a Command Post of this Haven as they talked in grim tones regarding recent events.
Purple thrones floated in a stellar space as these Avernus Extremities looked at each other while speaking.

[More bad news and good news from the Supernal Haven of Dissolution...our brethren have begun dying to the Pathogenic Authority released by Osmont. The good news is that Esteemed Blue has touched upon the door of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.]
A Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity spoke as her gaze was a grim one even with such good news!
[Tier 4?!]
Others rose in shock and happiness as such a thing as it meant their Clan was that much more secure.
Each Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity was the backbone of the Seven Clans as the more of them, the better.
So why was her gaze still grim?
The one who had spoken sighed as she continued.

[Unfortunately, her first action after arriving at the doors of Tier 4 was to attack Osmont who was under the protection of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage- under a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity. Now because of that, all of our forces are barred from entering all Archipelagos under the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage, which greatly dampers our progress into the Supernal Havens of Extremity...]
The news shocked those hearing it for the first time as they sat back on their thrones and sighed.
[First the Blood Sources, now this...]
The heads of the Tier 3 and Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities shook as they thought about everything that had occurred so far.
Just where did it all begin to go wrong?

[Our might is unblemished as nobody would even dare to utter our name if not with reverence, now...there have been scuffles between our Scions and Elders with even dredges of people from Inheritances- not even the Seven Clans, and we lost in those scuffles!]

Normally, no inheritance would ever dare to even besmirch the grandeur of Avernus. And yet over the past day, their people moved about as normal, and when it came to receiving the same level of respect from others as before...it did not happen!
Their Apex Aeonic Scions disagreed with the Scions of a middle-tier Inheritance at best, and yet their people lost in the ensuing conflict.
It was because of nothing else other than the fact that the other side had the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, and they did not!
This thought caused their minds to turn sour as these beings remained silent on their thrones.
[...Well-]
HUUM!

One had begun trying to lighten up the mood when all of their gazes suddenly changed, their faces turning to gaze towards a certain direction in their Brightlac Haven as their figures disappeared soon after!

This was because they had felt an ascension of life from Apex to Extremity in a region of this Haven, with all of them moving across space to stop a bright mountain surrounded by waves of purple mist, their eyes joyful as they disappeared again to enter this mountain and appear within a domain in its depths.

This was the Lilac Converging Mountain in their Brightlac Haven that was the abode of their Scions to cultivate in, so the change of life from Apex to Extremity they had just felt was astounding news as in their memory, they held a few candidates who had been stuck at the 17th Boundary Layer for a few hundred or thousands of years without success in breaking through!
They came to ascertain who had made this achievement as when they appeared, they saw a group of twice a dozen Scions rising up in shock and...
worry?

The moment they felt the aura of Tier 2 and Tier 3 Elders of the Avernus Clan behind them, their faces actually became ashen and filled with more worry as they surrounded a single being who had just formed their first Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture, the gaze of this woman blank as she uttered out with slight fear!
[I...I didn't mean to. I really didn't. It just...happened.]
Shocking words came from her that baffled the newly appearing Extremities as they soon realized something was wrong.
She didn't mean to step away from the 17th Layer and enter Extremity? Just what could allow such a thing?
In their confusion, they spread their wills out as their gazes suddenly changed.
This was because from the body of the newly advanced Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity and the twice a dozen other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms around her...
they felt a Havenly glow they had only seen around other beings that had attained something they could not!
And not just that, but on the feet of this group, there were over a hundred glimmering crimson gold round Blood Sources that finally came under their gaze.
[Preposterous!]
[You...you all!]
Their happy moods turned extremely sour as they bellowed out, the scene in front of them foreshadowing the shocking and chaotic times to come for the Avernus Clan!

chapters.title: Chapter 2709 With a Thought, Hundreds of Extremities Fall! I
paragraphs: 2709 With a Thought, Hundreds of Extremities Fall! I

The Tier 2 and Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity Avernus Elders began to bellow out while releasing their authorities in anger, especially a dashing woman at Tier 3 who looked at the newly advanced Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity that was her disciple.
This being almost kneeled on the ground under the pressure, but her new lineage shockingly cried out and denied such a motion as she kept standing while speaking absentmindedly.
[Master...I was stuck at the 17th Layer for a thousand years now. Nothing worked no matter which Treasures you provided for me! I...I only wanted to advance forward, Master.]

Her gaze was one of conflict and happiness at the same time as shockingly, this whole group of disciples here had renounced the Avernus Clan and taken the Blood Sources to attain the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage!
[Rubbish! Where did you even find all of these Blood Sources?!]
Her Master still bellowed out in reply as the newly advanced Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity gazed at the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms around her before she spoke in a low voice.
[...they just appeared in front of Lily and Sabo in a cluster as they were patrolling outside...]
Their gazes turned sour.
They just appeared?
It was very clear that their enemies were throwing them at their feet to tempt them and cut off their allegiances to the Avernus Clan!

The anger in the hearts of the Tier 3 and Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities was abundant as before they could release it, the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms around them who radiated a Havenly glow began speaking.

[We beg for your understanding, Esteemed Elders. But..all of us have already created an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity each in the last hour. We...we are progressing faster than ever before as our souls now tell us Extremity is only a matter of time! If...if Elders also take these Blood Sources, I believe you can traverse across the Gradations of Extremity that much faster. The path of Extremity is a long one as it cares not for allegiances. What is the Avernus Clan in the face of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity? Or even the impossible Tier 5?]
BOOM!

The instant this Scion finished speaking, a heavy force smashed into him that threw him back while spitting out blood, his figure smashing onto a wall behind as a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity had flung their hand forward at his shocking words!
But the words...boomed and repeated in their minds over and over again.
What was a clan in the face of Extremity?
If they could traverse across the Gradations of Extremity with speed again, if they could...
Many possibilities bloomed as an immense silence descended in this space.

The Tier 3 and Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities still seemed to be filled with anger, but their eyes now held a different light as they started at the over 100 Blood Sources radiating a pristine glow at the feet of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
The glow seemed so supremely tempting as they couldn't take their eyes off of it, these Extremities beginning to look at each other as they sought to understand what each of them was thinking!

They didn't know that from the eyes of the newly advanced Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity, Noah's will watched all of these events silently as he continued to delve and probe deeper into the destruction of the Avernus Clan.
After their continued isolation, more and more of their own people would renounce and leave them as soon...the phase of indeterminate chaos and destruction of the Clan from within would start!
Everything was proceeding on the path Noah foresaw as while he was systematically breaking one of the Seven Clans, his other bodies continued their tasks without a shred of worry.

At this moment, his Reified Source of Quintessence was about to take on another monumental task as while adorning the Vacuous Infernal I Entity Form, he commanded and led Apex Vacuous Lifeforms towards his other body of Alexander- gaining more and more kills over the last day.

What he did with even more fervor was the infection of the Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities located in nearby Savior's Arks- with the number of Extremities who silently had Noah's Virion inside of them now exceeding a thousand!

Currently, the battle between the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions felt like a meat grinder of moments of calmness and turbidity, and then instant eruptions of deadly attacks that ground down and decimated millions of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and a few Extremities.

Gradually, both sides revealed their Tier 3 and 4 Hyperversal Extremities and the power they held, each one getting their opposing combatants as currently, even Emperor Shao was reigned in by a terrifying Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity taking on their Vacuous Infernal III Entity Form- an existence that had undergone the Third Vacuous Awakening!
He seemed to be made up of pure Aurora of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as he was supported by two other Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity to counter Emperor Shao and his attacks.
The whole battlefield now seemed to be a deadly period of calm before the storm as both sides seemed ready to erupt with a new action that could change the entire landscape of the battle.
For Noah, none of this mattered as his will had already released 167 False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER onto 167 affected Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities!
This number was utterly staggering to mention in terms of Extremities, and even more so when talking about killing them.
They were stretched out over five Hyperversal Savior's Arks as some already had the Virion actively destroying their bodies, while others did not have it active just yet!

At this moment, Noah's eyes released a light of coldness as the False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER rose from inside the bodies of the Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities who are taken out of commission and moved towards the center of the Savior's Ark to find against the storms of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities.
They silently appeared as with precision and deadly sharpness, they located the weakest and most compromising area to attack as a moment later, Noah gave the command.
And...
BOOM!
It was like bombs were set off en masse as a shocking chain reaction began!

paragraphs: 2710 With a Thought, Hundreds of Extremities Fall! II
The False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER were activated!

On over 28 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities, their expressions changed as they bellowed out with horror- their swirling layers of Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures becoming perforated as the action instantly destabilized the little protection they put together against the storms of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities.

And the moment one part of their defenses was perforated, the Virion didn't let go of this chance as it spread madly. It spread across their Records of Extremity, their memories, lifeforce, and their very souls!
More and more perforations occurred as within moments, all of these Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities fell into a deadly spiral as their records were now being eaten up uncontrollably!
Lotra and Quintessence raged within them as they began to claim everything, this situation quickly becoming discerned by those around them as their Authorities erupted out to support.
But this was the moment where Noah's eyes flashed with the most brilliance as from the over 1,000 Extremity affected by his Virions and yet they had remained inactive this whole time...
[Oh!]
[No!]
BOOOM!
The Virions were all activated simultaneously as hundreds of Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities found themselves facing an unprecedented storm inside of them!

As for the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities...the moment this authority reached a sufficient devouring of their records, they had their protective domain of Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures be perforated as they were put on a path of no return.
[This...!]
DUM! DUM! DUM!
Drums of victory and glory began to resound across the battlefield as the reality that was playing out was an alarming one that caused many beings to draw sharp breaths.
This was because by the dozens, Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities began to fall one after another in an unprecedented fashion!
Throughout multiple arks, their bodies were destroyed from within as they ultimately exploded in a shower of authority and dust.
DUM!

And the drums in the surroundings only became more fervent as the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions took a deadly blow, with their forces watching with crimson eyes filled with rage as within moments, over 100 Tier I Vacuous Extremities perished!
DUM!
When this number reached 167, it finally stopped.
But this was only in the number of deaths.

Over 10 nearby Hyperversal Savior's Arks were currently in disarray as all of their Extremities were affected by the now active Virions, their battle power being reduced and becoming negligible as when the Vitalis Hyperversal Legions saw this, their forces moved to attack with glee!
They wanted to take this chance to deal heavy damage while these beings couldn't protect themselves with the same strength as before.
A shocking level of chaos erupted as a single being watched all of it unfold with a sharp gaze.

He activated over 1000 Virions at once as all of these Extremities were now in a precarious position, the Tier 1s not being able to defend themselves against other attacks if they wanted to focus on stopping the spread of the Virion as because they were still attacked by their enemies who wanted to use this opportunity...
[NO!]

They bellowed out in despair as after they were forced to take on the attack of a Tier 1 Vitalis Extremity, their inward defense weren't kept active as perforation began to appear around their Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures, and their bodies ultimately became devoured by a raging storm after!

Like this...even though Noah didn't use the False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER, there were still over a dozen more Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities that began dying due to their enemies taking this chance to attack them with even more fervor, and this number only began to rise.

Tier 2 and Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities could still protect themselves somewhat against those wishing to use this moment to destroy them, but Noah was still lucky with one Tier 2 Vacuous Extremity who was instantly attacked by a sharp flaming arrow simmering with Hyperversal Extremity Authority from his enemy who held a brilliant crimson bow, multiple of their Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures being destroyed as the Viriok used this chance to spread irreversibly- the eyes of this Tier 2 Vacuous Extremity becoming extreme horrified and unwilling as he began to be swallowed up by the heavy storms of the Virion!
And so far, none of the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities seemed to be in precarious positions as they retreated quickly.
Multiple Hyperversal Savior's Arks were forced to pull back at this moment as all of their Extremities were nearly taken out of service!
And all of this...was a single move done by one existence.

It was a shocking development of the battlefield as from a far distance, the eyes of Emperor Shao are radiating a bright flight as his eyes blazed to see through the truth, the storms of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities confirming everything he saw on the records of the Avernus Clan!
His will barreled out as he sought to locate the being who could affect the battle this much before he had even achieved Extremity.
Even this thought of him not achieving Extremity began to be questioned as...
could any being that had not grasped Extremity even be capable of doing this?
This was the thought in Emperor Shao's mind as even while his will surged out, he couldn't find anything about Noah Osmont.

With the opportunistic counterattacks of the Vitalis Hyperversal Legions, more and more of the affected Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities began to fall as in addition to the 165 Noah personally acted against, dozens more began to gradually fall!
And the ken responsible for it all...his soul was buzzing with a glorious light as his Vaults of Quintessence were accepting truly magisterial waves of Loot.
And in his mind, astonishing prompts cascaded.
[You have destroyed the True Records of over 200 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities!]
[A Quintessential Achievement!]
[The distinction of the Extremity Despoiler has been elevated to Extremity II Despoiler.]
