chapters.title: Chapter 2711 With a Thought, Hundreds of Extremities Fall! III
paragraphs: 2711 With a Thought, Hundreds of Extremities Fall! III
Extremity Despoiler!

The first time Noah gained this, it was a tool that allowed him to forge the False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER- something that could actually break the authority of a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity.

An elevation of this distinction was bound to be something grand, with Noah's eyes filtering across waves of information and prompts of Loot at this moment as he looked for the information of Extremity II Despoiler.
Before that, the loot from another Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity falling and the over 200 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities came in glorious waves.
[1x Remnant Obsidian Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity has been attained.]
[1x Tier 2 Singularity Crystal of the Record of Extremity has been attained!]
[1x Tier 2 Singularity Crystal of the True Death Record of Cabulan has been attained.]
[208x Singularity Crystal of the Records of Extremity have been attained!]
[The Singularity Crystal of the True Death Record of Zed has been attained.]
[The Singularity Crystal of the True Death Record of Johanna has been attained.]
[The Singularity Crystal of the True Death Record of Yan has been....]
[208x Remnant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writs of Extremity have been attained.]
[200 Remnant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writs of Extremity are merging to form 20 full Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity!]

With every successive move Noah made, his progression and things he could do only became that much more explosive as currently, he had the ridiculous grandeur of 23 Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writs of Extremity when he added those gained from the Avernus Extremities loot.
23 tools that could birth 23 Extremities that held Planar Boundaries!

The mere stage of Extremity was so pristine and hard to reach that with his lineage and Loot he was accumulating even before he achieved Extremity...it felt like Noah was violating the sacred pathway of Extremity with everything he was doing.
And this was bound to be even truer as he finally looked at the description of Extremity II Despoiler.

[Extremity II Despoiler]:: A distinction and title that 9 beings share across Recorded History- something obtained before they entered the folds of Extremity. While 9 beings share this distinction, the True Emperor of Quintessence is the only one among them in Recorded History to have already achieved the purpose of the Extremity II Despoiler before he attained Extremity. The purpose of Extremity II Despoiler is to ultimately aid one in relating the life of a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity, with it allowing you to condense a False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity II Rune Scripture of [DESPOILER]. This False Extremity II Rune Scripture of Despoiler requires 300,000 Units of either Vitalis or Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, along with immense reserves of resources, Soul Values, and authority to condense as no average existence standing before the cusp of Extremity is capable of condensing it. A Single False Extremity II Rune Scripture of [DESPOILER] is capable of piercing a protective Golden or Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture on the body of a Hyperversal Extremity...
A glorious distinction that granted an even grander authority for Noah to wield!
One that others received...but were nowhere near as grand as him.

His gaze left the battlefield that had become increasingly chaotic due to him, the will of his Main Body coming into focus again as in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven- the mountains of loot from the prompts appeared within his Vaults of Quintessence.
There was more than enough Loot to have the Sporos III of Extremity achieve maturity, but Noah's full focus was currently not on this!

It was on the dazzling round, smooth, and deeply crimson Krystallos that had finished its refinement after draining him of all of the reserves of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities and more over the past half day.
The instant it was completed...
BZZT!
It vibrated and released an oppressive authority that pressed on all beings here!
Those who were withstanding the pressure of the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Andromeda being given off by the Andromeda Cleaver were stopped in their tracks by this oppressive authority.
It was something that was in the realm of Extremity!
It was truly only 5 inches wide, but the being who refined it knew that billions of light years worth of processed, refined, and purified authority of Ruin lay inside of it.

When one grasped this Krystallos to absorb or assimilate into their existence, Noah didn't doubt that they would reach the 17th Boundary Layer of Ruin even before a hundredth of its essence was used up.
His eyes were luminous as even when he reached out towards it- he could fully grasp this Krystallos that he had forged himself!
His will went towards it as its details rose up.

[Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos]:: The first refined Planalith Krystallos from the True Emperor of Quintessence who is seeking to become the Extremity of Quintessence. It is Low Grade in nature due to the Refiner not having enough experience with his Art and the absence of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures in its forging. It is something that could normally only be refined and utilized by those in the Gradations of Extremity. Its foundation was built from Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities and not Hyperversal Extremity Authorities through Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures. Because of this, it is only 1% effective for elevating the Extremity of Ruin across the First Gradation of Extremity to the Third Gradation of Extremity. It has no effectiveness on the Fourth Gradation of Extremity or above as only a Middle Grade or High Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos may be effective for such a stage. If an existence below the folds of the Gradations of Extremity is capable of assimilating the essence of the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos, they will have glimpses of the Extremity of Ruin as if this concept is inclined and truly compatible with their existence, this Krystallos will aid them in forming their first Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture. It is unknown and debatable whether the True Emperor of Quintessence himself can utilize this Krystallos to break across the Unscalable Wall of Ruin, which even if he does- it is even more debatable whether his concepts that are considered Dead Paths would follow this ascension to Extremity with just this advancement. Through the Refinement of this Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos, your proficiency in the Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art has increased by 1%. A proficiency of 100% will elevate your capabilities to a higher grade and increase the chances of refining higher grades of Planalith Krystallos....
A wondrous product came to be.
Noah's smile was devilish as he stared at it, its description revealing a world of possibilities as for now- it only confirmed that Xiaomi would now be attaining Extremity very soon!

chapters.title: Chapter 2712 The Process of Extremity! I
paragraphs: 2712 The Process of Extremity! I
A Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos!

It was Noah's first product with the Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art as the moment it was done, it was actually given a grading while he received a percentage proficiency.
The more authorities he refined, the faster his rate of refinement would be, and the higher the grades of profundity of the Planalith Krystallos would be!

Noah gazed at the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos before him that floated in space and the oppressive pressure it released, its aura that was making others feel suffocated exerting a sort of a pull towards Xiaomi as her eyes fluttered open to gaze at it longingly at this moment.

Noah beckoned towards her as her body floated over, and he went above even this as he gazed at the depths of the light years long domain where his people were overcoming the limitations and strengths of their souls to get ever closer to the Andromeda Cleaver.
[Come. Come observe the process of Extremity.]

He called them all over in such a shocking manner as Aurelia and Orion trembled- these beings who had always thought Extremity would be far, far from their grasp having their common sense once more shattered when Noah spoke about it so freely!
As if he could decide when and where Extremity would arrive.
Others wouldn't even be able to know if it would come for them in a thousand or a million years, and yet he called them over to observe the Process of Extremity!

They didn't tarry as they allowed the repulsive Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Andromeda to push them back, a few hundred figures very quickly coming out of the domain and circling Noah and Xiaomi figures.
This includes Hyperion and other Enders of Extremity, in addition to Henry, Barbatos, Kazuhiko, and other prominent Vassals.
They circled around Noah and Xiaomi as with a thundering voice, the True Emperor of Quintessence spoke!

"For others, Extremity is distant and forever out of reach. For us...it is merely a matter of time. The concept achieving Extremity today is Ruin- with the Foundation of Xiaomi being extremely conducive to Sources of Chaos as with a little push, Extremity will be within her grasp. Experience and feel it to the best of your abilities, and I will display what I see with my eyes for you all to see."
Yes!

Even though they were gazing and observing the process, none of them were like Noah who held Eyes of Extremity that could observe Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures or understand just how the authority of Extremity flowed!

So at this moment, an illusory screen of light appeared with grand stature above them, displaying the scene of the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos and the figure of Xiaomi as it was subtly different compared to what the rest of them saw.
Thereafter, Noah nodded towards Xiaomi who breathed out any worries or nervousness.
The gazes of many beings seemed to disappear and fall out of the picture as before her, there was only the dazzling crimson colored Planalith Krystallos and the figure of Noah.
She would have never imagined her current position just days ago, and here she was now.

She didn't forget the one who made all of it possible as when she floated ever closer to the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos, she gazed towards Noah and bowed down deeply before she rose again and instantly thrust her hand out towards the smooth and round Planalith Krystallos in front of her!
BZZT!
Tendrils of crimson light began to surge on its surface as Xiaomi could not fully reach and grasp it.
But these tendrils of Ruin began to be pulled by her one by one, landing on her stellar obsidian skin as the moment they did so...
GONG! GONG!
It was like the sound of heavy booming metals reverberating out with every strand landing on her!

And the moment she came in contact with the tendrils emanating from the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos, her body drank all of it in as instantly, dazzling crimson flames of Ruin erupted all over her body.
Flames that coalesced and roared with purpose as above her head...the beginnings of a dazzling runic ecriture began to be forged.
"Ya!"

Xiaomi bellowed out with ferocity as she became inches away from the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos, even more tendrils of refined and pure Ruin entering her existence as the precipice she had arrived at- the infinitesimally small distance that she had not yet been able to cross...she was slowly bridging this gap and arriving at the other side!
HUUM!
The surroundings resonated and turned wild as above them, seething waves of Ruin and other Sources of Chaos began to gather.
The Aletheian Haven of Apollyon rumbled as the Natural Law of Entropy and other Sources of Chaos rose in cheering majesty.

The stellar obsidian hourglass figure of Xiaomi became ever more resplendent and magnificent as her bearing became even more graceful, a halo of red light covering her as her dark stellar hair waved madly!
She looked like a holy Infernal princess from ancient times that others could only stare at from afar.
And in front of her gaze, dazzling prompts began to rise.
[A distance of unfathomable proportions has been crossed forcefully with a profound treasure.]
[Extremely Pure and Refined Authority of Ruin has assimilated into your existence and connected the 17th Boundary Layer to the 18th Boundary Layer.]
[You have arrived at the Extremity Boundary Layer of Ruin!]
BOOM!
An explosion of Ruin bloomed as in a shocking show of utter majesty, the stellar obsidian palm of Xiaomi came to grasp and wrap around the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos!
She was able to grasp an object meant for Extremities as it felt like she was holding onto a billowing and roaring crimson sun, her small figure trembling as she once more released a valiant shout.
[Ya!]
The shout this time was filled with authority.
Hyperversal Extremity Authority!

They didn't tarry as they allowed the repulsive Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Andromeda to push them back, a few hundred figures very quickly coming out of the domain and circling Noah and Xiaomi figures.
This includes Hyperion and other Enders of Extremity, in addition to Henry, Barbatos, Kazuhiko, and other prominent Vassals.
They circled around Noah and Xiaomi as with a thundering voice, the True Emperor of Quintessence spoke!
"For others, Extremity is distant and forever out of reach.
For us...it is merely a matter of time.
The concept achieving Extremity today is Ruin- with the Foundation of Xiaomi being extremely conducive to Sources of Chaos as with a little push, Extremity will be within her grasp.
Experience and feel it to the best of your abilities, and I will display what I see with my eyes for you all to see."
Yes!

Even though they were gazing and observing the process, none of them were like Noah who held Eyes of Extremity that could observe Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures or understand just how the authority of Extremity flowed!

So at this moment, an illusory screen of light appeared with grand stature above them, displaying the scene of the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos and the figure of Xiaomi as it was subtly different compared to what the rest of them saw.
Thereafter, Noah nodded towards Xiaomi who breathed out any worries or nervousness.
The gazes of many beings seemed to disappear and fall out of the picture as before her, there was only the dazzling crimson colored Planalith Krystallos and the figure of Noah.
She would have never imagined her current position just days ago, and here she was now.

She didn't forget the one who made all of it possible as when she floated ever closer to the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos, she gazed towards Noah and bowed down deeply before she rose again and instantly thrust her hand out towards the smooth and round Planalith Krystallos in front of her!
BZZT!
Tendrils of crimson light began to surge on its surface as Xiaomi could not fully reach and grasp it.
But these tendrils of Ruin began to be pulled by her one by one, landing on her stellar obsidian skin as the moment they did so...
GONG!
GONG!
It was like the sound of heavy booming metals reverberating out with every strand landing on her!

And the moment she came in contact with the tendrils emanating from the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos, her body drank all of it in as instantly, dazzling crimson flames of Ruin erupted all over her body.
Flames that coalesced and roared with purpose as above her head...the beginnings of a dazzling runic ecriture began to be forged.
"Ya!"

Xiaomi bellowed out with ferocity as she became inches away from the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos, even more tendrils of refined and pure Ruin entering her existence as the precipice she had arrived at- the infinitesimally small distance that she had not yet been able to cross...she was slowly bridging this gap and arriving at the other side!
HUUM!
The surroundings resonated and turned wild as above them, seething waves of Ruin and other Sources of Chaos began to gather.
The Aletheian Haven of Apollyon rumbled as the Natural Law of Entropy and other Sources of Chaos rose in cheering majesty.

The stellar obsidian hourglass figure of Xiaomi became ever more resplendent and magnificent as her bearing became even more graceful, a halo of red light covering her as her dark stellar hair waved madly!
She looked like a holy Infernal princess from ancient times that others could only stare at from afar.
And in front of her gaze, dazzling prompts began to rise.
[A distance of unfathomable proportions has been crossed forcefully with a profound treasure.]
[Extremely Pure and Refined Authority of Ruin has assimilated into your existence and connected the 17th Boundary Layer to the 18th Boundary Layer.]
[You have arrived at the Extremity Boundary Layer of Ruin!]
BOOM!
An explosion of Ruin bloomed as in a shocking show of utter majesty, the stellar obsidian palm of Xiaomi came to grasp and wrap around the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos!
She was able to grasp an object meant for Extremities as it felt like she was holding onto a billowing and roaring crimson sun, her small figure trembling as she once more released a valiant shout.
[Ya!]
The shout this time was filled with authority.
Hyperversal Extremity Authority!

chapters.title: Chapter 2713 The Process of Extremity! II
paragraphs: 2713 The Process of Extremity! II

Above Xiaomi, the runic scripture shone with a blinding light as letters were forged rapidly by an influx of billions of light years of Ruin from the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos, very quickly releasing an obsidian glow and grandeur of a Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture that read...
[RUIN]!
The process caused the 17th Boundary Layer of Ruin within Noah's own existence to vibrate and begin dancing crazily as he continued to observe the prompts that only appeared in front of Xiaomi.
[You are stepping on the ever glorious path of the Gradations of Extremity.]
[The Extremity of Ruin is acting as the base of your Existence.]
[So long as Ruin persists, so will your existence.]
BOOM!

Billowing might exploded out as a fully forged Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of RUIN appeared, swirling with might and grandeur as it floated onto Xiaomi's body and released a terrifying devouring force- a force that devoured her Origin and Soul entirely!
Her body and foundation became like a husk with nothing in it- all signs of life fading from her as only the Extremity Rune Scripture of RUIN was ever radiant.

And then an instant later, an even more domineering strand of soul began to be released from the Extremity Rune Scripture of RUIN, a soul of an entirely different being as it filled up the empty body and foundation to cause it to transform into an entirely different form of life!

Cellular structure was broken down and reforged to the singular atoms as more and more strands of an Extremity Soul radiated from the Extremity Rune Scripture of RUIN, along with a restructured Origin of Extremity that was born on the basis of RUIN.
A pulse of shocking power then emanated from Xiaomi's body as from a lifeless husk, a glorious and mighty Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Ruin began to surge from her.
In the far distance, one being watched this scene with stellar tears falling out of his eyes as if it was something out of his wildest imagination.
It was the Mad Apex Emperor Caesar.
He watched his daughter ascend to a stage even he had not neared yet as when he saw her unmatched and holy aura, his heart trembled as no sign of madness could be seen from him.
Only unbelievable happiness.
This was his daughter!
She was sick and dying weeks ago as now, everything was entirely reversed as she gained a sense of longevity and wonder that even he paled in comparison to.
And now, she forged the way forward for the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
For the domain of the one being who made it all possible.
His gaze couldn't help but linger on the glorious visage of Noah whose own body had begun terrifically dancing with tendrils of Ruin.

On Xiaomi, the change continued as more and more of her soul was returned into her body as something entirely new, every part of it radiating Extremity and majesty as it was tinted with a crimson glow.
Her eyes opened with utmost power and ferocity as then, she grasped the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos that had shrunk by a third in her hands ever tighter.
And...
BOOM!

An influx of light years of pure and refined RUIN was pulled into her as beside the single Extremity Rune Scripture of RUIN, another one began to be forged and was completed a moment later- with a third Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of RUIN beginning to be formed soon after!
[You are traversing the First Gradation of Extremity.]

[The Quality of your Concept of Extremity granted an Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture at the onset, with its advancement into a Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture guaranteed as you enter the next Gradations of Extremity.]

[You have accomplished an astounding achievement of skipping over Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures entirely and beginning your traversal of the Gradations of Extremity with an Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture!]
[An Astounding Achievement!]
Her figure was like a blazing obsidian sun that some of the hundreds of beings surrounding her and Noah had to look away from.

She ate up the extremely pure and refined authority within the Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos as her Hyperversal Extremity Authority only became more and more dense, very quickly beginning to exceed any normal Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity as more and more Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of Ruin were born on her body!
When the number of Extremity Rune Scriptures reached 9...
WAA!
A glaring aura rose as another prompt appeared before her.
[You have attained the Zenith of the First Gradation of Extremity.]

[Your soul and very existence require nourishment and refinement from the established Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of Ruin before you can step on the Second Gradation of Extremity.]
An unprecedented glow of power covered her as she released an aura even more terrifying than average Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities.
And yet she was only at the Zenith of the First Gradation of Extremity!
The glow around her was maddeningly glorious and enticing as she opened her eyes soon after, the surrounding space becoming painted obsidian ever so briefly as of her might covered everything.
Her hands unfurled to reveal a Planalith Krystallos that was dim and clear, now seeming like a transparent round and smooth stone that held nothing within it.

An air of profundity and stupendous might circled around her as Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Ruin burned all around her, every part of her still undergoing changes as 9 blinding Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures began to swirl protectively around her figure.
At every moment, they released their authority to infuse and refine her very existence as she grew stronger every second!

The scene of her glory was shown by Noah on the illusory screen as the eyes of the hundreds of beings around them shone, watching the scene of Scriptures they had never seen before as their hearts palpated due to it.
"Extremity can be unreachable and forever in the dreams of others...or as easy as breathing for some. Remember this scene as you seek Extremity- a scene that will be repeated a few times today."
As he spoke, Noah's gaze pointed above where another figure of him could be seen.
It was the Reified Wealdian Source of Vitalistic who currently held 23 Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writs of Extremity.
23 authorities that would have a being with a Planar Boundary achieve Extremity!

The eyes of the Vassals flickered with brilliance as they became focused on the Reified Wealdian Source of Vitalistic, with Noah's main body coming to gaze at the graceful and pure visage of Xiaomi who radiated Hyperversal Extremity Authority as with a wave of his hands, their figures disappeared.
After fluctuations of the spacetime continuum, they reappeared in the depths of the Apollyon Aletheian Haven as Noah's voice thundered out around Xiaomi.
[How close are you with the other Sources of Chaos?]
After one domino fell, others would follow.
This was especially so for a holder of the Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Extremity Foundation of Ruined Chaos!
With a dazzling smile that caused her astonishing figure to radiate even more brilliance, she replied.

[Within the day, I should be able to take one or two of the other Sources of Chaos to Extremity. It will be even faster if I get more of those Planalith Krystallos...but that can come later. You wanted to feel Extremity closely, yes?]
As she spoke, her eyes breezed over the tens of other promptsshe had seen of her Aspects of Existence and her foundation. One prompt was particularly brilliant.

[You have attained the Gradation of Ruined Chaos Extremity Foundation. Dual Cultivation with any existence carrying Sources of Chaos will increase their and your rate of progression towards Extremity and the traversal across the Gradations of Extremity by 10,000,000%!]

[The traversal across the Gradations of Extremity, refinement of your Existence, and the formation of your Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures will accelerate when Dual Cultivating and resonating with the authorities of the True Emperor of Quintessence.]

A myriad of prompts like these had risen in her mind as more continued to come, her graceful figure shining with a powerful light as she instantly disappeared from her position and pounced on the True Emperor of Quintessence.
He had been taking the lead during their discussions of Extremity in the past, but would he still be able to have the upper hand even now?!

With a glimmer of brilliance, a discussion of Extremity began in the depths of the Apollyon Aletheian Haven as near the Aletheian Havens of the Havenly Authorities, other Vassals stared at the Reified Wealdian Source of Vitalistic as yet another round of majesty was about to unveil itself!

chapters.title: Chapter 2714 A Twist of Fate! I
paragraphs: The astonishing scene that had just occurred has been branded into the souls of all, with astonishing effects of course being felt by Xiaomi, but Noah also made great gains!
And the gains only continued to pour in as he began dual cultivating with a genius Zenith First Gradation of Extremity.
When he had met The Adjudicator of Dissolution and bathed in her residual aura of Hyperversal Extremity Authority, he had promised himself to experience Extremity in an even closer sense.

Now, he had done just this as while he discussed Extremity with Xiaomi and felt her Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of Ruin closely, the prompts that showed his own gains from her Advancement showed themselves.
{An existence under your banner has achieved Extremity mainly through your aid and guidance!}
{You are the Third in Recorded History to elevate another being to Extremity before achieving Extremity yourself.}
{You have earned the distinction of Guider of Extremity.}

{The concept taken to Extremity by your Vassals is closely connected to your Source of Ruin. Under the authority of Guider of Extremity, all concepts you aid others in traversing to Extremity can have their False Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures forged by you through the utilization of pure Soul Values and Mana Values. Only 100 False Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures can be built from any one concept, with the capability of building False Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures only becoming possible if the aided concept in your Vassal attains the ranking of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture.}
Noah's eyes had opened wide at this prompt as it thundered down an explosive and heavy ability!

When he attained Extremity II Despoiler, he could forge False Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER in addition to the Golden Tier ones from before, but all of these required heavy reserves of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities as it took a long time to make them, and they always drained him at the end of the day.

But due to the distinction of Guider of Extremity and the fact that he aided his Vassals to achieve Extremity in a concept...he could utilize Mana and Soul Values to enact up to 100 False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures!
He could enact a hundred from Xiaomi currently, and if he guided multiple other concepts on other Vassals to Extremity...he could stack more and more.

When he had hundreds of False Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures ready to be deployed on the battlefield to Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities affected by his Virions...what would they be able to do but tall en masse?!
HUUM!
His Aspects of Existence shone brightly as his body was filled with multiple wild and utterly reality breaking authorities, with the discussion occurring with Xiaomi also coming with its own boons.
{You are closely experiencing the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Ruin within your Dual Cultivating partner.}
{In this state, you can forge the False Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of Ruin with 80% less resource requirements.}

{Increased forging of the False Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of Ruin and close interaction of the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Ruin through Dual Cultivation will eventually allow you to take the infinitesimally small step towards the Extremity Layer of Ruin. Such an action is a pathway of achieving Extremity, but it is recommended that you stop its advancement if it does occur as this pathway isn't enough to trigger Extremity in Quintessence- no matter the authority expressed by your Extremity Meridians.}
The requirements of the concepts considered Dead Paths continued to be just as restrictive.
The elevation of a concept much lower than them- even if they were the same Crimson Consummate Boundaries...
would not trigger their advancement to Extremity with all 81 Boundaries in Noah's Meridians!
Even at the Crimson Consummate level, Quintessence was much, much greater than Ruin.

And then...there was Noah's task of taking them to the ranking of Quintessential Zenith which would theoretically make these concepts even harder to elevate to Extremity, but the rewards and power from it would be that much more obscene.
Quintessence...had to be the first concept that Noah brought to Extremity.
He couldn't do it any other way, or this pathway would forever remain a dead pathway!
But even with such a massive wall before him, Noah was unfettered and free as he knew in his heart what he could and could not achieve.
And Extremity in Quintessence...would be in his grasp soon!
BOOM!

Immense Authority erupted from him as during his discussion of Extremity with Xiaomi, he raised his right hand up and caused the emergence of dense threads of Ruin that when mixed with his Quintessential Hyperversal Mana and Soul Values- vibrant False Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of Ruin began to be forged.

His partner in the discussion of Extremity refocused her eyes at this scene as she blinked at the scene of Extremity Rune Scripture being forged by him, questioning whether she was the one who achieved Extremity or him!?
Waves of authority converged and bloomed in abundance as more tools were added under Noah's belt.

Meanwhile, in addition to the Records of Extremity and Writs of Extremity, he had still been getting thousands of prompts of him receiving the Golden Hyperversal Bones of Gradation, Obsidian Hyperversal Bones of Gradation, and the Hyperversal Marrow Soul Singularities every time his Virion ravaged the affected Extremities and brought them towards true death.

All this loot piled up into a mountain and then became an even bigger mountain after being processed by Ruination, and it was then directed towards the Sporos III of Extremity as this maddening seed surged towards full maturity.

The time for the next tier of the Ash Tree of Gradation to be born was nearing as at that juncture- Apexification would be underway! While this time became ever closer, Noah continued increasing his authority as he currently held 23 complete Writs of Extremity in his hands that represented the true deaths of 230 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities.

His Reified Wealdian Source of Vitalistic held them while looking at his people near the light years domain of the Andromeda Cleaver, a bright light crossing through his eyes as he was about to select a few specific beings that through the twist of fate- were one of the few existences in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven who held Planar Boundaries!

His partner in the discussion of Extremity refocused her eyes at this scene as she blinked at the scene of Extremity Rune Scripture being forged by him, questioning whether she was the one who achieved Extremity or him!?
Waves of authority converged and bloomed in abundance as more tools were added under Noah's belt.

Meanwhile, in addition to the Records of Extremity and Writs of Extremity, he had still been getting thousands of prompts of him receiving the Golden Hyperversal Bones of Gradation, Obsidian Hyperversal Bones of Gradation, and the Hyperversal Marrow Soul Singularities every time his Virion ravaged the affected Extremities and brought them towards true death.

All this loot piled up into a mountain and then became an even bigger mountain after being processed by Ruination, and it was then directed towards the Sporos III of Extremity as this maddening seed surged towards full maturity.
The time for the next tier of the Ash Tree of Gradation to be born was nearing as at that juncture- Apexification would be underway!

While this time became ever closer, Noah continued increasing his authority as he currently held 23 complete Writs of Extremity in his hands that represented the true deaths of 230 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities.

His Reified Wealdian Source of Vitalistic held them while looking at his people near the light years domain of the Andromeda Cleaver, a bright light crossing through his eyes as he was about to select a few specific beings that through the twist of fate- were one of the few existences in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven who held Planar Boundaries!

chapters.title: Chapter 2715 A Twist of Fate! II
paragraphs: The Reified Wealdian Source of Vitalistic was filled with a deep flow of green as the 23 Writs of Extremity in his hands drew in the eyes of all Vassals here.
His face was resonant as it boomed out while looking at everyone.

"It was the destiny and fate for some to achieve Extremity faster than others, but the main thing that will distinguish how far you go up the Gradations of Extremity isn't whether you attained Extremity sooner than others- it is ultimately the concepts taken to Extremity. Watch the processes that will continue to occur and prepare yourselves for when you take your own concepts to Extremity."
WAA!
The light of Oraculum shone as he spoke, his Vassals feeling a gaze of scrutiny as Noah looked at every single one while continuing to speak.
"Kazuhiko, recall your Vitalistic Clones and merge the gains that have been made. Utilize these..."
As Noah spoke, he waved his hands to release a cluster of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity that could smoothly elevate Boundaries to the 17th Layer!
"Utilize these to take your Planar Boundary of Darkness to the 17th Layer as thereafter...you will utilize this Writ to achieve Extremity in it."
Most, or really nearly all of Noah's people were affected by him as their concepts were mainly at the Consummate level, with very few even having Innate ranked concepts!
And there were even fewer with Planar ranked concepts as those who held such concepts...they had expanded themselves as they were attached to a part of them that they wished to bring to Extremity.

Kazuhiko had expanded his own concept of Darkness that bathed his Katana as his eyes trembled at the opportunity, nodding with a blank gaze as a moment later- a verdant clone of him reappeared and merged into his body as he glowed with a radiant light, his hands beginning to absorb the Aeonic Treasures of Extremity around him speedily!
Treasures such as these...Noah had in abundance after collecting so many things through the Infernal Havenly Commerce.
When it came to elevating a Planar Boundary to the 17th Layer? This was even easier due to the low ranking of the concept!
After Kazuhiko, Noah continued to wave his hands out and cause bundles of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity to appear in front of a few specific beings.
"Dr. Hall...take your Planar Boundary of Stomatology and bring it to Extremity."
This unique Doctor had continued to expand his own concepts after he had Noah's aid in elevating Medicine and other concepts that were at the Consummate ranking after Noah touched them.
Stomatology was something Dr. Hall had expanded himself on a whim as it now gave him a chance to take it to Extremity!
Noah didn't stop with this as he continued.
"Shadow Guard Night...take your Planar Boundary of the Scribe and elevate it to Extremity."
WAA!
In a far, distant corner behind the visage of a calm Adelaide who turned towards her with a smile, the figure of a certain Shadow Guard was dazed as a cluster of Loot appeared before her.
She considered herself a minor being in the grand scheme of things as she recorded in her Diary the intricacies of things not commonly mentioned in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

The mundane lives when the True Emperor of Quintessence and his son were farming Spiritual Herbs with his mother- Amelia Osmont. The times when the True Emperor of Quintessence cooks grand feasts in paradisiacal domains where the sandy gold essence of dreams falls like a waterfall from the vibrant skies as Barbatos, Athena, Ophelia, Katelyn, and many others swim in royal seas shimmering with Avalon.

The intricate order and balance of the Enders of Extremity and how sad it makes her that the Infinite Hyperversal Haven secludes them in their own Aletheian Havens. How great would it be if they all took on human forms and joined them in their mundane and laid back adventures?

She recorded all of this in her Diary as eventually, she had an epiphany and expanded the Boundary of the Scribe herself- which made it even easier for her to see and record the Events occurring in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
But she never would have expected such an action from her to lead to this.
Adelaide patted her back to wake her out of her stupor as her gaze became firm, her hands moving forward and taking the opportunity presented before her!
The will of the True Emperor of Quintessence didn't linger as he continued to call out others.
"Maximilian...take your Planar Boundary of the Shattered Emperor and elevate it to Extremity."
The figure of another existence trembled in shock as a cluster of Loot appeared before him.
Who was he? He was the Learnean Lineage Emperor who had failed Apexification and was only going to meet an absolute end!

After his fate was entirely changed and his realm and very existence were altered by the True Emperor of Quintessence, he had expanded the concept of the Shattered Emperor to represent his past self as he would have never expected the ultimate result to be this.
And the voice of the True Emperor of Quintessence continued.
"Cthulhu...take your Planar Boundary of Aether and elevate it to Extremity."
A humanoid form of a Chthonian radiated a purple light of glory at such words as even more Existences were mentioned!
"Athena...take your Planar Boundary of the Inquisitor and elevate it to Extremity."
"Guinevere...take your Planar Boundary of the Connate Beast and elevate it to Extremity."

One being after another was called out as each one felt more shocked than the other, with Noah's gaze then going to another corner where a being radiating an intense crimson light was floating isolated and alone.
He gazed at her while pausing as after a moment, his voice continued to thunder out.
"Lilith, take your Planar Boundary of Hatred and elevate it to Extremity."
The eyes of the Daughter of Hatred opened wide.

The Defiler of Souls saw a cluster of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity as well as a brilliant Golden Absolute Hyperversal Writ of Extremity floating in front of her in a shocking twist of fate as she reacted quickly, her gaze moving up to meet the eyes of the being who had shaken her past self and then given her this shocking opportunity as...
His gaze had already moved away.
He didn't linger on her any longer than he had lingered on all the others.
As if he treated her the same, as if there was no need for any special distinction.
Lilith could feel the faraway gazes of Morgana and Guinevere land on her at this opportunity, but she didn't even gaze back as her eyes became even more stern and filled with power.
With many thoughts rising and falling in her mind, her hand reached out as she grasped onto the Loot before her and began undergoing a stupendous change!

chapters.title: Chapter 2716 One by one!
paragraphs: "Kraken, take your..."
"Anna..."
"Ezekiel..."
"Aurelia..."
"Eowyn...take your Planar Boundary of the Dreamer and elevate it to Extremity."
"Tiamat...take your Planar Boundary of the Draconic Ruler and elevate it to Extremity."

One name after another was called as a bountiful opportunity presented itself to some destined beings, all of them taking it fully as those mentioned first had already devoured the Aeonic Treasures of Extremity to take their Planar Boundaries to the 17th Layer- their hands already grasping the Writ of Extremity in front of them!
Kazuhiko was the first as the Writ of Extremity in front of him was ripped open, an oppressive and absolute authority erupting from it that surged into his very being.

His dark hair wavered in this stellar region as he grasped his katana with his right hand, his face rising up and bellowing out pure Darkness a moment later as a dazzling Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of DARKNESS began to form above him.

His soul and origin would then be taken into this Rune Scripture and be reborn under the grandeur of Extremity, his body broken down and reformed to attain an Extremity Body soon after as all of his Aspects of Existence would display and fully attain Extremity!

Under the eyes of all, yet another process of Extremity was seen as if they held any talent and genius, they could use this to gaze upon the profundities of Extremity and forge their own path- or at the very least make it very easy for themselves when they were also given the resources to take them towards Extremity with their higher ranked concepts.
After Kazuhiko, the others all followed in sequential order they were granted the Loot before, with this order only being broken after Maximilian began his transformation as on the side...
BOOM!
Space shuddered above the visage of the Dimensional Deceiver as a blinding Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of HATRED bloomed.
It radiated a power much more grandiose than those before her as it seemed to resonate with her very soul!
Others expanded their Planar Boundaries based on a memory they reminisce about or simply to explore and experiment.

She had expanded Hatred because it was a part of her life since the very beginning. She was entrenched in hatred and knew it very deeply as at the time of her ascension into an Extremity Lifeform, it resonated with her soul!

Instead of taking on the grandeur of a Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture, half of it was tainted with an Obsidian light as it swallowed up her Aspects of Existence- leaving behind a shell that brimmed with life again soon after and even went further to split and enlarge, the devilish form of the Defiler of Souls descending in its full glory as demonic horns rose on either side of her head, a jewel-like third eye opening on her forehead while a flaming crown of Hyperversal Extremity Authority burned above her.

She seemed like an exotic demoness coming to life as her eyes radiated a profound light of power, her soul burning under the grandeur of Hatred as this was the only concept she would focus on next besides Hatred- the concept of the Soul!

Her advancement was watched by all as she spurred on all the chosen others, with a glorious reality playing out in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven at this moment as fated Vassals stepped on the Gradations of Extremity one after another.
Their glory was their own to witness as in the outside spacetime continuum, reality moved on.
A war raged between Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions.
The Seven Clans and Inheritances delved deeper into the Supernal Havens of Extremity to establish themselves and attain grand opportunities.
The Seven Clans...apart from the Avernus Clan who were faced with a great deal of challenges at this moment.

This was because within their own bases in different Havens, some of their own Extremities had renounced their allegiance to the Avernus Clan and taken the Blood Sources that granted the Heavenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage- many of them deserting their old posts after that as on the rare chance they were found out by other Avernus Extremities...they were still able to leave and fight their way out as they now expressed much greater power than their counterparts!

But the situation was disheartening for both of them as even though they renounced the Avernus Clan and would no longer be involved with it, they had still spent the majority of their lives with this force and made many memories.
They gave it all up for the chance to ascend ever higher across the Gradations of Extremity, with Apex Aeonic Lifeforms doing this for a chance to attain Extremity.
Ever so rapidly, waves of chaos and discourse were spreading across the bases of the Avernus Clan in all Seven Havens!
Another half a day passed.
It was now 2 days since the True Emperor of Quintessence was notified by the authority that defined him that he had seven days to attain Extremity in it or forever lose this path.
At such a juncture, something worthy of note began playing out within the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
Past a few Golden Havenly Archipelagos that were nearest to the misty wall of Dissolution that the Vein Rifts led to.

Atop a golden dreamy floating island, one of the bases of the Infernal Havenly Commerce could be seen. It was bustling with tens of thousands of Existences moving atop it in an orderly manner, each one ready to trade and barter to get as many Blood Sources as they could. The largest numbers were Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, but a few hundred were Hyperversal Extremities that ranged from Tier 1 to Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.

At this moment, the gazes of many rapidly changed as they sensed the descent of an aura much greater than any of these here- an aura filled with infinite heat and majesty as from above, a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity descended with 100 other lower ranked Extremities following behind him!

chapters.title: Chapter 2717 The Hyperversal Bow of Helios! I
paragraphs: All of them were adorned in crimson robes that had a blinding golden infinity symbol etched behind their backs, the gazes of many people changing as they uttered in hushed tones.
{A major force from the Infinite Extremity...isn't that the Esteemed Infinity Scorcher in the lead?}
Infinity Scorcher.
The Extremity of Flames.
The Extremity of Heat.
The Extremity of Ignition.
He held many titles like this as he was one of the Four Hyperversal Tier 4 Extremities publicly known by other forces!
He walked with majesty as his hair shone like crimson flames, his fair skin tainted with a red hue from blistering heat all around him as he seemed like a man in his prime.

A single crimson horn being circled by hundreds of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures could be seen on the center of his forehead, the Extremities behind him holding their own variations as they stepped towards the main trading area of the Infernal Havenly Commerce, many beings making way!
Within moments, the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity came before Noah's figure as they looked at each other serenely.
The crimson robes of the Infinity Scorcher wave majestically as his voice was deep when he spoke.
{We seem to be seeking after the same type of Extremity.}

His eyes were gazing at the crimson infinity symbol etched on the Golden robes adorned by Noah, and the striking similarity it had with the crimson robes adorned by the Infinity Scorcher and those behind him that had a golden infinity symbol!
One was crimson and the other was gold, but both represented infinity.
Noah smiled at the words of this being while nodding.
{Perhaps. But you didn't come here just for that.}

His eyes were filled with mystery and majesty as he spoke, the crimson hair of the Infinity Scorcher pulsing with light as this being squinted his eyes and nodded, waving his hands to reveal a blinding halcyon light that caused many beings to avert their eyes.
When they refocused, their hearts trembled as they felt the contained pressure and majesty of an Armament of Extremity appear in front of the Infinity Scorcher!

Not a Half-Forged Armament of Extremity, but a genuine one that radiated pristine glory as it pulsed with a halo of a crimson gold light- its identity being none other than the Hyperversal Bow of Helios that Noah had seen closely before in the Infinite Oni Haven!

Currently, the blazing Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Helios that would be raging around it for thousands of light years was contained within it as the hands of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity pulsed with Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of FLAMES.

It didn't have a preset barrier like the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity Noah had traded with the Havenly Moon Clan that contained its authority as the pure might of an Extremity holding it reigned in its blazing majesty.
Receiving this would now be a challenge as another Extremity had to grasp it in order for it to exchange hands!
Noah's eyes twinkled as he looked at the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity who thrust his hand holding out the Hyperversal Bow of Helios.
{It's only a Low Grade Armament of Extremity, but I wonder if it can be exchanged for enough Blood Sources?}
The wondrous treasure was placed forward for Noah to take, the eyes of many beings twinkling at this scene as he didn't even rise himself.

Instead, he waved his hands as behind him, a rift that was veiled by an overabundance of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority split apart space as it connected to another spacetime entirely, with the crimson light of Oraculum flashing briefly as from it- the sharp aura of a Hyperversal Extremity walked out!

Her body shone with a stellar obsidian glow as her curves and blessed figure could be the object of envy for trillions of beings, her powerful aura of a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity emanating from her as she carried a golden treasure cache in her hands that was labeled with {LOOT} atop it.

The aura of hundreds of Millions of Blood Sources spilled out from this treasure chest maddeningly as the souls of all beings nearby felt nourished, the figure of Xiaomi stepping out of the rift with it as with a smile, she placed the chest on the feet of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity!

She then patted her hands as she was the one to reach out and accept the Hyperversal Bow of Helios as blinding Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of RUIN swirled over her skin, their might and pressure allowing her to put her hands on the Low Grade Armament of Extremity as the moment she fully grasped it...
BZZT!
The Infinity Scorcher let go of the Bow of Helios as it buzzed in her hands threatening to get out.

But her body only released a dozen more Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures that calmed the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Helios, her face carrying a look of accomplishment as she nodded towards the group of Extremities in front of her and walked back towards the portal pulsing with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!

She was no longer only limited to 9 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures as after her existence was nourished and refined to a sufficiently powerful extent, she was able to move from the Zenith of the First Gradation of Extremity the moment a tenth Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture began to form.
It was then established that a minimum of 9 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures were required before an existence could touch upon the stage of a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity.

But Noah utilized the power of the Extremity he had forged under him to receive the shockingly powerful Hyperversal Bow of Helios, exchanging it for a treasure cache that held 10 Billion Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Sources that when the will of the Infinity Scorcher passed over, he nodded in appreciation while waving his hands- his forces beginning to move out right after as the treasure cache disappeared!
10 Billion.
The Half-Forged Armament of Extremity was traded with 50 Million Blood Sources, but a completed one received so much more! This was just how much more precious a complete Armament was.
The number wasn't explicitly stated, but those in the surroundings could feel the breadth of hundreds of millions of Blood Sources as they drew sharp breaths.

They knew that with this...all of the prominent forces of the Infinite Extremity Inheritance were about to undergo an overhaul of strengthening and elevation as this Aeonic Inheritance would not be the same thereafter!

{A major force from the Infinite Extremity...isn't that the Esteemed Infinity Scorcher in the lead?}
Infinity Scorcher.
The Extremity of Flames.
The Extremity of Heat.
The Extremity of Ignition.
He held many titles like this as he was one of the Four Hyperversal Tier 4 Extremities publicly known by other forces!
He walked with majesty as his hair shone like crimson flames, his fair skin tainted with a red hue from blistering heat all around him as he seemed like a man in his prime.

A single crimson horn being circled by hundreds of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures could be seen on the center of his forehead, the Extremities behind him holding their own variations as they stepped towards the main trading area of the Infernal Havenly Commerce, many beings making way!
Within moments, the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity came before Noah's figure as they looked at each other serenely.
The crimson robes of the Infinity Scorcher wave majestically as his voice was deep when he spoke.
{We seem to be seeking after the same type of Extremity.}

His eyes were gazing at the crimson infinity symbol etched on the Golden robes adorned by Noah, and the striking similarity it had with the crimson robes adorned by the Infinity Scorcher and those behind him that had a golden infinity symbol!
One was crimson and the other was gold, but both represented infinity.
Noah smiled at the words of this being while nodding.
{Perhaps.
But you didn't come here just for that.}

His eyes were filled with mystery and majesty as he spoke, the crimson hair of the Infinity Scorcher pulsing with light as this being squinted his eyes and nodded, waving his hands to reveal a blinding halcyon light that caused many beings to avert their eyes.
When they refocused, their hearts trembled as they felt the contained pressure and majesty of an Armament of Extremity appear in front of the Infinity Scorcher!

Not a Half-Forged Armament of Extremity, but a genuine one that radiated pristine glory as it pulsed with a halo of a crimson gold light- its identity being none other than the Hyperversal Bow of Helios that Noah had seen closely before in the Infinite Oni Haven!

Currently, the blazing Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Helios that would be raging around it for thousands of light years was contained within it as the hands of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity pulsed with Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of FLAMES.

It didn't have a preset barrier like the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity Noah had traded with the Havenly Moon Clan that contained its authority as the pure might of an Extremity holding it reigned in its blazing majesty.
Receiving this would now be a challenge as another Extremity had to grasp it in order for it to exchange hands!
Noah's eyes twinkled as he looked at the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity who thrust his hand holding out the Hyperversal Bow of Helios.
{It's only a Low Grade Armament of Extremity, but I wonder if it can be exchanged for enough Blood Sources?}
The wondrous treasure was placed forward for Noah to take, the eyes of many beings twinkling at this scene as he didn't even rise himself.

Instead, he waved his hands as behind him, a rift that was veiled by an overabundance of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority split apart space as it connected to another spacetime entirely, with the crimson light of Oraculum flashing briefly as from it- the sharp aura of a Hyperversal Extremity walked out!

Her body shone with a stellar obsidian glow as her curves and blessed figure could be the object of envy for trillions of beings, her powerful aura of a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity emanating from her as she carried a golden treasure cache in her hands that was labeled with {LOOT} atop it.

The aura of hundreds of Millions of Blood Sources spilled out from this treasure chest maddeningly as the souls of all beings nearby felt nourished, the figure of Xiaomi stepping out of the rift with it as with a smile, she placed the chest on the feet of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity!

She then patted her hands as she was the one to reach out and accept the Hyperversal Bow of Helios as blinding Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of RUIN swirled over her skin, their might and pressure allowing her to put her hands on the Low Grade Armament of Extremity as the moment she fully grasped it...
BZZT!
The Infinity Scorcher let go of the Bow of Helios as it buzzed in her hands threatening to get out.

But her body only released a dozen more Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures that calmed the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Helios, her face carrying a look of accomplishment as she nodded towards the group of Extremities in front of her and walked back towards the portal pulsing with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!

She was no longer only limited to 9 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures as after her existence was nourished and refined to a sufficiently powerful extent, she was able to move from the Zenith of the First Gradation of Extremity the moment a tenth Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture began to form.
It was then established that a minimum of 9 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures were required before an existence could touch upon the stage of a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity.

But Noah utilized the power of the Extremity he had forged under him to receive the shockingly powerful Hyperversal Bow of Helios, exchanging it for a treasure cache that held 10 Billion Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood Sources that when the will of the Infinity Scorcher passed over, he nodded in appreciation while waving his hands- his forces beginning to move out right after as the treasure cache disappeared!
10 Billion.
The Half-Forged Armament of Extremity was traded with 50 Million Blood Sources, but a completed one received so much more!
This was just how much more precious a complete Armament was.
The number wasn't explicitly stated, but those in the surroundings could feel the breadth of hundreds of millions of Blood Sources as they drew sharp breaths.

They knew that with this...all of the prominent forces of the Infinite Extremity Inheritance were about to undergo an overhaul of strengthening and elevation as this Aeonic Inheritance would not be the same thereafter!

chapters.title: Chapter 2718 The Hyperversal Bow of Helios! II
paragraphs: Many eyes watched the pristine figures of the Infinite Extremity leave with billions of Blood Sources as when seeing such ancient inheritances make a move- they knew that the coming era would be dominated by those who obtained treasures like these.
If someone didn't obtain a Blood Source to acquire the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, they would be left far, far behind all others in the coming future!
While many began having these thoughts, they also began to closely look at the Infernal Havenly Commerce that was trading all of these Blood Sources.
They had seen how this behemoth had already taken in two Armaments of Extremity as they wondered...in the future to come, just how many more wonders would they take in?

Such a future was unknown, but many beings had already begun working on their behalf as there were now a few hundred Extremities who signed up to be Employees of the Infernal Havenly Commerce and spread their wares into the Nether Havens of Extremity!
As for those who couldn't even grasp these Blood Sources?
Their future was grim!
In the Nether Haven of Andromeda.
Within a major base of the Avernus Clan, in a cluster of Major Planes of Existence.
In a small hidden domain in a corner of this base that was known as the Thousand Plane Lilac Cluster, the figures of two beings were hidden within as their eyes carried immense wrath and trepidation!
These two figures were the Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity who was formally respected and distinguished as Destruction, and the other was the past genius who was a disciple under him- Ahpuch!

These two beings stayed in a hidden domain and didn't dare to step out the past days as when they were actively moving about, they were receiving hateful gazes and even silent words from all those around them.
Everyone knew the conflict that Osmont had with them.
And they all knew that it stemmed from the actions of Destruction and his Disciple!

The gradual Deterioration of the Avernus Clan and their hegemony was at times placed on their shoulders as after the last day, Destruction and Ahpuch could not even bring themselves to leave their hidden domain.
They felt as if there was a massive blade hanging over their necks- this blade just waiting to swing down and use them as scapegoats for what had occurred.
They felt as if their very lives were on the line as any day now, the blame would be so much that they may just be killed in anger by the Avernus Extremity Overlord himself!
So these two once prominent Existences lived with trepidation as at this time, their fate seemed infinitely dark.

Meanwhile, the man they had initiated the conflict with had been getting many things ready for a stupendous transformation, with grand changes occurring in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven in the past half a day as these lands welcomed 23 more Hyperversal Extremities in addition to Xiaomi!

Each being was more prominent than the last as Noah had them reform their Vitalistic Clones soon after- this process taking much longer for them as Extremities as even until now, none had completed this task yet as it took a great deal of resources and their Hyperversal Extremity Authority to construct clones of equivalent power.

With the passage of the previous hours, Noah did not sit idly by as his will in the form of the Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum had entered the Recorded History of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity to once more carry out Hyperversal Plundering.
This time, his target had been something that he almost failed to attain as it was halfway through being a completed product of Extremity.

His target had been the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity that he had already attained, and yet he tried Plundering it in the Recorded History as the result was now visible with the scene of two purple light years domains that sat side by side!

It wasn't something easy as it came with heavy restrictions, with the myriad of prompts that had come telling Noah how at his current stage, he could only plunder Half-Forged Armaments of Extremity, and such an act of Plundering could only be done once per object.
It was also outlined that he wouldn't be able to plunder genuine Armaments of Extremity until he himself attained Extremity!
But to him, this was only a matter of time and possibilities.

Because even as two field domains pulsing with Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Andromeda shone brightly in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, Xiaomi reappeared at this time thousands of light years above as her figure released the Low Grade Armament of Extremity from her hands- her figure weary and spent just from holding and reigning it in for a few seconds as the Hyperversal Bow of Helios roared out and released waves of Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Helios!
The Vassals that had just attained Extremity looked at this scene with wonder along with all others, Noah's figure rising up at this moment as he stared at the brilliant Bow of Helios.
Xiaomi came to float beside him looking weary as she spoke with a glimmer of excitement.
{When you grasp it, its details and capabilities begin to unveil themselves, do you want to know? It's utterly ridiculous...}
Her eyes were bright at the sheer majesty of the capabilities that the Hyperversal Bow of Helios showed!
Yet Noah shook his head while opening his palm, his voice ringing out gently.
"I'll find out myself soon enough."
There, in his hands, one could see a dazzling multicolored Seed.
A seed that radiated a pristine light of Quintessence as it had reached full maturity!
It was a Sporos III of Extremity that was ready to bloom into an Ash Tree III of Gradation.
One tool that would be used to scale the Unscalable Wall of Extremity was now in his hands.
The other was Apexification itself as the third Tool...was the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity that he had just obtained through Hyperversal Plundering.

chapters.title: Chapter 2719 Quintessential Apexification! I
paragraphs: One of the tools to aid Noah in scaling an Unscalable Wall was the Plundered Half-Forged Armament of Extremity!
This was because after his first Vacuous Awakening, Noah had attained the {Hyperversal I Assimilation} authority that gave him a glimpse into the power of Vacuous Malignancies.

This feature was then elevated to Hyperversal II Assimilation as it allowed him to devour and assimilate treasures, existences, concepts...any Records laying before him as he could apply the authority of what he devoured towards the progression of his Realm, fortifying his foundation, or even towards the elevation of his concepts.
The reason for him to Plunder the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity even though he already had one...was to prepare the plundered one that he would devour and assimilate.
With all of these means, if he couldn't break through the Unscalable Wall of Extremity and forge a soul unlike any other across Recorded History...then nobody would ever be able to do such a thing!
HUUM!

Reality began to buzz as he threw out the Sporos III of Extremity in his hands, watching it land and become anchored near the plundered Half-Forged Armament of Extremity as it began to release waves of multicolored light- an ancient illusory tree beginning to emerge from it.
His main body then appeared beside the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity that he couldn't yet grasp as his visage then began to suffuse with a Quintessential light.
His breath was steady as he had brought himself to the precipice of a grand achievement.
The realm and progression of others were simple as they became Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and then sought and fought for Extremity.

Yet he had already grasped multiple parts of Extremity even before undergoing Apexification as he had Eyes of Extremity, and he could forge False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures en masse!
And on this day, after a great deal of preparations...
"It is time."
BOOM!
His words thundered out across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as they meant many things.

First, an indomitable and breathtaking illusory tree appeared as its grandeur flashed across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven- the might of the Ash Tree III of Gradation making itself visible to as as streams of multicolored rivers of light made its branches that all began to flicker and surge towards Noah!
Second, his body began to give off an undeniable glow as Hyperversal II Assimilation was activated, a heavy pull surrounding the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity as it began to tremble!
And then....
SAA!
Space flickered as beside Noah's main body, another figure came to be.
It was none other than the recalled figure of Alexander King.
It was time for the Vitalistic Clone to rerun to Noah, along with the stupendous gains that had been made as he would be even greater fuel for a shockingly Quintessential foundation.
It was most definitely time!
Without a delay, the body of Alexander King turned into radiant verdant light that thundered into Noah's Aspects of Existence.
And at the same time...Noah's Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds flickered and boomed out as his voice reverberated commandingly.
"Apexification."
A Refulgence of light exploded.
An array of prompts danced around Noah!

As the might of the Ash Tree III of Gradation descended, the chosen Havenly Authority was determined to be Penumbra- the mighty tree towering over the Infinite Hyperversal Haven bathed and radiating obsidian tendrils of light within their branches that all sank into Noah's as if he was an ancient singularity.
{The Seventh Aletheian Haven is continuing its forging.}

He had Seven Aletheian Havens already established as the last one had a small portion of it completed with the Havenly Authority of Oceanus, with the other portion of the Seventh Haven now beginning to burst forth with an obsidian light as Penumbra came forth.
{The First Havenly Boundary Layer of Penumbra has been attained.}
{The Second...}
Prompts came and went, but some were more important than others as Noah classified them into separate quadrants, his eyes focusing on the ones that would determine his future path with intensity.
{You have completed the cycle of life and death by returning your Vitalistic Clone into your existence.}
{Your Clone achieved stupendous feats and enacted reality sundering Meridians!}
{The accomplishments and Records of the Vitalistic Clone are being assimilated into your foundation.}
There were the prompts of his assimilation of Alexander that came first as thereafter, there were the wonders of the Ash Tree III of Gradation, Half-Forged Armament of Extremity, and Apexification.
{Your Quintessential Hyperversal Soul has reached the highest peak it can before scaling the Unscalable Wall of Extremity.}
{The authority of the Ash Tree III of Gradation seeks a pathway as it cannot strengthen your soul any longer.}
{You are the 9th Existence to reach the highest possible level of the Soul recorded throughout history before attaining Extremity!}
His soul had been refined and strengthened so much that it could not undergo any more strengthening.
It had arrived and was knocking on the door of the Unscalable Wall of Extremity as if he could not overcome it, his soul could not grow stronger.
And thus....came his other prepared means.
{Hyperversal II Assimilation is grasping at the authority of the Andromeda Cleaver!}

The dazzling Half-Forged Armament of Extremity plundered from a Recorded History before him seemed to come alive with flames of unwillingness, and yet parts of it began to flake off and merge into Noah's body that seemed to be the center of a heavy storm within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven currently.

His people watched from a far distance as they were gobsmacked at the variety of authorities surging around him, each one with more intensity than the others as even when Xiaomi and other Vassals attained Extremity, it wasn't this wild.
And yet they knew...the True Emperor of Quintessence before them was only undergoing his Apexification at this moment.
What if his enemies knew what was happening?
What if the Tier 1 and Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities he had killed knew that they died even before he underwent Apexification?!

What if the Avernus Extremity Overlord and the few other Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities under this behemoth of a Clan knew that their force was being systematically broken down by an existence that was only now undergoing Apexification?
Their eyes would roll back as their souls may just fracture from shock and disbelief alone!
But none of this mattered to the being himself as after flakes of the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity began to flow into his body, his will made the decision.
{The target of Hyperversal II Assimilation has been determined to be the soul.}
{The assimilated authority of a Half-Forged Armament of Extremity is being directed into your Quintessential Hyperversal Soul!}
BOOM!
A heavy thud emanated from Noah's body that emanated across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, the souls of his people shuddering and resonating with this thud as they moved back in astonishment.
It was a heavy knock on the Unscalable Wall of Extremity that produced it as not too long after...
BOOM!
The explosive thud echoed out again as the True Emperor of Quintessence sought to break this wall entirely!
