chapters.title: Chapter 2720 Quintessential Apexification! II
paragraphs: 2720 Quintessential Apexification! II
A scene of Quintessential glory!
It was witnessed by a select few as if the True Emperor of Quintessence wished for it, even their eyes would be masked and not be able to gaze upon any part of his transformation.
But they had access to observe because they had to see what was possible.
They had to see that even the impossible and Unscalable could be made possible and scaled!

In the corner of the erupting domain field of the Hyperversal Bow of Helios that spread out its Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of HELIOS for thousands of light years, the visage of a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity could be seen.
Her identity was a simple one as she was a Shadow Guard under the moniker of Night, and she was one of the only beings who was recording down a record of what was currently occurring.

Hyperversal Extremity Authority of the Scribe danced around her and formed into a golden pen that was constantly writing on a massive and ancient looking white gold tome- a tome that had as its title [The Quintessential Apexification of the True Emperor of Quintessence]!
Within it, The Scribe recorded down everything she saw as astonishing sentences could be seen constantly etched on this ancient looking book.
[...His body took the center point of multiple converging authorities as he swallowed them in with a pace that put Singularities to shame.
A celestial tree extended its branches into him and bathed him with indomitable might, his tower like Havens barely being discernable as the Seventh one was almost completed!

The Half-Forged Armament of Extremity that many of them couldn't even near a day ago was breaking off piece by piece- somehow being devoured by his existence as if a pristine item like this could only be something that could supplement and add to his glory.
And then to the shock and awe of all his people...his Meridian Seeds began to light up and bloom.
His Aspects of Existence began to be drawn into these blooming seeds as they were rising to become endless pillars of multicolored light that represented Hyperversal Extremity Meridians!

Wondrously, his body began to be drawn in as an illusory multicolored shell of light remained visible to all. His soul still pervaded across his existence as a part of it was taken into the Meridians, with the rest of it staunch and unmoving.
Even more drastic, an outline of his tower like Origin remained undaunted.
It didn't even move a single step to be taken into the blooming Meridians as its stature seemed far too pristine and unchanging!
And then...the blooming Meridians roared out in a fervent valor of majesty as...
No way...]
The Hyperversal Extremity Authority of the Scribe trembled as the body of Night also trembled while she gazed forward.
Geniuses had at most 9 or 10 Meridians when they completed their Apexification. Even in their Infinite Hyperversal Haven, the highest numbers were upwards of 24 or 36!
Noah already showed 81 blinding Extremity Meridian Seeds blooming, but the scene that caused even Night's Hyperversal Extremity Authority to stutter in its recording was even more astonishing.
[...An unforeseen glory.
Before all of our eyes, in addition to the 81 blooming Meiridans within the body of the Tyrannical Emperor, another 81 bloomed opposite them in a moment that drew utter silence from all.
Silence for the immensity of the achievement.
Silent for the grandeur of the True Emperor of Quintessence!
Silence for those who chose to be his enemies.
For his enemies...their souls may not have a shred of hope or mercy after this!]
The Scribe continued to record.
Others continued to gaze at the transformation in shock!
And yet the True Emperor of Quintessence thundered forward to enact an unequaled Foundation!

The rest of his tools to scale an unscalable wall were utilized as while flakes of a Half-Forged Armament of Extremity entered his body and struck at the wall preventing his soul from getting any stronger, other parts of his existence were shimmering and undergoing even grander transformations as his blooming 81 Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds came alive at this moment.
But...they weren't alone as after assimilating the existence of Alexander and other unknown factors, there were now 81 illusory Hyperversal Extremity Meridians standing opposite them!
162 Meridians!

The newly appearing 81 Meridians took in more of his soul to refine and transform it as paired with the assimilated essence of a Half-Forged Armament of Extremity and the waves of authority from the Ash Tree III of Gradation...
BOOM!
The explosive knock on the Unscalable Wall of Extremity was faced with a thudding sound as if it were now knocking on a hollow tree.
As if another few knocks would make way!

Noah could feel this in his soul as he felt like he was hammering away with multiple different tools, each one hitting different avenues of his soul as after being compressed and enriched over and over again, it could only continue its advent upwards.
BOOM!
The nearby thousands of light years of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven began to tremble with the boons of Noah's soul.
Those watching felt as if their own souls were booming as they scrambled back in shock and horror.

Noah felt the time nearing and coming ever closer as he couldn't take it anymore, Quintessence shining all around him as what remained of his illusory body clenched his fist and expanded his chest, breathing in like an abyssal singularity as his existence took in every remaining chunk of the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity- his whole existence illuminating like a multicolored sun as he bellowed out!
[OOOOH!]

A thundering bellow thundered out as the souls of all existences that had yet to reach Extremity were overwhelmed by the sheer pressure and immensity as their eyes rolled back and their consciousness was momentarily brought to a halt.

A few like Henry fell down to their knees as his pure Lineage held up his soul and prevented him from losing consciousness right away as a light from the very Infinite Hyperversal Haven enveloped him and others just as a security measure!

The 23 Vassals that had achieved Extremity felt their Hyperversal Extremity Authority shaken as it inherently trembled as if the advent of a much grander authority made their very concepts of Extremity want to kneel!

chapters.title: Chapter 2721 Quintessential Apexification! III
paragraphs: 2721 Quintessential Apexification! III
A bellow that caused all those who weren't Extremity Lifeforms to lose consciousness with the exception of a select few!
Even beings in the depths of the Aletheian Havens millions of light years away heard it as they were overwhelmed by its sheer majesty and temporarily fell into a slumber.

On the bodies of the 23 Vassals that had attained Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity and on Xiaomi...they felt as if their concepts of Extremity were shuddering and bowing down at the oncoming oppression as...
BOOM...CRACK!
A door was breached.
A wall was smashed so many times that it couldn't help but begin to crack.
And once a single crack was established...
BOOM!
Everything else would be blown to oblivion!
At this moment, every authority came to a standstill.
For a brief instant.
Thereafter, everything raged in a controlled and systematic manner as finally, the dense waves of authority from the Ash Tree III of Gradation surged into his soul.
The waves of authority from a digesting Half-Forged Armament of Extremity surged into his soul.
And the process of Apexification continued and sought to transform his soul!
But...it had exceeded an uncrossable boundary.
It could not be categorized the same way that it was before as the processes that were happening and trying to alter the soul were all not accepted.
The authorities came to a standstill once more.
Noah's soul shone with brilliance as at this very moment, it had taken just a single tiny step forward that demarcated the level of the soul of a Non-
Extremity and an Extremity.
But for one to have an Extremity Soul...they had to have their existence swallowed up by the first Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture they forged!
The Rune Scripture would then alter their Soul and release an Extremity Soul thereafter.
Noah had watched this process himself twice a dozen times in the past day.
So without a genuine Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture...how would he have his Extremity Soul forged?
It was the question and conundrum that caused everything to come to a standstill at this moment!
And yet...booming prompts that foretold of the answers came.
[A Quintessential Achievement Unrecorded across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!]
[You have scaled a wall impossible for your level of life to scale!]
[Your soul has thoroughly stepped into a stage only those that have attained Extremity can achieve.]
[A monumental achievement that has yet to receive any honorariums in the eons of Recorded History!]
BOOM!
With the advent of these prompts, the space above Noah split wide open as Records were torn and ripped apart.
And from the torn records descended a shocking Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture that radiated pure milky white transparent light.
It read [VITALIS] and caused the Extremity Souls of Xiaomi and the other Extremity Vassals to entirely bend down and kneel!
It was massive and small in stature at the same time as it seemed to be towering over the forged Aletheian Havens below.

But before this shocking Rune Scripture could do anything, another booming sound echoed out as the torn records were spread out ever wider, a roar of glory and valor coming out as an inky black Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture reading [VACUOUS] also descended!
These two immense Scriptures hung above Noah and seemed to buzz with utmost glory, all other authorities remaining still as his soul began to be drawn up towards them.

[The Quintessential Achievement that is being recorded for the first time has allowed the Honorarium of Extremity Sanctification of the Soul by Hyperversal Havenly Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures.]
[The change and future ushered forth by this is unknown.]
In equal proportions, half by half, his soul was taken into the Rune Scriptures of VITALIS and VACUOUS.
Everything was utterly silent until every shred of his soul was devoured by the blinding Scriptures.
In this instant of time, Noah felt like he experienced an indeterminate number of years.
He felt like he saw countless things, and yet saw nothing.
His soul buzzed as an instant later, this sensation faded as his soul was released onto the illusory shell that was his body and the vibrant Origin with Seven Aletheian Havens in it!
The instant it came out of the massive Rune Scriptures, everything changed as Xiaomi and the others sank evermore in their kneeling positions.
The instant that parts of his soul began to be released, the authorities that were at a standstill finally surged with fervor as they were now able to sink into it freely.
They were able to permeate across his soul and further strengthen it as...
[You have Scaled the Unscalable Wall of Extremity and come out of the other side with a unique Extremity Soul.]
[You have attained an Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul!]
[You are the first Existence in Recorded History to achieve a type of Extremity Soul before taking a Concept to Extremity!]
Glorious prompts came as above, the Rune Scriptures of VITALIS and VACUOUS receded into the folds of Records.
Two parts of Noah's soul had come from them and filled up a single body, everything coming together with brilliance and wonder as his soul filled his Body and Origin.
Subtle and not so subtle changes began across his existence as his body no longer remained illusory, a new body etched from his Meiridans and Soul as after a few short seconds...
HUUM!
His eyes opened wide.
He floated in space as around him, authorities were fully swallowed into his existence as in his Origin, a seventh Haven released glorious brilliance as an Eighth one began to be forged.
And his body...radiated such an intense aura that made even Xiaomi and the others feel suffocated!
The aura that he released was suffocating to even Tier 2 and Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities!
Why was this?
Both he and them now held Extremity Souls, but his was a unique one as he had undergone Extremity Sanctification of the Soul by Hyperversal Havenly Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures.
It was always Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
Yet now, the Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Extremity Authority descended and were the ones to allow the Extremity Sanctification of his soul!
They didn't glow gold, obsidian, or crims
on as they seemed out of these ranks entirely.
Achieving an Extremity Soul from these concepts...just what did it bring?

chapters.title: Chapter 2722 Quintessential Apexification! IV
paragraphs: Every shred of his soul had been taken into the dazzling Rune Scriptures of VITALIS and VACUOUS and was released as a unique type of Extremity Soul!
Every shred.
The different parts of his soul spread across the Vitalis Havens.

His Reified Source of Quintessence taking the form of a Vacuous I Entity. His body following the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity Titanosaurus who was leading him to a unique domain within the Obsidian Havenly Saurischian Archipelago.
His body that was situated in front of the Adjudicator of Dissolution whose gaze towards him changed greatly at this moment!
{You...have achieved Extremity?!}

She had felt the body before her become entirely empty as a moment later, it was filled with a shockingly abundant and powerful Extremity Soul that radiated a ferocious power that was only increasing with every passing second.

When the eyes of the clone before her opened again, his aura seemed distinguished and far above others as when his nine pupils landed on her, the Adjudicator of Dissolution felt a sense of discomfort!
What was this? She- an Adjudicator of a Haven at the Zenith of Tier 3, felt uncomfortable under the gaze of a being that had just become an Extremity?

She very soon realized that it wasn't that the Extremity Soul was more powerful than hers, it was just that its gaze felt particularly penetrative and authoritative compared to her own soul as this was the cause of the sense of uncomfortability!
His newly opened eyes blinked as reality seemed to become dimmer and brighter with every blink.

He seemed to be getting accustomed to his new soul and eyes as they were focused on the Adjudicator of Dissolution, his words emanating out with grand stature and authority at this moment as he replied to her question.
{No...not Extremity. I have merely undergone Apexification.}
Words that caused the eyes of the Adjudicator to flutter boomed out.
What...the fuck did this even mean? His very being emanated the grandeur of an Extremity Soul, so of course he had achieved Extremity! Yet...why did his words not contain a hint of falsehood?!

As the mind of the Adjudicator of Dissolution buzzed, Noah's eyes that expressed the power of his new Soul continued to gaze at her as he tilted his head to the left as if he found something peculiar.
His voice echoed out soon after as his words were calm, but they felt like thunderous booms of life and death in front of the Adjudicator of Dissolution.
{Nevermind that though...why is it that you have inborn Innate Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians, and your very existence seems to have as its source Vacuous Hyperversal Authority?}
BOOOM!
The first display of what his new Extremity Soul was capable of.
He gazed at a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity and instantly saw something within her that was hidden at the very core of her existence.

He spoke words that caused the Adjudicator of Dissolution to shudder before a moment later, her veiled face of shocking beauty became utterly ashen as a dense number of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures erupted from her and covered everything in this domain!

And yet before her, the clone of the being expressing an Extremity Soul kept his utmost calm in the face of blooming Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures as his voice continued to ring out.

{If I wanted to expose you, I have many bodies stretched out across these Havens that can do so in a heartbeat. Vacuous or Vitalis...does not matter to me. All I have is curiosity...and your existence in the Senatus of Extremity and Curagulus of Extremity has made me very, very curious.}
His eyes glimmered with majesty as he spoke with a smile even under the blatant threat of a terrifying Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.
An Extremity whose blooming authority slowly calmed with the passing seconds as in the next instant, the veil that always adorned her face was torn down, revealing an astonishing visage underneath!
What boons did achieving an Extremity Soul in the manner that Noah achieved it bring?
The answer was an Astounding one as Noah's nine pupils radiated a terrifying light of blankness as he took everything in!

{{Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul}:: An achievement Unrecorded in the eons of History that have passed. It is a type of soul gained before the True Emperor of Quintessence elevated any concept to Extremity, ushering the appearance of the Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VITALIS and VACUOUS to descend as the Honorarium for such an achievement. Eight other beings have touched upon the Unscalable Wall, and the True Emperor of Quintessence was the first one to cross this wall before attaining Extremity. Under this type of Extremity Soul, all the concepts currently within your Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians are being elevated from Consummate to the ranking of Quintessential Zenith, with future concepts placed in your Meridians and nourished by your soul completing this process within a day. The veil between Havenly Extremity Authorities and Infernal Extremity Authority is now non-existent in your eyes as the secrecy and information that couldn't be accessed before within the Vacuous and Vitalis Annals of Extremity becomes accessible to your soul. The impossible task of taking Quintessence to Extremity has been made manageable by the Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul, with this concept currently being enriched as within the following days, it has a much greater chance of being elevated to Extremity....}

{... Utilizing other means on top of your Extremity Soul will only hasten this process as the path of waiting for your 9 Aletheian Havens to be completed is now not the only Quintessential Path of Extremity. Enough achievements have been stacked by your existence as if it were correlated to any other concept, it would have achieved Extremity a day ago. Furthermore, any Planar, Innate, and Consummate Boundaries can be feely taken to Extremity after bathing in the light of your Soul for Three, Six, and Nine Days respectively. With your Soul reaching the stage of Extremity and yet no concepts achieving this same stage, you are in a unique position across Recorded and Unrecorded Histories. The power behind Existences who have achieved Extremity lie in their Rune Scriptures, and yet you have no Rune Scriptures born from your soul. Such a reality leaves a lot of things in the realm of the unknown as it will require exploration to see just what you are capable of, with the limits currently unknown. With this soul, there only remains a word of caution as with it, attaining Extremity for you through lesser concepts at the ranks of Planar, Innate, or Consummate has become incredibly easy as it may occur in a passing thought. For the sake of attaining Extremity in Quintessence, it cautions you to stop the formation of any lesser Rune Scripture before it and halt the advancement of any concept towards Extremity before it- lest you jeopardize your advancement of Quintessence to Extremity...}

As the mind of the Adjudicator of Dissolution buzzed, Noah's eyes that expressed the power of his new Soul continued to gaze at her as he tilted his head to the left as if he found something peculiar.
His voice echoed out soon after as his words were calm, but they felt like thunderous booms of life and death in front of the Adjudicator of Dissolution.
{Nevermind that though...why is it that you have inborn Innate Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians, and your very existence seems to have as its source Vacuous Hyperversal Authority?}
BOOOM!
The first display of what his new Extremity Soul was capable of.
He gazed at a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity and instantly saw something within her that was hidden at the very core of her existence.

He spoke words that caused the Adjudicator of Dissolution to shudder before a moment later, her veiled face of shocking beauty became utterly ashen as a dense number of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures erupted from her and covered everything in this domain!

And yet before her, the clone of the being expressing an Extremity Soul kept his utmost calm in the face of blooming Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures as his voice continued to ring out.
{If I wanted to expose you, I have many bodies stretched out across these Havens that can do so in a heartbeat.
Vacuous or Vitalis...does not matter to me.
All I have is curiosity...and your existence in the Senatus of Extremity and Curagulus of Extremity has made me very, very curious.}
His eyes glimmered with majesty as he spoke with a smile even under the blatant threat of a terrifying Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.
An Extremity whose blooming authority slowly calmed with the passing seconds as in the next instant, the veil that always adorned her face was torn down, revealing an astonishing visage underneath!
What boons did achieving an Extremity Soul in the manner that Noah achieved it bring?
The answer was an Astounding one as Noah's nine pupils radiated a terrifying light of blankness as he took everything in!
{{Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul}:: An achievement Unrecorded in the eons of History that have passed.

It is a type of soul gained before the True Emperor of Quintessence elevated any concept to Extremity, ushering the appearance of the Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VITALIS and VACUOUS to descend as the Honorarium for such an achievement.
Eight other beings have touched upon the Unscalable Wall, and the True Emperor of Quintessence was the first one to cross this wall before attaining Extremity.

Under this type of Extremity Soul, all the concepts currently within your Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians are being elevated from Consummate to the ranking of Quintessential Zenith, with future concepts placed in your Meridians and nourished by your soul completing this process within a day.

The veil between Havenly Extremity Authorities and Infernal Extremity Authority is now non-existent in your eyes as the secrecy and information that couldn't be accessed before within the Vacuous and Vitalis Annals of Extremity becomes accessible to your soul.

The impossible task of taking Quintessence to Extremity has been made manageable by the Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul, with this concept currently being enriched as within the following days, it has a much greater chance of being elevated to Extremity....}

Utilizing other means on top of your Extremity Soul will only hasten this process as the path of waiting for your 9 Aletheian Havens to be completed is now not the only Quintessential Path of Extremity.
Enough achievements have been stacked by your existence as if it were correlated to any other concept, it would have achieved Extremity a day ago.
Furthermore, any Planar, Innate, and Consummate Boundaries can be feely taken to Extremity after bathing in the light of your Soul for Three, Six, and Nine Days respectively.
With your Soul reaching the stage of Extremity and yet no concepts achieving this same stage, you are in a unique position across Recorded and Unrecorded Histories.
The power behind Existences who have achieved Extremity lie in their Rune Scriptures, and yet you have no Rune Scriptures born from your soul.
Such a reality leaves a lot of things in the realm of the unknown as it will require exploration to see just what you are capable of, with the limits currently unknown.

With this soul, there only remains a word of caution as with it, attaining Extremity for you through lesser concepts at the ranks of Planar, Innate, or Consummate has become incredibly easy as it may occur in a passing thought.

For the sake of attaining Extremity in Quintessence, it cautions you to stop the formation of any lesser Rune Scripture before it and halt the advancement of any concept towards Extremity before it- lest you jeopardize your advancement of Quintessence to Extremity...}

chapters.title: Chapter 2723 Quintessential Apexification! V
paragraphs: Quintessence sought to be first.
It had to be first- it was in the name and distinction!

The last portion of the details of his Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul was actually commandeered by Quintessence to tell Noah that with his soul, he could achieve Extremity in lesser concepts as easily as just thinking.

If he found himself crossing the 17th Boundary Layer and going towards the Extremity Layer in any concept that wasn't Quintessence...he had to actually halt such a process as Quintessence had to be first.
To attain Extremity in this dead path, Noah had been stacking one Quintessential Achievement after another!

Scaling and Unscalable Wall was only another one of these grand achievements as it had brought him all that much closer, loosening the grand locks and restrictions around Quintessence as the means Noah could use to attain Extremity in it were expanded.
The main pathway was of course to establish all the 9 Aletheian Havens.
But...he could also try other methods like refining a Quintessence Planalith Krystallos!
His Achievements were grand enough.

He may just be able to do it! Then, there were the other wonders of his Extremity Soul that included an overabundance of things, but the most terrifying thing of all...was the fact that he lay on the realm of Recorded and Unrecorded Histories where his soul didn't have a lot of things to compare to, and so the limits of what it could do were unknown!
It was an Extremity Soul, and yet it didn't hold its own Extremity Rune Scripture.
When Noah's will now gazed at his surroundings with this new soul, he felt as if the secrets of Extremity were laying themselves bare before his very eyes.

His clone that was next to the Adjudicator of Dissolution had just opened its eyes when it saw across the veils of secrecy and found out the fact that the Adjudicator of the Haven that had begun the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification was actually a Vacuous Hyperversal Extremity!
When his main body gazed at the space of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven around him, he could see the myriad of swirling authorities and their ebb and flow.
He could see the branches of the Ash Tree III of Gradation give its last vestiges of authority unto him as it left behind a glimmer of a Sporos IV of Extremity.

He felt undulations of pristine authority within his Origin as the Seventh Aletheian Haven was completed...and the authority of the Ash Tree III of Gradation had enough remaining to even begin forging the beginnings of his Eighth Aletheian Haven.
He had to forge Nine Aletheian Havens, and he had already started on the Eighth!
Along with all this, his Apexification had brought forth an Unfathomable reality.
{You have attained 162 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians!}
{The concepts contained within are transforming into the rank of Quintessential Zenith.}
{Your Innate Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians are being bathed by your Extremity Soul and strengthened by the process of Apexification as they begin to transform.}
All parts of him advanced forward as he could feel Quintessence and all of his other concepts exceed the bounds of the Crimson Consummate level and achieve a stage that had Quintessence in its name.
Their Layers were further modified and elevated.
It also meant the Dynamis they made were even more elevated compared to before!

Of course, an advancement of concepts to the Quintessential Zenith level also meant the prominent layers of some particularly astounding concepts- like the concept of Quintessence itself...had its boundary layers elevated in a ridiculous fashion.

{The Seventeenth Boundary Layer of Quintessence has taken the reigns of the elevation towards Quintessential Zenith, allowing the immeasurable advancement of the Quintessential Hyperversal Ash Tree IV of Gradation that blooms from the Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos IV of Extremity to continue elevating and refining your Extremity Soul with half of its authority, while the other half of the authority can now be utilized to elevate your Aletheian Havens not just with the Havenly Authorities stemming from the Vitalis Havens of Extremity, but also the Infernal Authorities of the Vacuous Havens of Extremity. This process requires the penetration of Records far from your current location as it makes the maturity of Sporos of Extremity even more difficult...}
A ridiculous authority came to be due to a myriad of factors.

The already astonishing effects of the Ash Tree of Gradation were further elevated as apart from the Havenly Authorities, Noah was going to pay a heavy cost to also gain access to Infernal Authorities.

It laid out the ground work for a glorious future as at this time, Noah continued to ascertain the changes within him as prompts continued to rise here and there, but what he truly wanted to do...was to tear the Limits of his Extremity Soul that even its description stated were unknown.
He would be the one to test them and quantify just what this Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul could do!
And when he arrived at such a thought, his eyes that were now flung wide open gazed all around him.

They passed over the kneeling Xiaomi and 23 other Extremities as the pressure radiating from his eyes only continued to become more maddening even to their souls, their heads unconsciously brought down as they couldn't meet his gaze straight on!
His gaze felt like that of an ancient emperor Unrecorded in eons past as he could see through the deepest secrets within their souls in a single glance.
After his gaze passed over his people, it came to land on billowing crimson gold Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of HELIOS that was being released from a single Low Grade Armament of Extremity.
Xiaomi had barely been able to hold it for a few seconds before she had to let go, and she was a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity with only Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures.
If Noah wanted to test the limits of his soul...what better way was there than grasping something that only Hyperversal Extremities could?
With a thought, his whole body pulsed with brilliance.
And an instant later, he bypassed the thousands of light years of billowing Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of HELIOS and appeared inches away from the terrifying Hyperversal Bow of Helios.
The blazing authority that used to give him pressure before...felt like a seaside breeze over his existence currently.

And the Armament of Extremity before him that if one clasped, it meant they had already achieved Extremity or were establishing their Extremity Layer...it felt like any other object before his Extremity Soul as his hand reached out!
His hand that was bathed with his Extremity Soul across every single atom.
KAA!

It's proximity to the Hyperversal Bow of Helios caused a fearsome cry to ring out from this Armament of Extremity, and yet the approaching hand swiped from right to left as with a glimmer of majesty and a booming glory, the hand bathed in Quintessence landed on the Armament of Extremity and clasped it tightly!

chapters.title: Chapter 2724 Appalling Might! I
paragraphs: An Armament of Extremity could not be touched by those who had not achieved Extremity.
It was yet another unbreakable rule that on this day, the True Emperor of Quintessence violated.
His right hand reached out and grasped onto the grip of the Hyperversal Bow of Helios as this Armament of Extremity buzzed in his hands!

His Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul was bathing all of his being as changes continued to occur in his body, with his grasp on the bow before him being unshakable as the purest and densest waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Helios burned themselves on his stellar skin.
And yet his figure remained unfettered as after buzzing in his palm for another few seconds, the Hyperversal Bow of Helios calmed as Noah's Soul began to cover it entirely.
As his will entered it, it also returned a feedback of itself as extremely Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Helios danced and resonated with Noah's Extremity Soul.
[An astonishing feat!]
[Before taking any concept to Extremity, you have grasped onto an Armament of Extremity and dominated its will!]
[The Seventeenth Havenly Boundary Layer of Helios is taking great strides towards Extremity.]
[An infinitesimally small distance is left between the 17th Havenly Boundary Layer of Helios and the Extremity Layer of Helios!]
Grasping an Armament of Extremity meant that one was at this stage or was undergoing the changes to achieve it.
Millions of streams of information about Helios flowed into Noah's mind feely after grasping the Hyperversal Bow of Helios as it instantly took this Boundary of the precipice of Extremity.
It felt like if Noah concentrated just a little bit more...he may be able to take that infinitesimally small step and come out the other side.
But...
'Suppress.'
He had to actively stop this process as Helios was not the first Boundary he had to achieve Quintessence in.
His path was a stellar one.
What others considered Dead Paths and could never traverse- this was what he would take to Extremity first. It remained Quintessence!
So instead of focusing on the Extreme of Helios that the Bow of his hands was resonating, he instead focused on its information.
It no longer radiated the light years domain of Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Helios as the moment Noah grasped it, all of this power and grandiose might seemed to be contained within.
Its shape became clear.
It was a longbow that was nearly as tall as him, the limbs of the bow simmering with a crimson gold color as on its surface, Rune Scriptures of HELIOS could be seen constantly moving.

The grip at the center of the bow was near the arrow rest where an arrow would be knocked, with a Singularity of blazing gold etched at the very center of this grip as Noah's palm was centered on it- this being the area that would devour waves of resources to activate the Hyperversal Bow of Helios and knock an arrow!

The bow tips were curved like sharp mountains as it seemed like they could be used as spear tips for close combat, while the bowstring...it seemed so infinitely sharp that the fingers of even a weak Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity may be shredded if they tried to pull back such a bow string!
The whole weapon gave off a Havenly glow of gold and crimson as its details unveiled themselves before Noah.

[[Hyperversal Bow of Helios]:: A Low Grade Armament of Extremity that was formed naturally in the center of a Haven that bore the metalloid of Helionium. Due to a Havenly Authority being at its very core, an existence with Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures is most ideal in the usage of this weapon as an Extremity with the backing of only Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures cannot support its output of this weapon. Among the ranks of Armaments of Extremity, its purpose is to display and release the quickest output of the Havenly Authority of Helios, its speed being at the very top of Low Grade Armaments of Extremity. At its base use, knocking back the String of Helios will require 100 Extremity Soul Values and 100,000 Extremity Mana Values as this will form a [Hyperversal Projectile of Helios]- an arrow containing 9 Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures of Helios at its core. The [Hyperversal Projectile of Helios] exceeds the bounds of spacetime continuum, reality, and existence as the selected target can be reached with 100% certainty regardless of their location in the Axis of space and time, or if they exist outside of it. If you are capable of observing their Records in real time, one can be selected as a target as this doesn't require any change in usage...]

[...If the target is pursued in Recorded or Unrecorded Histories, this will require ten times the Extremity Soul Value to enact a [Hyperversal Projectile of Helios] that can pursue an enemy in their Recorded or Unrecorded History. Once hit by a [Hyperversal Projectile of Helios], all 9 Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures of Helios will radiate their Extremity Authority to decimate the core Records of the Aspects of Existence of the target. If all Records of the Target are successfully erased, the [Hyperversal Projectile of Helios] will use the force of the extinguished Records to undergo [Nirvanic Rebirth of Helios] and produce another [Hyperversal Projectile of Helios] that will chain to another intended target, and this chain effect can continue a total of 9 times if every selected target thereafter perishes due to each shot. If there isn't another intended target, the newly reborn [Hyperversal Projectile of Helios] will return to you and grant back half of its initial resource requirement. This only covers the rudimentary and base usage of the Hyperversal Bow of Helios, with advanced usage including the features of [Deadeye], [Infinite Helios], and [Ricochet]. An Extremity Soul that had been reinforced and refined by Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures will be best suited to utilize the advanced features of the Hyperversal Bow of Helios as the resource requirement becomes that much greater, and a weak Extremity Soul cannot bear it...]

chapters.title: Chapter 2725 Appalling Might! II
paragraphs: Noah's eyes squinted at the details of the Hyperversal Bow of Helios as the space around him shuddered.
It shuddered as if it was crying out in sorrow and despair for anyone who chose to be his enemy!

Noah's own soul perused across the details of the Low Grade Armament of Extremity hundreds of times in an instant as he understood its capabilities extremely well, his own soul buzzing when he read the details of the advanced features of [Deadeye], [Infinite Helios], and [Ricochet].
But the base reality of this weapon remained clear.
A single pull of its bow string would require 100 Extremity Soul Values and 100,000 Extremity Mana Values!
Now, with the advent of his unique Extremity Soul, Noah could see in his status panel the words Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values.

Not Extremity Soul Values- but an advanced form of these Values known as Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values! They were different from other beings as Noah innately knew that his were much grander, and just like the description of his soul stated- he would have to see just how much grander they were by testing his limits!

Currently, he could see that he had just barely broken the barrier of 100 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values, with this number rising in decimal points as the boons of the Ash Tree III of Gradation finished being swallowed up in addition to the assimilation of the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity and the effects of Apexification.
In addition to this, every part of his existence continued to change because of his Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul.

Under the effects of his Extremity Soul, his Mana Values were already being transformed into Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Mana Values- this process being arduous and time-consuming as over 1 million units of Mana were already transformed into Extremity Mana!
The task of transforming his Mana Values to Extremity Mana Values would be an endless one as they would continue to rise up to an extent they would be determined infinite.
HUUM!

His body buzzed as he grasped the Hyperversal Bow of Helios in his right hand tightly, his soul roaring out with majesty as he flung the bow from one hand to another as his left hand now grasped its center handle.
He straightened up in the starry space he floated in as his left hand rose, the bow in his hands pointing up!
Then, the fingers of his right hand rested on the terrifyingly sharp bow string that began to buzz as he...pulled it back.

The instant he did so, the air around him entirely changed as a shockingly sharp aura erupted, an aura that caused the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities far below Noah to feel their Souls shuddering as if they expected certain death were this Bow to ever be directed towards them!

They barely raised their heads in their kneeling position as they saw Noah's glorious figure that was now bathed in a Crimson gold light- Scriptures of Helios emanating from the Bow bow circling the surroundings as they gave off a glow that made him seem like a celestial archer Unrecorded in eons past.
He pulled on the bow string.
And he unveiled and quantified yet another wonder of his Extremity Soul.
To pull back the bowstring and knock a single [Hyperversal Projectile of Helios], 100 Extremity Soul Values were required along with 100,000 Extremity Mana Values!

Yet as he pulled back the bowstring enough to have the Hyperversal Projectile of Helios be 10% completed, he found that only .1 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values and 1,000 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Mana Values were used up so far.
It foretold of the sheer ridiculousness of Noah's new Soul.
It meant that to fully knock the Hyperversal Projectile of Helios, he would only need 1 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values and 10,000 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Mana Values!
This shocking finding was quickly ascertained by Noah as he tracked down why soon after.
Since it was a unique type of Extremity Soul, the resource cost of Extremity Soul Values only required a tenth of Noah's Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Value to be paid.
Then, there was still the quality of his Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Mana Values that paid for a vast majority of the abilities he cast with his soul values.

His Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Mana Values that were still being changed at this moment covered another 90% of the resource cost as the cost of 100 Extremity Soul Values was cut down to 10, and then cut down to 1!
Meanwhile, the additional cost of Extremity Mana Values was cut from 100,000 to 10,000!
It was an astounding reality as still, this wasn't all.
There was the rate at which he regenerated his Extremity Soul Values.
Since he had barely spent any resources so far, Noah continued to knock the bowstring back to more accurately ascertain the rate of regeneration.
BZZT...KAA!

The reality around him buzzed as it began to melt, extreme heat permeating all around as after the heavy buzzing, a sharp cry boomed out as a crimson gold flaming singularity of an arrow formed between his fingertips!
The reality around him was melting, and yet his body remained unfettered as his Extremity Soul bathed his hand- the scorching heat not harming him in the least.

He continued to pull the bow string back further and further until he spent a full 1 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Value and 10,000 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Mana Values, the Crimson gold arrow between his fingertips buzzing and becoming completely formed as its arrowhead actually had two blinding Singularities open as if they were eyes, 9 Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures of Helios burning throughout it and ready to be directed to their target.
It was an arrow that could cross Recorded and Unrecorded Histories.
An arrow that could traverse the Aeonic Annals of Extremity to reach an observable target in the current unfolding reality or non-reality!
Noah had fully knocked the arrow without yet choosing a target, with his soul gazing inward to affirm his rate of regeneration as he found an appalling scene.

In his body, his Innate Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians had spread out as if they were innumerable vessels and capillaries- entirely connecting to all parts of him as they even had vessels stretching out across his Eight Aletheian Havens.
His 162 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians were the same as they stretched out across his existence!
Every flow and ebb of his Boundaries, every flow and ebb of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities...they now seemed to do so in every part of his being as he could feel them all simultaneously.

And all of these vessels of meridians...went on to connect to the utterly magnificent mountainous-looking Reality Passages that were stretched out across his Aletheian Havens, with some massive Reality Passages even connecting from one Haven to another.
Within the Havens, and between the Havens!

These Reality Passages looked like grand celestial mountains that pulsed and gushed out energy, with the flow of his Boundaries, Vitalis, and Vacuous Authorities coursing through his Meridians culminating within these mountains as on their peaks, they gushed out multicolored lava light of immeasurable waves of essence that just by pulsing across his existence once...
Caused a glow of Quintessence to flash within Noah as he found that the single Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Value he spent was already restored.
And...it had only been a tenth of a second that passed.
It meant that every second, Noah would recover 10 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values- and his maximum reserves were barely just spilling above 100!

And every shot of a [Hyperversal Projectile of Helios] that held 9 Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures of Helios cost 1 Extremity Soul Value for him instead of 100 as if this single shot could theoretically wipe out a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity...
How many Extremities could he kill per second? If the 9 chaining effects of the Hyperversal Projectile of Helios were achieved, just how appalling would the things he planned be?!
DUM!
The booming and low sound of a drum began to beat in the surroundings.

The transformations brought about by an Extremity Soul were far from over as the interconnectedness of Noah's meridians, Reality Passages, and Origin brought about an unprecedented change as above him, spanning half of the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven- an illusory mountainous Reality Passage pulsing with threads of his Extremity Soul began to form.

It billowed out majesty and ghastly cries of glory as it looked like an inverted mountain the size of multiple Havens pointing down towards Noah's line visage, its mountain top billowing out and erupting with endless waves of energy at this point as all of it began to gush down towards Noah in a dense steam of utter majesty.

As this process began, his status panel that showed his Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values and the quantified Units of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities he held...their numerical value became encased in brackets as next to these brackets, a +1 appeared.
With another tenth of a passing second this number once more changed, and the Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values now displayed (100)+2.
And...it did not stop as from the massive illusory inverted mountainous Reality Passage half the size of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, even denser waves of authority continued to cascade down!

chapters.title: Chapter 2726 Appalling Might! III
paragraphs: The scene in itself was utterly outlandish.

When the illusory mountainous Reality Passage half the size of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven descended, it pulsed with so much essence and authority that the Vassals that had their consciousness shaken and fainted were gradually aroused, their souls feeling a sense of nourishment and immense as they blinked their eyes while ascertaining their current reality.
Gradually, they gazed up to observe yet another scene that they could never forget in all their Recorded Histories.
An entity with a golden crimson bow pulled all the way back, the reality around him warping and melting as an arrow blazing with golden flames was roaring out to be released.

And above this figure, the illusory stellar mountain shone with multiple colors as it gushed out waves of essence and authority unto his body- particles of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities being among the waves descending down!
It was utterly breathtaking for others to see, but under Noah's own gaze...it was only logical for it to be this way.
It was only logical that the Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul show this shred of power and might.
After all, it was transformed from the Extremity Rune Scriptures of VITALIS and VACUOUS! Authorities that weren't yet even close to his grasp.
And under his eyes, even more things were quantified.
{The Meridians coursing with Authority in your existence have intricately connected with your Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Reality Passages!}

{The Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Reality Passages aid in the rapid generation of authorities and resources, but they go past this to generate an additional Quintessential Reserve of all Authorities and Resources that matches your maximum values.}

{The intricate connection of your Innate Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians to your Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Reality Passages and Aspects of Existence will only further expedite the rate at which Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities enrich your existence, and this will expedite the rate of your Awakenings.}
Extremity came in different forms, but when it elevated an existence- many parts of what made them would be expanded upon to also reach their extremes.

Noah's Extremity Soul sought to overdo itself in this aspect as his Reality Passages were transformed and granted a terrifying power- this same power giving Noah the capability to do something dreadful that he was only theorizing of with every passing second!

Instead of requiring 100 Extremity Soul Values to pull back the bowstring and fall forth a Hyperversal Projectile of Helios, he only needed 1 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Value as the requirement of Extremity Mana Values was inconsequential at this moment- his transformation of this type of Mana already reaching 1 million from 100,000 after the tenths of seconds passed.
The main factor to how rapid his attacks would be lay in his Extremity Soul Values and how rapidly he recovered them.
By recovering 10 every second, he could release 10 Hyperversal Projectiles of Helios in a single second as his resources would remain unchanged.

And then...there were the advanced features of the Hyperversal Bow of Helios that were named {Deadeye}, {Infinite Helios}, and {Ricochet}. Out of these, Noah only breezing through their appalling details observed that he could utilize {Deadeye} since it cost 10,000 Extremity Soul Values to cast!
But first, he would see the effectiveness of the {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios}.
How did it fair against Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities?
With the bow string pulled to the utmost limit and the Hyperversal Projectile of Helios trembling in Noah's hands asking to be released, his main body closed his eyes.
And in his mind, the scenes of the deadly battle where millions of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms had perished and hundreds of Hyperversal Extremities had fallen on each side played out.
Uniquely, Noah's actions accounted for the vast majority of the death toll of the Vacuous Hyperversal Lineages as even Emperor Shao didn't exceed Noah in terms of casualties that he had caused.

This could be attributed to the fact that Shao was surrounded and keeping at bag multiple Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities, but it was a testament to Noah's own power that under his hands, more Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and Extremities had fallen than the number from a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity!
And now, he wanted to widen this gap even more.
His will gazed at the battlefield and came to lock onto dozens of Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities stretched out across different Savior's Arks.
He focused on those who weren't even affected by his Virions as his vision came to lock onto a single Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity in particular.
His visage displayed a humanoid appearance with six arms and two heads, his body brimming with 44 Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of {DESTITUTION} swirling across his existence.
An Extremity that had only brought a single concept to the extremes of what it could be.

After forging a single Golden Hyperversal Extremity Rune Scripture when they first attained Extremity, they worked hard to accumulate these to 44 currently as they were halfway to the Zenith of the First Gradation of Extremity.
Noah locked his will on such an Extremity that was currently wielding an Ax Relic in his hands while pushing back a Tier 1 Vitalis Extremity opposite him.

Vacuous and Vitalis Apex Aeonic Lifeforms battled around them as every now and then, some would erupt with great domains of Boundaries or Dynamis of Extremity to cause the true death of other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
Locked onto this Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity, Noah released the bowstring of the Hyperversal Bow of Helios for the first time.

When the fingers of his right hand released it within the depths of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity where he hid the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, the {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios} roared out as the moment it shot out, it disappeared as if it had never existed.
And then, within the span of an instant...
SAA!

Noah's Reified Source of Quintessence observing everything on the battlefield between Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions saw the arrowhead of the {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios} bloom in front of the face of the Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity.
Within the span of an instant!
It crossed innumerable records and distances as it ignored spacetime or the absence of spacetime to appear before its target right away.
The Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity didn't and couldn't even react in time!

chapters.title: Chapter 2727 Appalling Might! IV
paragraphs: The reaction time of the Extremity couldn't even compare to the speed of the attack!
His eyes only saw a blinding gold flash out of nowhere as Noah's will intensified its focus to understand just what would happen next.
Under his Extremity Soul, everything was zoomed in and played out in slow motion.

He saw that the moment the arrowhead of the Hyperversal Projectile of Helios came in contact with the first Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of Destitution that protected this being, the Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scripture of HELIOS at the very forefront burned the Golden Rune of Destitution as if it didn't even exist to begin with.
What was the Hyperversal Projectile of Helios?
It was an attack shot out from a Low Grade Armament of Extremity that even a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity like Xiaomi had trouble holding onto!

It stated in its description that an existence with Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures was most ideal in the usage of the weapon, and that an existence whose soul had been enriched with Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures would be best suited to use its advanced features of Deadeye, Infinite Helios, and Ricochet.
It wasn't a weapon that Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities could support the expenditure of.

And so the {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios}...was not something a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity could handle as the 9 Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures of Helios within a single Projectile...Noah equated them to 9 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures!
Such a number of Rune Scriptures was what Xiaomi had when she reached the Zenith of Tier 1.

After gazing at Extremity so much recently, killing multiple of them to obtain their memories, and even observing the process of Extremity on his Vassals, Noah could confidently say that 9 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures were equivalent to 81 Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures- and this was the peak that Tier 1 existences had to climb to before they could try and enter Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity.

Within Tier 2, one would have to form up to 2,997 Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures if they sought to achieve Tier 3, or they simply had to have a powerful Concept of Extremity that granted them 333 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures before they could arrive at the Zenith of Tier 2 and try breaking into the stage of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity!
Noah didn't include Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures in these calculations as he needed more information on them.

So the single {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios} holding 9 Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures within it was akin to 81 Golden Rune Scriptures smashing onto an entity who only had 44 Scriptures- these defenses not being worth anything as they were scorched one after another as they were the Records of Extremity of this being...and after they were extinguished, the rest of his Records were sought and scorched by the single Projectile of Helios!
All of this...was Noah observing it in slow motion.

But in real time, the scene that the awareness of many beings saw...was a golden line blooming inches away from a Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity, and an instant later- the massive obsidian body of this Extremity was pulverized as his body exploded into colorful multicolored light as if he were fireworks!
It was appalling to see.
There wasn't the usage of a Virion or any underhanded means.
No False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER.
Just a pure, single attack shot out from a Hyperversal Bow of Helios.
A single attack, and Noah pulverized a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity!

Shocking cries erupted from the Vacuous Apex Lifeforms that had lost their pillar as the Vitalis Hyperversal Extremity who was fighting the now dead Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity gazed on in a stupor, his soul feeling prickles of horror as he felt like he was a breath away from death.
But...the most shocking thing had yet to bloom.

Because under the features of the basic attack of the Hyperversal Bow of Helios, it stated that if an attack by a {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios} was successful in eradicating them, it would undergo {Nirvanic Rebirth of Helios} and chain onto another target- for a total of 9 times if every target was successfully killed after the first!
And this fantastical reality was exactly what played out next.

From the ashes of the pulverized records of the Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity, crimson gold flames instantly came to life and formed into a blazing {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios} that disappeared where it stood, instantly appearing in front of a different Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity within the same domain of the Savior's Ark.

And this Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity faced the same fate as the one before it as before they could even react, a golden light appeared in front of them like a rising sun as in the next instant, their body exploded into tendrils of flames as their records were scorched and destroyed.

The scene caused alarm to rise among the now less than 100 Vacuous Extremities within this arc as with shocking speed, yet another blazing crimson gold light flashed as in another area- a third Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities also became pulverized into tendrils of flames!
A moment later, it was the Fourth, then Fifth, and then Sixth!
It was all happening so fast that by the time a Tier 3 Vacuous Extremity roared out and released an obsidian domain, the 9th Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity was turned into a flicker of Ash and flames.
{OOH!}
Bellows of rage and anger erupted out at such a quick massacre that even the Tier 2 and 3 Hyperversal Extremities within this Ark's domain could not prevent.
They all gazed around with utmost caution as they felt like such quick attacks had to come from a powerful Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity!
And yet, nobody claimed this glory as even the Vitalis Hyperversal Extremities that were fighting them seemed to be in a stupor as they gazed at each other- seemingly asking...was that you?
As for the being responsible, his eyes blazed with glory from afar as he saw the results of a single {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios} had produced such shocking results.
His tyrannical will surged and bubbled with Quintessence.

His main body within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven held the Bow of Helios within his left hand tightly as his Nine Pupils released rays of glorious light, prompts exploding before his eyes as he raised this bow up again!
While he did so, sensational words began to echo out from him.
{Let tyranny reign free once more.}
DUM!
A booming drum echoed out in the surroundings as if it were ushering in records of a glorious future.
Quintessence blazed with shocking brilliance around Noah's figure as his voice continued to ring out.
{Let Extremities perish as if they were mere dust in the Records of Extremity.}
DUM!
{Let Quintessence shine with glory.}
DUM!
{Let the spamming commence.}

The booming drums caused the hearts of his Vassals to resonate as Noah pulled on the bowstring of the Hyperversal Bow of Helios for the second time, very quickly pulling it back as far as possible before he released.
And before a tenth of a second passed, his fingers had already drawn the bowstring again as another blazing gold {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios} was released.
And before another tenth of a second passed, another Golden arrow flew!

One after another, ten {Hyperversal Projectiles of Helios} were released within the span of a second as Noah's Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values remained unchanged, and his hands didn't stop going towards the bowstring a moment after he released it as flashes of crimson gold light continued to be released from him!
It was an appalling action that the True Emperor of Quintessence was taking, with the continued reality of this action bringing about irreversible changes to an already chaotic battlefield!

sentences.text: The reaction time of the Extremity couldn't even compare to the speed of the attack!
His eyes only saw a blinding gold flash out of nowhere as Noah's will intensified its focus to understand just what would happen next.
Under his Extremity Soul, everything was zoomed in and played out in slow motion.

He saw that the moment the arrowhead of the Hyperversal Projectile of Helios came in contact with the first Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of Destitution that protected this being, the Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scripture of HELIOS at the very forefront burned the Golden Rune of Destitution as if it didn't even exist to begin with.
What was the Hyperversal Projectile of Helios?
It was an attack shot out from a Low Grade Armament of Extremity that even a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity like Xiaomi had trouble holding onto!

It stated in its description that an existence with Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures was most ideal in the usage of the weapon, and that an existence whose soul had been enriched with Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures would be best suited to use its advanced features of Deadeye, Infinite Helios, and Ricochet.
It wasn't a weapon that Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities could support the expenditure of.

And so the {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios}...was not something a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity could handle as the 9 Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures of Helios within a single Projectile...Noah equated them to 9 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures!
Such a number of Rune Scriptures was what Xiaomi had when she reached the Zenith of Tier 1.

After gazing at Extremity so much recently, killing multiple of them to obtain their memories, and even observing the process of Extremity on his Vassals, Noah could confidently say that 9 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures were equivalent to 81 Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures- and this was the peak that Tier 1 existences had to climb to before they could try and enter Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity.

Within Tier 2, one would have to form up to 2,997 Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures if they sought to achieve Tier 3, or they simply had to have a powerful Concept of Extremity that granted them 333 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures before they could arrive at the Zenith of Tier 2 and try breaking into the stage of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity!
Noah didn't include Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures in these calculations as he needed more information on them.

So the single {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios} holding 9 Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures within it was akin to 81 Golden Rune Scriptures smashing onto an entity who only had 44 Scriptures- these defenses not being worth anything as they were scorched one after another as they were the Records of Extremity of this being...and after they were extinguished, the rest of his Records were sought and scorched by the single Projectile of Helios!
All of this...was Noah observing it in slow motion.

But in real time, the scene that the awareness of many beings saw...was a golden line blooming inches away from a Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity, and an instant later- the massive obsidian body of this Extremity was pulverized as his body exploded into colorful multicolored light as if he were fireworks!
It was appalling to see.
There wasn't the usage of a Virion or any underhanded means.
No False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER.
Just a pure, single attack shot out from a Hyperversal Bow of Helios.
A single attack, and Noah pulverized a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity!

Shocking cries erupted from the Vacuous Apex Lifeforms that had lost their pillar as the Vitalis Hyperversal Extremity who was fighting the now dead Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity gazed on in a stupor, his soul feeling prickles of horror as he felt like he was a breath away from death.
But...the most shocking thing had yet to bloom.

Because under the features of the basic attack of the Hyperversal Bow of Helios, it stated that if an attack by a {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios} was successful in eradicating them, it would undergo {Nirvanic Rebirth of Helios} and chain onto another target- for a total of 9 times if every target was successfully killed after the first!
And this fantastical reality was exactly what played out next.

From the ashes of the pulverized records of the Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity, crimson gold flames instantly came to life and formed into a blazing {Hyperversal Projectile of Helios} that disappeared where it stood, instantly appearing in front of a different Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity within the same domain of the Savior's Ark.

And this Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity faced the same fate as the one before it as before they could even react, a golden light appeared in front of them like a rising sun as in the next instant, their body exploded into tendrils of flames as their records were scorched and destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2728 Appalling Might! V
paragraphs: 2728 Appalling Might! V
Like a primal archer from eons gone, Noah's hand never stopped pulling and releasing the tout bowstring of the Hyperversal Bow of Helios as he did so 10 timed within a second!
It was a level of spamming that Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities would find hard to maintain for even half a minute with the requirements of 100 Extremity Soul Values for any common being.

A Low Grade Armament of Extremity was something that Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities could utilize with some efficiency, but it was truly Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities who could expertly handle such weapons and achieve devastating effects- with Noah getting a glimpse of this with the dazzling sword that Emperor Shao used to nearly bisect a Hyperversal Savior's Ark.

Other Extremities on the battlefield were expressing multiple other Low Grade Armaments of Extremity in their own way- with them being held by prominent Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities and above for the most part!
Due to his unique Extremity Soul, Noah was utilizing the Low Grade Armament of Extremity in his hands in a way that would even put Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities to shame.
The result obtained from this...was a mystifying and unfathomable reality.
At the densest cluster of Existences where Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions were fighting.

The brief burst of roaring flashes of 9 flaming lights that whisked 9 Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities caught the attention of the Tier 3 Vacuous Extremities in the surroundings, their wills spread out wide open to see if the hidden expert releasing such strikes whom they deemed to be someone at Tier 3 or above would show themselves!
But nobody rose amidst the increasing chaos as after a brief lull of mere seconds...
SAA!
A flash of flaming crimson gold light appeared once more.
But this time, it wasn't alone. Nor did it appear in the domain field of their Hyperversal Savior's Ark alone!

One after another, 10 dazzling streaks of flaming gold appeared in the faces of Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities from different domains of Arks who were instantly exploded into flames and ash, a [Nirvanic Rebirth of Helios] occurring for each one after they succeeded in decimating their targets as they flashed away to appear in front of another 10 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities.
If these 10 Projectiles of Helios alone managed to achieve their purpose by changing 9 times, this would be 90 Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities snuffed out of existence in a ball of fire and ash.
But it wasn't just 10.
In a continued and shocking fashion, another 10 Projectiles of Helios appeared after every passing second as they targeted other Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities!
Noah's most arduous task in all this...was making sure he had multiple beings marked as targets for the Projectiles of Helios to continue chaining after every kill.

10 Projectiles of Helios every second. Each set of 10 designated to reap the lives of 90 Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities. So in the passing of 10 seconds, 900 Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities could theoretically be turned into Ash and flames.
If Noah continued for a full minute with his constant spam and no interference, that would be 5,400 Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities he could extinguish!

It would empty out the Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities within the protective light of at least 100 of the massive spinning wheels of the Hyperversal Savior's Ark controlled by the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions.
Such a daring possibility did not escape Noah's mind.

And Quintessence sought to achieve it as in a startling turn of events, multiple Arks began facing attacks that extinguished their Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities into balls of flames and ash, the flicker of crimson gold beginning to light up the darkness of the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority around them!
It very quickly caught the attention of the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities within the domains of these Arks as they bellowed out.
[Defend!]
[Behind me!]
The movements of the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities began to change as they sought to protect the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities.
Those at Tier 2 weren't even fast enough as they couldn't do anything about it.
And the Vitalis Hyperversal Extremities did not sit still at this opportunity as their attacks against their chosen Tier 2 and Tier 3 enemies became all that much more ferocious.

It meant that the burst of Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities being popped like flaming balloons continued within 10 domains of nearby Arks for the next few seconds, the death toll instantly rising to a few hundred dead Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities!
[HO!]

At such a juncture, a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity bellowed out as he saw the Nirvanic Rebirth of Helios occur where a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity used to be, and the reformed flaming arrow instantly pointed its trajectory towards another Tier 1 a distance to his right as this being angrily twisted space to appear in front of the next target, but the moment he arrived...
POOF!
He was faced with a flicker of flames and ash.

His eyes billowed with typhoons of rage as his body pulsed a meant later, an Extremity Domain Expansion erupting from him an instant later as a dense number of Crimson and Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures covered it- with this Domain Expansion extending to cover nearly 50% of the domain of the Ark he was in as every Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity was covered!
His obsidian pupils shone with a fiery light at this as he bellowed out.
[Now what, coward? Will you face your attacks to those who can contend with you?!]
This Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity bellowed out such words, not knowing the enemy who was doing all of this...had yet to even take any concept to Extremity!
What an awe inspiring reality this was.

If the pristine existences here truly knew that an Entity who had yet to achieve Extremity was utilizing a Low Grade Armament to spam over and over again to achieve this result...the very fundamentals they understood about Extremity would be bent and broken!
