chapters.title: Chapter 2729 Appalling Might! VI
paragraphs: 2729 Appalling Might! VI

The Projectiles of Helios that had killed their targeted Tier 1s within the Ark that now protected all others with swirling Obsidian and Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures underwent their Nirvanic Rebirth of Helios at this moment as an instant later...they flickered out of existence.

They disappeared from the domain field of this Ark entirely as an instant later, they appeared in the Domain of the Ark to their left that already had Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity scrambling to put up heavy defenses and expand their Extremity Domain Expansions.
And...
POOF! POOF! POOF!
The scene of pristine and esteemed Extremities exploding into Ash and flames continued as if nothing had ever happened.
The face of the Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity and other prominent Vacuous Extremities in nearby Arks turned extremely sour at such a progression.
Deadly attacks that could extinguish Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities in an instant were appearing en masse as they actively avoided Tier 2 and 3 Hyperversal Extremities!
Only five seconds had passed as already, over 400 Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities had perished.
Such a loss in such a short period of time was devastating as even their enemies- the Vitalis Hyperversal Extremities in this region...watched on in a stupor!

Some of the veteran Tier 3 Vitalis Hyperversal Extremities instantly used this situation to their advantage as two grouped up to attack the Zenith Tier 3 Vacuous Extremity who had expanded an Extremity Domain to protect the Tier 1s under his Ark.
If he was using his Rune Scriptures to protect others, what was protecting him would be greatly reduced.
This caused the battle and chaos here to get even more intense.

And in the seconds that followed, more and more domains of Savior's Arks saw flickers of crimson gold flaming arrows turn their Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities to ash as their Tier 3s resorted to releasing Domain Expansions or other unique means of their Concepts of Extremity to lay out barriers and brilliant auras of protection around their Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities!

And during this whole time, they continued to search for which terrifying enemy was doing all of this as after Tier 3 Vacuous Extremities got involved in protecting the Tier 1s, the target of the crimson gold arrows would only move to other Arks and continue their rampage.
The scene was utterly devastating as with another 6 seconds passing, the death toll of Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities in this region exceeded 1000!
[AWOO!]

A Tier 3 Vacuous Extremity with a humanoid form had rage flowing out of his eyes as he bellowed out in indignation, his shout spreading out far behind him where Vacuous Hyperversal Authority swirled with dense mist obscuring everything.
[O Esteemed Infernal Emperors, please make a move!]

After the drastic death toll of 1,000 Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities in the span of 10 seconds- a death toll that hadn't occurred in such numbers even in the span of the last day if they gazed at it from the perspective of the constraints of time that their enemies were bound by...they had to call out.
Because whatever dreadful enemy that was causing all of this could not be allowed to continue!

And the moment that the Tier 3 Vacuous Extremity called out such words, from the depths of Vacuous Hyperversal Legions that seemed to endlessly stretch from behind...the blazing aura of a Tier 4 Vacuous Extremity blared out and rose like a tide.

An existence adorned in the Vacuous Entity III Form appeared as they were made up of pure Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, their bodies shining gorgeously with five pairs of wings as they held a humanoid female body that showed off illusory curves of wonder and beauty.
Their face only had two obsidian Singularities spinning with glory as they gazed at the dozens of domain fields of Savior's Arks.
This terrifying Tier 4 Entity appeared as she locked onto the flaming authority that seemed too fast for many eyes.
Under her breath, she muttered.
[The Havenly Extremity Authority of Helios...]
WAA!
She could see the makeup of the dazzling arrows that were laying waste to so many of their people.

It wasn't that they were extremely powerful- they were average at best, at the level of Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures at most. The issue was their frequency and speed as they targeted so many Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities.

After this being analyzed these fantastical arrows of crimson gold flaming light, she thrust her hands made of pure Aurora of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as a dense number of Rune Scriptures erupted from her and disappeared into nothingness.

A second later, the barrage of the Projectiles of Helios continued as they were surging towards 90 targets at this moment when simultaneously, the moment that the blazing Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures of Helios at the top of the flaming arrows were about to come in contact with their targets...
BZZT!
A heavy friction bloomed as a Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture that read [PERDITION].
Perdition!
It was the Infernal Authority of Perdition from the Infernal Havens of Extremity!

It instantly bloomed in front of all current targets of the Projectiles of Helios as the clash was heavy and robust, instantly decimating the 9 Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures of Helios within the Projectiles as they were rebuffed and eradicated soon after.
Stark silence descended in this region.
SAA!
After another second, another 10 arrows of flaming light flashed towards other targets in Arks that were light years away, and yet when they were about to hit their targets...
BZZT!
The Crimson Rune Scriptures of Perdition bloomed as the means of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity were expressed.

She didn't make a move to protect all Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities or release an Extremity Domain Expansion that would cost a great deal, she somehow locked onto the signature of the particular Authority of Helios within the arrows blazing forth as an opposite Infernal Authority repelled them before they could hit any targets!
It was an austere and shocking development.
To counter Noah's brazen attacks, an esteemed Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity was mobilized from the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions.
An existence at the same stage as the leaders of the Seven Clans of the Nether Havens of Extremity.
Such a being had to step up to cancel Noah's attacks and stop the indiscriminate deaths of thousands of Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities!
